stories.title: PML-N Seeks Referendum Support from PPP Over New Provinces
stories.summary:
Pakistan Muslim League-Nawaz (PML-N) leader Tariq Fazal Chaudhry announced on Friday that his party will make an all-out effort to convince the Pakistan Peoples Party (PPP) to support holding a referendum regarding the creation of new provinces. Speaking to Geo News, the federal minister described a referendum as a democratic and constitutional option that allows citizens to directly voice their opinions on the matter, while acknowledging that the PPP maintains reservations concerning the division of Sindh.

The push for new provinces has sparked intense political friction and an exchange of statements between coalition partners. PPP Chairman Bilawal Bhutto-Zardari recently criticized the Centre, warning that forcing a division of Sindh could lead to unrest and questioning why the debate was initiated without consulting major stakeholders. In contrast, federal ministers and PML-N leaders, including Defence Minister Khawaja Asif and Health Minister Mustafa Kamal, argued that smaller provinces are essential for improved governance and that public opinion must guide the process.

Amid the tensions, Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif and President Asif Ali Zardari held a meeting at Aiwan-e-Sadr to address the verbal exchanges between the allied parties. The leaders agreed to resolve all differences through mutual consultation and dialogue. Chaudhry expressed strong confidence that the PPP will remain within the ruling coalition and that both parties will continue working together despite their differing stances on administrative boundaries.

This debate highlights deep political divisions over regional administration in Pakistan. While the PML-N and the Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf (PTI) show openness toward creating new provinces, the PPP remains fiercely opposed to dividing Sindh. Chaudhry emphasized that national consensus is vital, but argued that the process should not stall entirely simply because one party objects, underscoring the ongoing challenge of maintaining unity within the ruling alliance.

stories.title: Pakistan Strongly Rejects India's Baseless Mineral and UN Remarks
stories.summary:
Pakistan has issued a strong rejection of recent remarks made by India at the United Nations, labeling them as undiplomatic, irresponsible, and baseless. Foreign Office Spokesperson Sajjad Haider Khan characterized India's comments as an unacceptable interference in Pakistan's domestic affairs that directly violates the principles of the United Nations Charter. He noted that Pakistan's representative immediately rebutted the Indian allegations during the same UN session.

According to the Foreign Office, India is resorting to unsubstantiated insinuations against Pakistan's institutions and leadership instead of addressing legitimate concerns regarding hydro-terrorism. Islamabad reiterated long-standing allegations that India sponsors terrorist activities in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and Balochistan to disrupt stability and hinder local mineral development. Furthermore, Pakistan accused New Delhi of attempting to weaponize shared water resources by unilaterally holding the Indus Waters Treaty in abeyance.

Tensions over water resources are underscored by a unanimous ruling issued on August 31, 2026, by a Court of Arbitration established under the treaty. The court affirmed that the agreement remains legally binding and fully in force, with no legal foundation for a unilateral suspension. Pakistan argued that India's refusal to accept this ruling calls into question its commitment to international law and treaty obligations.

The Foreign Office statement also criticized India's domestic policies, alleging systematic discrimination against religious and social minorities such as Muslims, Sikhs, Christians, and Dalits. Islamabad concluded by urging New Delhi to cease using international platforms for spreading disinformation, fulfill its obligations under United Nations Security Council resolutions regarding Jammu and Kashmir, and respect the region's right to self-determination.

stories.title: Sanaullah Urges President Zardari to Counsel Sons on New Provinces
stories.summary:
Adviser to the Prime Minister on Political Affairs Rana Sanaullah has called on President Asif Ali Zardari to counsel his sons, Bilawal Bhutto-Zardari and Mohsin Naqvi, to keep the ongoing debate regarding new provinces constructive. Speaking on a television program, Sanaullah suggested that the president should speak with both figures to ensure that discussions remain healthy, noting that one son opposes the creation of new provinces while the other is in favor. He stressed that supporters and opponents alike must be free to present their positions without the discourse becoming polluted.

The debate has intensified following recent remarks by PPP Chairman Bilawal Bhutto-Zardari, who criticized the Centre and warned against forcing the division of Sindh. Bilawal argued that the discussion was launched without consulting key stakeholders and cautioned that coercion could trigger dangerous unrest. In response, federal ministers and PML-N leaders have defended the concept of smaller provinces, arguing that they are necessary for effective governance and that public sentiment should ultimately prevail.

Defence Minister Khawaja Asif also weighed in on the issue, warning that closing off political avenues for new provinces would harm the country and its people. Asif emphasized that political systems require public support to change and criticized politicians for retreating into personal agendas. He reiterated that the PML-N holds no reservations regarding new provinces and that Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif is actively seeking a national consensus through dialogue with coalition partners and President Zardari.

The back-and-forth reflects underlying strains within Pakistan's hybrid political system, where allied parties hold conflicting views on administrative restructuring. While the PML-N and other ministers maintain that smaller administrative units are vital for better management, the PPP views the push to divide Sindh as an existential threat. Leaders from across the political spectrum continue to stress the importance of resolving these disputes through formal dialogue rather than public confrontation.

stories.title: Trump Urges Nvidia to Reinstate Ousted CEO Jensen Huang
stories.summary:
US President Donald Trump publicly suggested that artificial intelligence giant Nvidia should give ousted CEO Jensen Huang a second chance. Huang resigned from his leadership position at the chip manufacturing company after disclosures of extramarital relationships, including one involving an alleged Chinese spy who might have funneled restricted semiconductor chips into China.

Speaking to reporters outside the Oval Office in Washington, DC, Trump praised Huang as one of the world's most brilliant minds. The matter of Huang's departure was not addressed during discussions between Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping in Shenzhen earlier in the week, according to Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent.

During those same bilateral talks, Trump and Xi reached an agreement regarding military guardrails for artificial intelligence. Both leaders concurred that human operators must retain decision-making authority over major military actions, preventing AI systems from operating with total autonomy.

Bessent emphasized that the United States must maintain its technological edge over China to safeguard against foreign exploits and cyberattacks. He noted that allowing domestic AI labs to remain at the forefront of innovation serves as the country's primary defense shield.

stories.title: Indian Man Sentenced to Over 19 Years for US Assassination Plot
stories.summary:
An Indian national received a prison sentence of more than 19 years in a United States court for orchestrating a foiled plot to murder a Sikh separatist on American soil. Nikhil Gupta pleaded guilty in February to three distinct charges, which included murder-for-hire, conspiracy to commit murder-for-hire, and conspiracy to commit money laundering.

Federal prosecutors stated that the assassination scheme was directed by an unidentified Indian intelligence officer who recruited Gupta in May 2023 to hire a hitman. The intended target of the plot was Gurpatwant Singh Pannun, a 56-year-old dual US-Canadian citizen associated with Sikhs for Justice, a New York-based organization advocating for the secession of Punjab.

The case caused diplomatic friction between Washington and New Delhi, though the Indian government denied any involvement. The incident followed a similar 2023 allegation by Canada claiming that Indian agents orchestrated the killing of naturalized Canadian citizen and Sikh separatist Hardeep Singh Nijjar, who was shot dead outside a British Columbia temple.

stories.title: Bilawal Criticizes Ministers While Highlighting Pakistan's Ongoing Economic Hardships
stories.summary:
Pakistan Peoples Party Chairman Bilawal Bhutto-Zardari stated in Karachi that whenever Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif attempts to present an economic recovery plan, a minister interjects with their own agenda. Bilawal emphasized that Pakistan is facing severe economic distress alongside regional war-like conditions, noting that citizens are heavily bearing the financial strain of the ongoing situation. He remarked that he has never witnessed such difficult financial times in his life and cautioned that resolving the crisis will take considerable time.

The PPP leader expressed a desire to strengthen the prime minister's hand, hoping Shehbaz becomes the first premier in Pakistan to complete a full five-year term. He argued that no single political party can resolve the country's challenges alone, calling instead for broad national consultations and joint efforts that prioritize the national interest over personal revenge. Furthermore, Bilawal asserted that the opposition Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf, founded by Imran Khan, must be engaged and return to parliament to play a constructive role despite political differences.

Detailing local initiatives, Bilawal noted that the Sindh government is supporting 600,000 farmers through the Hari Card to mitigate rising diesel and fertilizer costs. He also pointed out that an emergency was declared in Tharparkar due to drought, with the Benazir Income Support Programme distributing Rs8,000 to impoverished residents. Additionally, the Sindh party leadership is constructing one million homes for women ownership, generating employment, and offering free CyberKnife treatments.

Bilawal concluded by noting that inflation, poverty, and unemployment continue to rise across the country. He clarified that it remains the prime minister's prerogative whether or not to adopt the suggestions put forward by the PPP. By emphasizing grassroots support and tenant farmer representation, the PPP chairman reiterated his call for unified political action to steer the nation out of its current economic turmoil.

stories.title: Anthropic Researcher Claims Claude Chatbot Solved Riemann Hypothesis
stories.summary:
A mathematician at artificial intelligence firm Anthropic stated on Friday that he used the company's Claude chatbot to discover a proof for the Riemann Hypothesis, a prominent mathematical problem unsolved for over 160 years. In a four-legged note released publicly, Levent Alpoge wrote that he believes he successfully worked with Claude to resolve the complex question. However, this remarkable claim has not yet been independently verified or reviewed by outside academic experts.

Proposed originally in 1859 by German mathematician Bernhard Riemann, the hypothesis deals with the distribution of prime numbers and stands as the most critical open question in pure mathematics. It is classified as one of seven Millennium Prize Problems by the Clay Mathematics Institute, which offers a $1 million reward for a valid solution. Institute rules dictate that any successful solution must be published in a peer-reviewed journal and survive two years of intense scrutiny by the mathematical community.

Alpoge noted that the methodology also resolves the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis, a broader version of the problem. He stated that he and the AI generated a version of the proof in Lean, a computer programming language used to verify mathematical arguments, and chose to release only that version for now. He explained that a complete written proof would be extremely long and that he intends to properly write it up after mastering all the underlying mathematics involved.

Before making the announcement, Alpoge consulted Anthropic Chief Executive Dario Amodei. The announcement arrives shortly after rival firm OpenAI claimed an AI model solved a different Millennium Prize Problem related to fluid dynamics, a claim that is still undergoing vetting. Anthropic has not yet responded to requests for comment regarding Alpoge's assertion about the Riemann Hypothesis.

stories.title: Pakistani Minister Insists Referendum on New Provinces Will Proceed
stories.summary:
Federal Parliamentary Affairs Minister Tariq Fazal Chaudhry stated on Friday that a public referendum regarding the creation of new provinces will definitely happen. The announcement follows a speech by Pakistan Peoples Party Chairman Bilawal Bhutto-Zardari on Tuesday, in which he strongly opposed the division of provinces and the idea of a referendum, warning that forced divisions in Sindh could lead to bloodshed. 

Despite the opposition from the PPP, Chaudhry maintained that a referendum is a constitutional and legal method to gauge public opinion. Speaking on a Geo News program, Chaudhry emphasized that building a national consensus is a priority for the ruling coalition, though the process cannot be halted simply because a single party disagrees. He noted that the Pakistan Muslim League-Nawaz will make every effort to convince the PPP to stay in the coalition. 

Chaudhry confirmed that Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif and President Asif Ali Zardari recently met in Islamabad to address the verbal confrontation between the coalition allies. He stated that both leaders agreed to resolve their differences through dialogue, and matters have largely returned to normal. Furthermore, Chaudhry affirmed that Prime Minister Sharif fully coordinates major decisions with PML-N supremo Nawaz Sharif. 

Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi initially floated the referendum idea on November 12, arguing that the current governance system has collapsed. While the Muttahida Qaumi Movement-Pakistan supported a nationwide referendum, the Jamiat-Ulema-i-Islam-Fazl backed Bilawal Bhutto-Zardari's stance. Meanwhile, Defence Minister Khawaja Asif expressed hope for a resolution while criticizing politicians who treat provinces like personal fiefdoms, maintaining that administrative division is meant to improve public service delivery.

stories.title: Pakistan Health Minister Blames High Fertility Rate for Economic Struggle
stories.summary:
Pakistan Health Minister Mustafa Kamal stated on Friday that the country's economy struggles to grow in real terms due to a rapid population growth driven by a high fertility rate of 3.5 children per woman. Speaking at the Healthtech 2026 event at NED University in Karachi, Kamal warned that a population growth rate matching the 2.5 percent GDP growth effectively leaves economic growth at zero. He emphasized that the fertility rate must drop below 1.5, similar to neighboring countries like Iran, Bangladesh, and Sri Lanka, to achieve economic viability.

Kamal highlighted that exorbitant healthcare costs have recently pushed 12 million people below the poverty line, forcing families to sell homes, land, and jewelry for medical treatments. The health minister noted that Pakistan adds a population larger than New Zealand every year, with approximately 6.7 million children born annually. Furthermore, he reported that 11,000 mothers die each year due to pregnancy-related complications, placing Pakistan at the top position globally for maternal mortality rates.

Malnutrition and neglect heavily contribute to the poor health of mothers, which subsequently results in 43 percent of children in Pakistan suffering from stunting. Kamal also noted that about 400,000 children die annually from preventable health-related causes, translating to roughly 1,300 child deaths every day. He questioned how the nation's youth bulge can be considered an asset when nearly half of the children are stunted.

Additionally, Kamal addressed the widespread public-health challenge of hepatitis C, which affects approximately 11 million people in the country. He underscored the importance of the prime minister's screening initiative and early treatment to prevent severe complications like liver cancer. The minister encouraged startups and innovators to focus on preventative healthcare solutions to help citizens lead healthier lives.

stories.title: Japan Offers Storage and Purchase Options for Saudi Crude Oil
stories.summary:
Japan has agreed to provide storage capacity for an extra 16 million barrels of Saudi crude oil and plans to purchase up to 8 million barrels for its national reserves, according to the Saudi Press Agency on Friday. This agreement follows virtual discussions held on November 9, 2026, between Saudi Minister of Energy Prince Abdulaziz bin Salman and Japan's Minister of Economy, Trade and Industry Ryosei Akazawa. The talks built upon earlier initiatives launched by a bilateral task force formed in May 2026.

Saudi Arabia has already begun replenishing joint stockpiling tanks in Japan as part of the Joint Crude Oil Stockpiling Project originally announced in 2010. Japan will temporarily place an additional 16 million barrels in Saudi national storage tanks. Combined with the 8 million barrels Japan previously allocated to the Kingdom's national reserve system, the total stored Saudi crude in Japan will reach 24 million barrels.

The arrangement also allows Japan to purchase up to 8 million barrels of Saudi crude for its national reserves, pending favorable market conditions and final execution procedures. Both countries are further aligning their regional resilience efforts through Japan's POWERR Asia process and the AZEC Ministerial Work Programme, which focus on strengthening oil stockpiling infrastructure, institutional capacity building, and synchronizing emergency response actions across Asia.

During their talks, the Saudi and Japanese ministers expressed mutual appreciation for their consistent energy cooperation. They reaffirmed their dedication to expanding and diversifying their joint stockpiling partnership to reinforce the relationship between energy producers and consumers.

stories.title: Arrival of Turkish Vessel Oruc Reis Marks New Era in Energy Cooperation
stories.summary:
Deputy Prime Minister Ishaq Dar stated on Friday that the arrival of the Turkish seismic research vessel Oruc Reis at Karachi Port inaugurates a new chapter in scientific and strategic energy collaboration between Pakistan and Turkiye. Speaking at a welcome ceremony, Dar emphasized that Pakistan's coastline offers vast potential for offshore exploration, shipping, and fisheries, highlighting the necessity of combining Turkish scientific expertise with local capabilities to identify seabed geological structures.

Turkish Energy Minister Alparslan Bayraktar, who attended the event, announced that the vessel completed a 19-day voyage to reach Pakistan and will conduct three-dimensional seismic surveys in Sindh and Makran offshore waters over roughly two months. Bayraktar noted that the Turkish Petroleum Corporation will handle data acquisition and confirmed that licensing for five blocks is complete, with offshore drilling expected to commence in 2027. He added that TPAO has established partnerships with domestic entities like the Oil and Gas Development Company Limited, Pakistan Petroleum Limited, and Mari Energies.

Petroleum Minister Ali Pervaiz Malik remarked that the arrival translates bilateral agreements into practical cooperation. Deputy Prime Minister Dar further stressed that development and environmental protection must proceed hand in hand, noting that Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif and Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan recently agreed in Antalya to accelerate collaboration across trade, defence, energy, and regional connectivity.

Bayraktar observed on X that the mission serves as a critical turning point for bilateral energy ties, particularly amid global oil and gas market turbulence. Although operations were previously delayed by approximately six months due to the conflict in Iran, the ongoing surveys in the Indus and Makran basins are expected to assess hydrocarbon potential and guide future exploration decisions.

stories.title: خواجہ آصف کا نئے صوبوں کے قیام اور ذاتی ایجنڈے پر بیان
stories.summary:
وزیر دفاع خواجہ محمد آصف کا کہنا ہے کہ سیاستدانوں کو اپنی ذات کے خول سے باہر نکلنا چاہیے کیونکہ دنیا میں نئے صوبے بنتے ہیں۔ ایک ٹی وی پروگرام میں گفتگو کرتے ہوئے انہوں نے الزام عائد کیا کہ ذاتی مقاصد اور ایجنڈے کو آگے بڑھانے کے لیے سندھ میں حالات خراب کرنے کا بہانہ بنایا جا رہا ہے۔ انہوں نے مزید کہا کہ اس بحث میں سیاستدانوں کے ذاتی مفادات سامنے آئے ہیں اور نئے صوبوں کے معاملے پر اتفاق رائے کے لیے وزیراعظم شہباز شریف کوشش کر رہے ہیں۔

وفاقی وزیر پارلیمانی امور طارق فضل چوہدری نے اس حوالے سے کہا ہے کہ کابینہ کی ہر بات کو میڈیا کے سامنے نہیں لایا جا سکتا۔ انہوں نے سیاست میں بات چیت کی ضرورت پر زور دیتے ہوئے کہا کہ خون خرابے کی باتیں معاملات کو غلط سمت میں لے جاتی ہیں۔ دوسری جانب سیاسی رہنماؤں نے مختلف امور پر اپنے خیالات کا اظہار کیا ہے جن میں پارلیمانی انتخابات اور دیگر انتظامی امور زیر بحث آئے۔

اس کے علاوہ ملک کے مختلف حصوں میں انتظامی اور سکیورٹی سے متعلق کئی اہم کارروائیاں بھی عمل میں لائی گئی ہیں۔ خیبر پختونخوا کے تمام سرکاری پرائمری اسکولوں میں روزانہ ایک گھنٹہ ریڈنگ آور لازمی قرار دیا گیا ہے تاکہ تعلیمی معیار کو بہتر بنایا جا سکے اور طلبہ کو منشیات جیسی مضر عادات سے بچایا جا سکے۔

وفاقی وزیر خزانہ سینیٹر محمد اورنگزیب نے اپنے ایک بیان میں کہا ہے کہ بجلی صارفین کو سستی اور مسابقتی فراہم کرنا حکومت کی اولین ترجیح ہے۔ اس کے علاوہ وزیراعظم شہباز شریف نے ترکیہ کے وزیر توانائی الپ ارسلان بیراکتار کے اعزاز میں عشائیہ دیا اور دونوں ممالک کے مابین دیرینہ تعلقات کو سراہا۔

stories.title: Merck Announces Trial Success for Advanced Stomach and Esophageal Cancers
stories.summary: Pharmaceutical company Merck announced on Friday that its experimental cancer drug successfully helped patients suffering from advanced stomach and esophageal cancers live longer compared to standard treatment options. The positive outcome was observed during a late-stage clinical trial evaluating the efficacy of the novel medication. The findings mark a significant development in the ongoing medical efforts to improve survival outcomes for patients diagnosed with these aggressive forms of gastrointestinal cancers.

stories.title: Three Militants Killed in Counter-Terrorism Department Operation in Kohat
stories.summary:
Three suspected members of the banned organisation Ittehadul Mujahideen Pakistan (IMP), including the mastermind of the Kohat Police Lines attack, were killed during a joint intelligence-based operation in Kohat, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. The Counter Terrorism Department (CTD) and district police launched the operation around 6:30 pm following intelligence reports that armed terrorists had set up a checkpoint on Bazeed Khel Road in the area.

Upon the arrival of law enforcement teams, the suspects opened indiscriminate fire, prompting the security forces to retaliate in self-defense. Following an exchange of gunfire, a search operation of the area led to the recovery of the bodies of three suspected militants, while several of their associates managed to escape. Authorities recovered three submachine guns and nine magazines from the site.

Preliminary investigations identified two of the deceased as Abdul Hai and Abdul Rashid. Abdul Hai, a local resident of Kohat, was wanted as the mastermind behind the September Kohat Police Lines suicide attack that left at least 21 people dead—including 15 police officials—and more than 100 injured. Both Hai and Rashid were also wanted in connection with a Rs6 million bank robbery in Balitang. The identity of the third militant remains unconfirmed.

Security forces are continuing search operations in the region to locate and capture the individuals who fled. KP police chief Zulfiqar Hameed and CTD Additional Inspector General Jawad Qamar stated that counter-terrorism efforts will persist until the complete elimination of militant groups. The incident occurs amid a nationwide surge in violence-related fatalities, with Balochistan and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa recording the vast majority of casualties during the third quarter of 2026.

stories.title: OGRA Adjusts Fuel Rates as Petroleum Dealers Demand Refinery Audits
stories.summary:
The Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority (OGRA) adjusted petroleum product prices for a three-day period spanning November 21 to 23. Under the official notification, the price of petrol decreased by Re1 per litre to set the new rate at Rs322 per litre, while diesel experienced a price increase of Rs2 per litre, bringing its cost to Rs357 per litre.

The price adjustment follows an emergency meeting held by petroleum dealers in Karachi, during which industry representatives called for a transparent forensic audit of oil refineries' financial records. Dealers, including Malik Khuda Bakhsh and Anwar Kamal, alleged that refineries had accumulated excessive earnings, generating a full year's profit in a span of three months.

According to the petroleum dealers, a proper examination of refinery accounts would demonstrate that consumers could receive price reliefs of Rs40 to Rs50 per litre on petrol. They argued that such measures are necessary to ease the financial pressures on the public and to prevent future economic burdens caused by perceived overcharging.

The dealers asserted that statements from the petroleum minister validated their concerns regarding refinery profits. They urged authorities to conduct a comprehensive financial review of all domestic refineries to establish accurate profit margins and ensure fairer pricing structures for consumers across the country.

stories.title: Joint CTD and Police Operation in Kohat Eliminates Three Suspected Militants
stories.summary:
Three suspected terrorists belonging to a banned group were killed during an exchange of fire with security forces in the Kohat district. The Counter Terrorism Department (CTD) reported that the joint intelligence-based operation was carried out in the Manakara mountainous area along Bazid Khel Road.

Law enforcement personnel encountered the armed suspects during the operation, resulting in a gunfight that left three militants dead. Authorities subsequently identified two of the deceased individuals as Abdul Hai and Abdul Rasheed, while the identity of the third person remains undetermined at this time.

Official records indicate that Abdul Hai, a resident of Kohat district, served as the mastermind behind the Kohat Police Lines suicide attack and was also wanted for involvement in a bank robbery. Abdul Rasheed was likewise sought by law enforcement in connection with the same bank robbery case.

During the aftermath of the operation, security personnel recovered three submachine guns and nine magazines from the possession of the killed suspects. A localized search operation remains active to apprehend any accomplices who managed to escape, and ongoing legal proceedings are being handled by the department.

stories.title: Government Revises Fuel Prices as Petrol Drops and Diesel Rises
stories.summary:
The federal government implemented a price adjustment for petroleum products, decreasing petrol by Re1 per litre and increasing diesel by Rs2 per litre. According to the Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority (OGRA) notification, the changes set retail prices at Rs322 per litre for petrol and Rs357 per litre for high-speed diesel, taking effect on November 21.

Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar emphasized ongoing government efforts to mitigate financial strains on citizens through policy changes, structural reforms, and targeted fuel subsidies. A Prime Minister’s Fuel Relief Scheme, launched in September, provides subsidized fuel to owners of motorcycles, rickshaws, and vehicles up to 800cc to counter rising costs linked to geopolitical tensions in the Middle East.

The government continues to levy substantial taxes, charging Rs114 per litre on petrol and Rs100 per litre on diesel. Additionally, an arrangement established on November 2 utilizes contributions from oil refineries to absorb a Rs15 billion cumulative impact, facilitating a partial reduction in consumer fuel costs.

In response to fluctuating international market conditions and prior price peaks—where diesel reached Rs520.35 and petrol hit Rs458.41 in April—authorities have also enforced austerity measures. These include a 9 pm closing time for markets and a 50 percent reduction in fuel allocations for official vehicles over a three-month period.

stories.title: Pakistan Foreign Office Rejects Indian UN Remarks and Mineral Claims
stories.summary:
Pakistan's Foreign Office strongly condemned recent statements made by India at the United Nations, labeling them undiplomatic, irresponsible, and reflective of an intent to interfere in internal affairs. Foreign Office Spokesperson Sajjad Haider Khan stated that New Delhi is actively attempting to destabilize Pakistan and oppose its mineral resource development.

Khan asserted that Islamabad possesses evidence linking India to sponsorship of terrorism in Balochistan and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa to obstruct development in mineral-rich regions. He further criticized India for evading concerns over hydro-terrorism, deflecting from domestic issues related to Hindutva extremism, and unilaterally holding the Indus Waters Treaty in abeyance in defiance of a Court of Arbitration ruling.

Addressing regional diplomacy, Khan noted that around 2,700 Sikh pilgrims from India are anticipated to arrive for the birth anniversary celebrations of Baba Guru Nanak. Regarding the Economic Cooperation Organization meeting in Islamabad, he explained that Afghanistan was excluded because Pakistan does not recognize the current Afghan administration, and its membership remains suspended until security concerns regarding terrorism are met.

stories.title: Pakistan Government Adjusts Fuel Rates as Global Oil Prices Fall
stories.summary:
The Pakistani government implemented a minor revision to domestic petroleum prices, reducing the cost of petrol while slightly increasing the price of high-speed diesel. The Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority issued a notification specifying that the new ex-depot prices would take effect from Saturday through Monday.

Under the revised pricing structure determined by the federal government's approved mechanism, the price of petrol decreased by Re 1 to reach Rs 322 per litre. Conversely, the price of diesel was raised by Rs 2, bringing the new rate to Rs 357 per litre.

These adjustments coincided with declining global oil markets, where benchmarks were heading toward their third consecutive weekly loss. Brent crude futures fell to $91.14 a barrel, while West Texas Intermediate futures also dropped amid growing expectations of a supply surplus and normalized crude shipments through the Strait of Hormuz.

stories.title: کوہاٹ میں انٹیلی جنس بیسڈ آپریشن، فتنہ الخوارج کے 3 دہشت گرد ہلاک
stories.summary:
کاؤنٹر ٹیررازم ڈیپارٹمنٹ (سی ٹی ڈی) اور پولیس نے خیبر پختونخوا کے شہر کوہاٹ میں ایک کامیاب کارروائی کے دوران فتنہ الخوارج سے تعلق رکھنے والے 3 دہشت گردوں کو ہلاک کر دیا ہے۔ یہ آپریشن بازید خیل روڈ منکارہ پہاڑی کے علاقے میں انٹیلی جنس معلومات کی بنیاد پر کیا گیا۔ سی ٹی ڈی کے مطابق ہلاک ہونے والے دہشت گردوں کا تعلق ایک کالعدم تنظیم سے تھا اور ان کے قبضے سے بھاری مقدار میں اسلحہ بھی برآمد کیا گیا ہے۔

حکام کا کہنا ہے کہ ہلاک شدگان میں کوہاٹ پولیس لائنز خودکش حملے کا ماسٹر مائنڈ بھی شامل تھا۔ آپریشن کے دوران کچھ دہشت گرد موقع سے فرار ہونے میں کامیاب ہو گئے جن کی گرفتاری کے لیے پولیس اور سی ٹی ڈی کی جانب سے علاقے میں شدید سرچ آپریشن جاری ہے۔ اس کارروائی کو سکیورٹی اداروں کی ایک بڑی کامیابی قرار دیا جا رہا ہے۔

دیگر خبروں میں وزیر دفاع خواجہ محمد آصف نے اپنے ایک بیان میں نئے صوبوں کے قیام کی حمایت کرتے ہوئے سیاستدانوں پر زور دیا ہے کہ وہ ذاتی خول سے باہر نکلیں۔ اس کے علاوہ خیبر پختونخوا کے تمام سرکاری پرائمری اسکولوں میں طلبہ کے لیے روزانہ ایک گھنٹہ ریڈنگ آور لازمی قرار دے دیا گیا ہے۔

وفاقی وزیر پارلیمانی امور طارق فضل چوہدری نے میڈیا سے گفتگو کرتے ہوئے کہا کہ کابینہ کے ہر فیصلے کو میڈیا کیز سامنے نہیں لایا جا سکتا۔ وفاقی وزیر خزانہ محمد اورنگزیب نے بھی صارفین کو سستی بجلی کی فراہمی کو حکومت کی ترجیح قرار دیا ہے جبکہ وزیراعظم شہباز شریف نے ترکیہ کے وزیر توانائی کے اعزاز میں عشائیہ دیا۔

stories.title: حافظ آباد کے سابق وزیر لیاقت بھٹی قتل کیس کے تین ملزمان گرفتار
stories.summary:
حافظ آباد میں سابق وفاقی وزیر لیاقت بھٹی کے قتل کے مقدمے میں نامزد تین ملزمان کو ملاکنڈ سے گرفتار کر لیا گیا ہے۔ پولیس کے مطابق اس کارروائی کے دوران ملزمان کے قبضے سے قتل میں استعمال ہونے والی تینوں گاڑیاں اور اسلحہ بھی کامیابی کے ساتھ برآمد کر لیا گیا ہے۔ گرفتار ہونے والے افراد میں صوابی کے رہائشی زاہد علی اور محمد خان بھی شامل ہیں۔

پولیس کے مطابق اس مقدمے میں لیاقت بھٹی کے اپنے چار ملازمین کو بھی نامزد کیا گیا ہے جن کی تلاش اور تفتیش جاری ہے۔ سابق وفاقی وزیر کو گزشتہ روز ان کی رہائش گاہ پر قتل کیا گیا تھا جس کے بعد سیاسی اور سماجی حلقوں میں گہری تشویش پائی جاتی تھی۔ قانون نافذ کرنے والے ادارے اس اندمناک واقعے کی تمام زاویوں سے تحقیقات کر رہے ہیں۔

ملک کے دیگر سیاسی اور انتظامی امور پر بات کرتے ہوئے وزیر دفاع خواجہ آصف نے نئے صوبوں کے قیام کی ضرورت پر زور دیا اور کہا کہ سیاستدانوں کو ذاتی مفادات سے بالاتر ہو کر سوچنا چاہیے۔ دریں اثنا، خیبر پختونخوا کے تمام سرکاری پرائمری اسکولوں میں روزانہ ایک گھنٹہ ریڈنگ آور کو لازمی قرار دے دیا گیا ہے۔

وفاقی وزیر خزانہ محمد اورنگزیب نے صارفین کو سستی اور مسابقتی بجلی فراہم کرنے کے عزم کا اعادہ کیا ہے۔ وزیراعظم شہباز شریف نے ترکیہ کے وزیر توانائی الپ ارسلان بیراکتار کے اعزاز میں عشائیہ دیا اور دونوں ممالک کے درمیان تاریخی اور برادرانہ تعلقات کو مزید مضبوط بنانے کے عزم کا اظہار کیا۔

stories.title: Security Forces Eliminate Militants Escaping in Rickshaws Dressed as Women
stories.summary:
Security forces in Pakistan neutralized multiple militants belonging to the Fitna al-Khawarij network during an operation in the Mir Ali region of North Waziristan. According to reports shared on Friday, the suspects attempted to evade capture by fleeing in a rickshaw while wearing female disguises. Authorities condemned this method as a violation of moral standards and an abuse of the respect traditionally afforded to women.

The operation was conducted under the framework of the Azm-e-Istehkam vision to counter ongoing threats in the region. Security officials noted that these militants frequently resorted to desperate and cowardly measures, including hiding inside local mosques and placing explosive devices in civilian neighborhoods to protect themselves.

Furthermore, officials stated that the extremist group routinely utilizes vulnerable women and children as human shields across Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. This latest engagement underscores the persistent security challenges faced by law enforcement agencies in dealing with embedded insurgent elements operating within civilian populated zones.

The elimination of these individuals marks a significant development in the ongoing counter-terrorism operations in North Waziristan. Authorities remain committed to dismantling the network's operational capabilities and neutralizing threats posed by militants disregarding ethical boundaries during armed conflicts.

stories.title: Saudi-Led Coalition Launches Military Operation Against Houthi Targets in Yemen
stories.summary:
The Joint Forces Command of the Coalition to Restore Legitimacy in Yemen announced a large-scale military operation across the Saada, Sanaa, and Taiz governorates on Friday. The strikes were initiated to neutralize Houthi threat sources that present a direct danger to civilians.

During the operation, coalition forces targeted critical logistics networks and infrastructure used for transporting and supplying weapons. The military actions successfully destroyed seven designated support targets and six workshops utilized by the Houthi group to maintain their operational capabilities. In Sanaa, the bombardment focused strictly on immediate threat sources to halt attacks against civilians while also neutralizing a major supply site.

Prior to the strikes, the Joint Forces Command issued an evacuation warning instructing civilians in the Red Sea port of Hodeidah to avoid designated areas using an accompanying chart. This military response follows escalating regional tensions triggered by a Houthi attack on a tower located in Riyadh’s King Abdullah Financial District, an incident that caused property damage but resulted in zero injuries.

The conflict highlights the ongoing geographical focus of regional hostilities. Meanwhile, in unrelated technological news, Apple removed the Andarium Android emulator from the App Store shortly after its approval, citing guidelines that objected to its ability to let iPhones and iPads run Android directly.

stories.title: Bilawal Urges Political Cooperation and Engagement with Imran Khan's Party
stories.summary:
Pakistan Peoples Party (PPP) Chairman Bilawal Bhutto Zardari voiced his support for Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif's economic policies during a public address in Karachi on Friday. Bilawal expressed a desire to strengthen the prime minister's hands so he can focus on achieving national economic prosperity. He stated that he had previously helped Shehbaz secure the premiership twice and expressed hope that he would become the first prime minister in the country's history to complete a full five-year constitutional term.

Addressing the severe economic hurdles facing the nation, Bilawal noted that the ongoing conflict involving Iran has intensified inflationary pressures, warning that citizens will continue to endure hardships until regional peace is achieved. He pointed out that everyday costs for diesel, electricity, gas, unemployment, and poverty are deeply concerning ordinary citizens, while fertilizer availability could also become constrained. Highlighting his party's commitment to agriculture, Bilawal mentioned the Benazir Hari Card initiative, which delivers financial assistance of Rs4,000 per acre to small landowners and farmers cultivating up to 25 acres in Sindh. Furthermore, he welcomed the designation of Tharparkar and Umerkot as disaster-hit districts, alongside the distribution of Rs8,000 to affected families via the Benazir Income Support Programme.

While acknowledging that Pakistan has narrowly avoided economic default and corrected its trajectory, Bilawal argued that Prime Minister Shehbaz has not been given adequate opportunity to implement a personal economic blueprint or unify all political factions behind a single recovery strategy. He observed that certain members of the premier's team appear to pursue independent agendas.

Concluding his remarks, Bilawal emphasized that no single political entity or coalition can resolve the country's crises alone. He urged the government to engage with opposition members, including those from Maulana Fazlur Rehman's faction and Imran Khan's party, stressing that political friction, stubbornness, and personal vendettas should never supersede national interests.

stories.title: ECC Approves Amendments to Export Financing Facility and Technical Grants
stories.summary:
The Economic Coordination Committee (ECC) of the Cabinet met on Friday at the Finance Division under the leadership of Federal Minister for Finance and Revenue Senator Muhammad Aurangzeb. During the session, the committee sanctioned amendments to the Long Term Export Growth Financing Facility, managed by the EXIM Bank of Pakistan. These adjustments aim to assist small and medium enterprises (SMEs) and emerging exporters by reducing the minimum export threshold from 80 percent to 50 percent over a four-year period, with a progress review scheduled after six months.

In addition to export facility adjustments, the ECC approved multiple Technical Supplementary Grants (TSGs) requested by various government ministries. These allocations include a Rs100 million grant for the Minorities Welfare Fund under the Ministry of Religious Affairs and Interfaith Harmony, intended for scholarships, orphan marriage grants, emergency relief, and the maintenance of minority places of worship. The committee also authorized TSGs for the Ministry of Interior and Narcotics Control, featuring Rs26.5 million for Pakistan Rangers Punjab helicopter spare parts, Rs100 million for the operational salaries of the Social Media Protection and Regulatory Authority and Social Media Complaint Council for fiscal year 2026-27, and Rs67 million for Frontier Corps Balochistan North helicopter maintenance.

Further financial decisions included modifying a previous directive for the Daanish Schools Authority, allowing the utilization of Rs500 million from a previously released Rs2 billion allocation to cover operational expenses such as salaries, utilities, transport, and maintenance for fiscal year 2026-27. The ECC also greenlit a Rs1 billion TSG to settle an outstanding guaranteed throughput claim for the Pak-Arab Pipeline Company Limited, alongside addressing sugar export recommendations to protect farmers' pricing interests.

The meeting gathered several high-ranking federal ministers, including Qaiser Ahmed Sheikh, Rana Tanveer Hussain, Sardar Awais Ahmad Khan Leghari, and Jam Kamal Khan, alongside state minister Bilal Azhar Kayani and various federal secretaries.

stories.title: کابینہ کی ہر بات میڈیا میں نہیں لا سکتے، طارق فضل چوہدری
stories.summary:
وفاقی وزیر پارلیمانی امور طارق فضل چوہدری نے کہا ہے کہ کابینہ کے ہر فیصلے اور معاملے کو میڈیا کے سامنے لانا ممکن نہیں۔ ایک نجی ٹی وی کے پروگرام میں گفتگو کرتے ہوئے انہوں نے کہا کہ گزشتہ چند دنوں سے دونوں بڑی سیاسی جماعتوں کے رہنما غیر ضروری بیانات دے رہے ہیں۔ انہوں نے مزید واضح کیا کہ مسلم لیگ (ن) نے نئے صوبوں کے قیام سے متعلق اپنا کوئی حتمی موقف تاحال باضابطہ طور پر میڈیا کو جاری نہیں کیا ہے۔

انہوں نے پیپلز پارٹی اور ن لیگ کے درمیان لفظی گولہ باری کا ذکر کرتے ہوئے کہا کہ صدر مملکت اور وزیراعظم کی حالیہ ملاقات کے بعد بہت سے معاملات معمول پر آ چکے ہیں۔ طارق فضل چوہدری نے یقین دہانی کرائی کہ پیپلز پارٹی حکومتی اتحاد کا حصہ رہے گی اور وہ اتحاد سے الگ نہیں ہوگی۔ تاہم انہوں نے اس بات کا بھی اظہار کیا کہ بلاول بھٹو زرداری کو میڈیا پر بیان دینے سے قبل وزیراعظم سے براہ راست رابطہ کرنا چاہیے تھا۔

ملکی سیاسی صورتحال کے اس پس منظر میں دیگر رہنماؤں نے بھی اپنے خیالات کا اظہار کیا ہے۔ وزیر دفاع خواجہ محمد آصف نے اس موقع پر نئے صوبوں کے قیام کے حق میں دلائل دیتے ہوئے کہا کہ دنیا میں نئے انتظامی یونٹس بنتے ہیں اور سیاستدانوں کو اپنے ذاتی خول سے باہر نکلنا ہوگا۔ انہوں نے کہا کہ اس معاملے پر تمام اتحادیوں کے ساتھ سنجیدہ مشاورت کی جا رہی ہے۔

دیگر اہم پیش رفت میں خیبر پختونخوا کے سرکاری پرائمری اسکولوں میں ریڈنگ آور لازم قرار دینے اور کوہاٹ میں سی ٹی ڈی کی کارروائی کے دوران دہشت گردوں کی ہلاکت کی اطلاعات بھی سامنے آئی ہیں۔ وفاقی وزیر خزانہ محمد اورنگزیب نے عوام کو سستی بجلی کی فراہمی کو اولین ترجیح قرار دیا ہے۔

stories.title: خیبر پختونخوا کے پرائمری اسکولوں میں روزانہ ایک گھنٹہ ریڈنگ لازمی قرار
stories.summary:
خیبر پختونخوا حکومت نے صوبے بھر کے تمام سرکاری پرائمری اسکولوں میں روزانہ ایک گھنٹہ ریڈنگ آور لازمی قرار دے دیا ہے۔ پشاور سے جاری ہونے والے سرکاری نوٹیفیکیشن کے مطابق مڈل، ہائی اور ہائیر سیکنڈری اسکولوں کے پرائمری سیکشنز میں بھی مطالعے کے لیے ایک گھنٹہ مختص کیا جائے گا۔ سرکاری اعلامیے کے مطابق اس اقدام کا بنیادی مقصد بچوں میں پڑھنے کی مہارت کو بہتر بنانا اور طلبہ کو منشیات اور تمباکو نوشی جیسی مضر عادات سے محفوظ رکھنا ہے۔

دوسری جانب وزیر دفاع خواجہ محمد آصف نے اپنے ایک بیان میں کہا ہے کہ لوگوں کو اپنی ذات کے خول سے باہر نکلنا چاہیے کیونکہ دنیا میں نئے صوبے بنتے رہتے ہیں۔ اس دوران قانون نافذ کرنے والے اداروں نے کوہاٹ میں کارروائی کرتے ہوئے فتنہ الخوارج کے تین دہشت گردوں کو ہلاک کر دیا جبکہ ان کے ساتھی فرار ہونے میں کامیاب ہو گئے۔ پولیس کے مطابق گرفتار ملزمان میں جھنگ کا رہائشی ظہیر خان بھی شامل ہے، جبکہ فرحان علی فرار ہو گیا اور دیگر کو حافظ آباد منتقل کیا جا رہا ہے۔

وفاقی وزیر پارلیمانی امور طارق فضل چوہدری نے کہا ہے کہ کابینہ کی ہر بات میڈیا کے سامنے نہیں لائی جا سکتی۔ دریں اثنا، وفاقی وزیر خزانہ سینیٹر محمد اورنگزیب نے زور دیا ہے کہ صارفین کو سستی اور مسابقتی بجلی فراہم کرنا حکومت کی اولین ترجیح ہے۔ وزیراعظم شہباز شریف نے دورہ کرنے والے ترکیہ کے وزیر توانائی الپ ارسلان بیراکتار کے اعزاز میں عشائیہ دیا، جہاں انہوں نے دونوں ممالک کے درمیان تاریخی، دیرینہ اور باہمی اعتماد پر مبنی تعلقات کا اعادہ کیا۔

اس کے علاوہ، خیبر پختونخوا کے مخصوص اضلاع میں غیر حاضر رہنے والے ہیلتھ اسٹاف کے خلاف سخت کارروائی کا فیصلہ بھی کیا گیا ہے۔ سیاسی صورتحال کے حوالے سے پی ٹی آئی رہنما شوکت یوسفزئی کا کہنا ہے کہ بلاول بھٹو کے سچ کے بعد موجودہ پارلیمنٹ کو ختم کر کے فوری طور پر نئے انتخابات کروائے جائیں کیونکہ اب ایوان کی کوئی وقعت نہیں رہی۔ جے یو آئی کے ذرائع کا کہنا ہے کہ کل جماعتی کانفرنس کے معاملے پر پاکستان تحریک انصاف کی پوزیشن اب تک واضح نہیں ہے جبکہ پنجاب میں دیوانی، خاندانی، جائیداد اور ہمسائیگی کے تنازعات کو پنچایت کے ذریعے حل کرنے کی تجویز بھی پیش کی گئی ہے۔

stories.title: پی ٹی آئی اس وقت کوئی نئی لڑائی میں نہ پڑے، شوکت یوسفزئی
stories.summary:
پاکستان تحریک انصاف خیبر پختونخوا کے سیکریٹری اطلاعات شوکت یوسفزئی نے بیان دیا ہے کہ اس وقت ان کی جماعت کے پاس کوئی سیاسی اسپیس موجود نہیں ہے لہذا اسے کسی بھی نئی لڑائی میں نہیں پڑنا چاہیے۔ انہوں نے کہا کہ اس وقت کٹھ پتلیوں کا تماشہ جاری ہے اور وہ صرف تماشا ہی دیکھ سکتے ہیں۔ شوکت یوسفزئی نے یہ بھی مطالبہ کیا کہ بلاول بھٹو کے سچ کے بعد پارلیمنٹ کو تحلیل کر کے نئے انتخابات کا انعقاد کیا جائے کیونکہ شفاف الیکشن کے بغیر پارلیمنٹ کی کوئی حیثیت باقی نہیں رہتی۔

نئے صوبوں کے قیام کے معاملے پر گفتگو کرتے ہوئے پی ٹی آئی رہنما نے مؤقف اختیار کیا کہ اس سے کوئی تباہی نہیں آئے گی بلکہ انتظامی یونٹ جتنے چھوٹے ہوں گے کارکردگی اتنی ہی بہتر ہوگی۔ انہوں نے مثال دی کہ ڈی جی خان اور بھکر کے عوام کے حالات آج بھی انتہائی خراب ہیں اور صرف لاہور کو پورا پنجاب نہیں سمجھا جا سکتا۔ اس ضمن میں وزیر دفاع خواجہ محمد آصف نے بھی رائے دی کہ لوگوں کو اپنی ذات کے خول سے باہر نکلنا چاہیے کیونکہ دنیا میں نئے صوبے بنتے رہتے ہیں۔

دوسری جانب قانون نافذ کرنے والے اداروں نے کوہاٹ میں ایک کامیاب کارروائی کے دوران فتنہ الخوارج کے تین دہشت گردوں کو ہلاک کر دیا جبکہ ان کے متعدد ساتھی موقع سے فرار ہو گئے۔ پولیس کے مطابق گرفتار ملزمان میں جھنگ کا رہائشی ظہیر خان بھی شامل ہے جبکہ ایک ملزم فرحان علی فرار ہو گیا اور دیگر کو حافظ آباد منتقل کیا جا رہا ہے۔ دریں اثنا، خیبر پختونخوا حکومت نے تمام سرکاری پرائمری اسکولوں میں روزانہ ایک گھنٹہ ریڈنگ آور لازمی قرار دے دیا ہے تاکہ طلبہ کی مطالعہ کی صلاحیت کو نکھارا جا سکے۔

دیگر خبروں میں، وفاقی وزیر پارلیمانی امور طارق فضل چوہدری نے کہا کہ کابینہ کے تمام معاملات میڈیا میں نشر یا زیر بحث نہیں لائے جا سکتے۔ وفاقی وزیر خزانہ سینیٹر محمد اورنگزیب نے کہا کہ عام صارفین کو سستی اور مسابقتی بجلی فراہم کرنا ان کی حکومت کی اولین ترجیح ہے۔ اس کے علاوہ وزیراعظم شہباز شریف نے ترکیہ کے وزیر توانائی الپ ارسلان بیراکتار کے اعزاز میں عشائیہ دیا اور دونوں ممالک کے مابین تاریخی اور برادرانہ تعلقات کو مزید مضبوط بنانے کے عزم کا اظہار کیا۔

stories.title: صارفین کو سستی اور مسابقتی بجلی فراہم کرنا اولین ترجیح ہے، وزیر خزانہ
stories.summary:
وفاقی وزیر خزانہ سینیٹر محمد اورنگزیب نے پاور سیکٹر کی ریگولیٹری اصلاحات سے متعلق ایک اہم اجلاس سے خطاب کرتے ہوئے کہا ہے کہ صارفین کو سستی اور مسابقتی بجلی فراہم کرنا حکومت کی اولین ترجیح ہے۔ انہوں نے واضح کیا کہ ان تمام اصلاحات کا بنیادی مقصد بجلی کی پیداواری لاگت میں کمی لانا ہے تاکہ توانائی کے شعبے کو درپیش موجودہ چیلنجز سے احسن طریقے سے نمٹا جا سکے۔ اجلاس کے اعلامیے کے مطابق پاور سیکٹر میں ایک شفاف اور قابل پیشگوئی ریگولیٹری نظام متعارف کرانے کے ساتھ ساتھ بجلی کی تقسیم کے دوران ہونے والے نقصانات کم کرنے والے اداروں کو مراعات دینے کی تجاویز پر بھی غور کیا گیا ہے۔

اجلاس کے دوران سولرائزیشن اور بیٹری اسٹوریج کے ذریعے بجلی کی مارکیٹ میں لائی جانے والی تبدیلیوں کا تفصیلی جائزہ بھی لیا گیا۔ شرکاء کو بتایا گیا کہ بجلی کی اضافی پیداوار اور کم طلب کی وجہ سے کیپیسٹی پیمنٹس کا مالی دباؤ مسلسل بڑھ رہا ہے۔ اس تناظر میں بجلی صارفین پر سے کیپیسٹی پیمنٹس کا اضافی بوجھ ہٹانے اور ایک مسابقتی بجلی مارکیٹ تشکیل دینے کے لیے موجودہ معاہدوں میں ضروری ترجیحی تبدیلیاں کرنے کی تجاویز زیر غور آئیں۔ اس کے علاوہ مسابقتی سپلائرز کو بجلی کے نرخ خود مقرر کرنے میں مزید لچک دینے کی تجویز بھی پیش کی گئی۔

ملکی سلامتی کے حوالے سے، کاؤنٹر ٹیررازم ڈیپارٹمنٹ (سی ٹی ڈی) اور پولیس نے کوہاٹ میں ایک مشترکہ کارروائی کے دوران فتنہ الخوارج کے تین دہشت گردوں کو ہلاک کر دیا جبکہ ان کے دیگر ساتھی فرار ہو گئے۔ پولیس کے مطابق اس کارروائی میں جھنگ کے رہائشی ظہیر خان سمیت کچھ ملزمان کو گرفتار کیا گیا ہے جنہیں حافظ آباد منتقل کیا جا رہا ہے، جبکہ فرحان علی نامی ملزم فرار ہونے میں کامیاب ہو گیا۔ تعلیمی شعبے میں بہتری لاتے ہوئے خیبر پختونخوا کے تمام سرکاری پرائمری اسکولوں میں روزانہ ایک گھنٹہ ریڈنگ آور لازمی قرار دیا گیا ہے۔

سیاسی اور سفارتی محاذ پر، وفاقی وزیر پارلیمانی امور طارق فضل چوہدری نے کہا ہے کہ کابینہ کے ہر فیصلے کو میڈیا کے سامنے لانا ممکن نہیں۔ وزیراعظم شہباز شریف نے ترکیہ کے وزیر توانائی الپ ارسلان بیراکتار کے اعزاز میں دیے گئے عشائیے سے خطاب کرتے ہوئے ترکیہ کے ساتھ تاریخی، دیرینہ اور باہمی اعتماد پر مبنی تعلقات کو سراہا۔ دریں اثنا، پی ٹی آئی رہنما شوکت یوسفزئی نے پارلیمنٹ میں نئے انتخابات کا مطالبہ کیا ہے جبکہ جے یو آئی کے ذرائع نے بتایا ہے کہ کل جماعتی کانفرنس پر پی ٹی آئی کا موقف تاحال مبہم ہے۔

stories.title: Central Bank of Pakistan Inject Over Rs 13.5 Trillion for Liquidity
stories.summary:
The Central Bank of Pakistan has supplied more than Rs 13.5 trillion into money markets to maintain liquidity and prevent cash shortages across commercial banks. This multi-trillion rupee mechanism enables financial institutions to process transactions smoothly, settle everyday funding demands, and avert sudden liquidity freezes within the national banking network.

In a dynamic financial ecosystem, daily deposit flows, payment transfers, and changing market demands create continuous fluctuations in cash reserves. Without routine central bank interventions, unexpected liquidity tightening can trigger short-term spikes in borrowing costs and spill over into ordinary interbank transactions. Regular liquidity management by the State Bank of Pakistan (SBP) minimizes these pressures while reinforcing broader confidence throughout the country's financial sector.

A stable and adequately resourced banking environment protects businesses and market participants from sudden credit shocks, ensuring the foundational framework of the economy operates without disruption. For treasury desks and corporate entities monitoring domestic borrowing conditions, this massive capital infusion highlights the central bank's vital role as a stabilizing anchor for the market's future trajectory.

Separately, cybersecurity firm Kaspersky revealed during the Cyber Threat Intelligence Summit 2026 in Islamabad that Pakistan encountered over 9.4 million device and web-based cyberattacks over the past year. The data indicated a 50 percent surge in backdoor attacks, drawing attention to mounting digital threats facing local organizations and supply chains.

stories.title: Kate Middleton Shares First Public Statement Following Visit to India
stories.summary:
Kensington Palace has published Princess Kate Middleton's first public remarks since she and Prince William concluded a three-day official tour of India. The royal visit, which ended on Wednesday, November 18, focused on advancing UK-India relations and participating in the sixth annual Earthshot Prize awards ceremony.

Following their return, 45-year-old Catherine pursued her dedication to early childhood development in her capacity as patron of the Centre for Early Childhood. She undertook a solo engagement at Nowrosjee Wadia Maternity Hospital in Mumbai on World Children's Day, where she interacted with new mothers and newborns to discuss childcare and family life. Meanwhile, Prince William visited Dharma Productions, a prominent Bollywood studio founded by Karan Johar, meeting film personalities such as Saif Ali Khan and Kareena Kapoor.

To commemorate World Children's Day 2026, Kensington Palace shared an Instagram carousel featuring four images highlighting tender moments between mothers and their babies at the Mumbai hospital. Accompanying the post was a statement emphasizing that every child deserves an optimal start in life while commending mothers, infants, and healthcare staff for working toward a healthier future.

The public message follows the return of the Prince and Princess of Wales to their full-time royal duties alongside their three children—Prince George, 8, Princess Charlotte, 6, and Prince Louis, 3—as well as Kate's gradual resumption of her involvement in Prince William's environmental initiative after nearly three years.

In a separate development, cybersecurity firm Kaspersky reported at the Cyber Threat Intelligence Summit 2026 in Islamabad that Pakistan experienced more than 9.4 million device and web-based cyberattacks over the past year, noting a 50 percent rise in backdoor threats.

stories.title: Bilawal Bhutto Zardari Expresses Support for Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif's Full Term
stories.summary:
Pakistan Peoples Party (PPP) Chairman Bilawal Bhutto Zardari recently stated in Karachi that he wants Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif to become the first premier in Pakistan's history to complete a full five-year constitutional term. Speaking at a ceremony, Bilawal noted that he had previously helped Shehbaz Sharif secure the prime minister's office twice and contributed to collective efforts to prevent the country from defaulting.

According to the PPP chairman, Prime Minister Shehbaz has not been given a proper opportunity to execute his economic agenda, unify political parties, or establish a joint strategy due to interference from other ministers. Bilawal emphasized that Pakistan is currently enduring a historic and severe economic crisis, arguing that solving this economic emergency should remain the absolute priority for all politicians and rulers rather than political egos.

Addressing political opposition, Bilawal remarked that he believes in principles rather than ego-driven politics, noting that he could have pushed for harsher pressure on PTI founder Imran Khan if he operated differently. Instead, he advocated for broad political consultations, suggesting that figures like Imran Khan and Maulana Fazal ur Rehman should be engaged despite opposing views.

Bilawal clarified that Prime Minister Shehbaz is entirely free to accept or reject his political suggestions. He reiterated that successfully resolving Pakistan's complex problems requires cooperation beyond just one or two political parties working together.

stories.title: Sophie Cunningham Criticizes Viral Courtside Outfits at Clippers and Thunder Game
stories.summary:
During a thrilling 113-112 basketball game where the Los Angeles Clippers narrowly defeated the Oklahoma City Thunder, online attention shifted toward a courtside controversy involving internet influencers Brittany Renner and Celina Powell. The duo wore matching, highly revealing outfits that quickly drew significant backlash across the internet, with many spectators and observers arguing that such attire was inappropriate for a family-friendly sports environment.

The incident soon became a topic of discussion on the "No Hesitation" podcast hosted by Indiana Fever guard Sophie Cunningham and trainer Drew Hanlen. Cunningham addressed the event by framing it around broader themes of public awareness, venue atmosphere, and respect for surrounding audiences rather than launching a personal attack on the women.

Cunningham explained that while she does not wish to police personal clothing choices, the outfits crossed a boundary in a public setting filled with young children and families, causing unnecessary distraction from the game. She questioned the underlying message of wearing such revealing clothes in a live crowd, suggesting that the individuals would likely frequent nightclubs regardless of their attire.

The public appearance ultimately served as publicity for the Zeus Network and the live-streaming reality series "Toxic Twins," which stars Renner and Powell and premiered just days later. While sports figures like Jason Whitlock also criticized the promotion, the exact impact on subscriber numbers remains uncertain, marking the event as a clear example of stunt-based internet publicity.

stories.title: Middle Powers Forge New Alliances as Trump Meets Xi and Putin in Shenzhen
stories.summary:
As United States President Donald Trump focused on great power diplomacy during the APEC leaders' summit in Shenzhen, key US allies Canada and Japan looked beyond Washington to forge alternative economic and security partnerships. Trump met with Chinese leader Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin at a lakeside villa, boasting that the gathering of the three nuclear-armed powers was bigger than the historic 1945 Yalta conference. Alejandro Reyes from the University of Hong Kong noted the unique symbolism of the meeting.

To navigate around US tariffs and Chinese trade restrictions, middle powers are actively de-risking their supply chains away from both superpowers, according to Fudan University expert Zhao Minghao. Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney concluded free-trade talks with the Philippines, advanced economic pacts with ASEAN, and extended a tariff deal with Xi in Shenzhen that grants relief on C$400 million in Canadian goods, such as pork and prawns, in exchange for lower barriers on specific Chinese metals.

Simultaneously, Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi traveled to Manila to secure new critical mineral supplies, strengthen supply chain and energy cooperation with South Korea, and adopt a joint economic resilience statement with ASEAN. Japan is also diversifying its defense and technology ties by partnering with European nations like Britain, Italy, and France.

Japan continues to rely heavily on US military protection to deter threats from its nuclear-armed neighbors, but Trump's warm reception of Xi raised concerns in Tokyo regarding long-term American reliability. A senior Japanese official noted that Japan must act by its own strength as a middle power, a sentiment echoed by Narushige Michishita from the National Graduate Institute for Policy Studies regarding the growing necessity of multilateral middle-power cooperation.

stories.title: Punjab Police Team Attacked in Karachi During Suspect Arrest Operation
stories.summary:
A violent confrontation erupted in Karachi when a visiting Punjab police team came under fire during an operation in Khadim Solangi Goth, located near the Super Highway area. The shooting resulted in the death of one person and left a Punjab police Assistant Sub-Inspector with a leg injury.

According to the Sohrab Goth Deputy Superintendent of Police, the officers had traveled from Multan to Karachi to apprehend a wanted suspect. However, local authorities confirmed that the visiting team failed to inform the local police station or make any official entry regarding their intended operation prior to conducting it.

The deceased individual was identified as 35-year-old Hamza, while the wounded police officer, ASI Asghar, was promptly taken for medical treatment and listed as out of danger. Law enforcement officials have since sealed off the surrounding area to search for the individuals responsible for the gunfire.

Following the deadly incident, the East District police initiated a formal investigation into the circumstances surrounding the shooting and the unannounced raid conducted by the out-of-province police personnel.

stories.title: Sri Lanka Invites Pakistani Exporters to Tap $19 Billion Market
stories.summary:
Sri Lanka is actively encouraging Pakistani business representatives to increase shipments to its nearly $19 billion import market by utilizing the countries' bilateral Free Trade Agreement. The initiative was discussed during a meeting between Sri Lankan Consul General Sanjeewa Pattiwilla and industrialists at the SITE Association of Industry in Karachi, as detailed in an official statement from the association. During the gathering, the envoy emphasized that both nations have historically taken advantage of the Generalised Scheme of Preferences and GSP+ market access, while possessing mutual export strengths in areas like construction goods, pharmaceuticals, and garments. Woven fabrics from Pakistan currently serve as a crucial supply for apparel producers in Sri Lanka who ship goods to the European Union, and multiple Pakistani firms already operate manufacturing plants within the island nation.

Agricultural prospects were also a major focus of the discussions, with the Consul General noting that his government permits up to 6,000 metric tonnes of rice imports from Pakistan, where Basmati varieties are increasingly favored. Additionally, recurring business prospects open up as the Sri Lankan administration launches tenders for rice purchases every half-year. To further bridge commercial ties, Pattiwilla encouraged Pakistani entrepreneurs to attend the Sri Lanka Expo 2027 planned for January 2027, and he welcomed a suggestion to coordinate a visit by a Pakistani business delegation to pinpoint specific commercial collaborations. Addressing inquiries from SITE Association president Abdul Hadi, the diplomat underscored the significance of driving both incoming and outgoing trade, noting rising maritime traffic at the ports of Colombo and Karachi, and agreed to pursue measures to ease cement imports from Pakistan.

Abdul Hadi noted during the welcome address that textiles make up the bulk of exchanges between the two nations, making Pakistan the second-biggest trading partner for Sri Lanka inside the SAARC region. Hadi advocated for pushing the total bilateral trade volume past the $500 million mark, pledging that his organization would serve as a bridge for commercial entities. Other industry figures raised specific challenges during the meeting, such as Nadeem Polani addressing the hurdles new traders encounter with Sri Lankan tenders, the ongoing burden of expensive freight charges, and the necessity of expanding textile market access. Junaid-ur-Rehman pointed out the importance of eliminating non-tariff obstacles and mentioned Pakistan's strengths in surgical instruments, pharmaceuticals, and textiles, while also suggesting initiatives to draw more tourists to Pakistan. Furthermore, former SITE Association president Majyd Aziz recommended reviewing the FTA, active since June 2005, to enhance its efficacy, and suggested establishing sister-port ties between Karachi's ports and Colombo Port.

stories.title: Pakistani Minister Visits New Delhi for SCO Cultural Dialogue Forum
stories.summary:
Federal Minister for Climate Change Dr Musadik Malik arrived in New Delhi on Friday to lead Pakistan's delegation at the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) Civilisational Dialogue Forum. Received by Pakistan's Chargé d'Affaires upon arrival, Malik is attending the event at the invitation of India's Minister of Culture and Tourism to discuss shared heritage, cultural ties, and regional cooperation among member states.

This visit marks the first trip to India by a Pakistani federal minister since May 2023, when then foreign minister Bilawal Bhutto-Zardari visited Goa for an SCO foreign ministers meeting. The current dialogue takes place against a backdrop of diplomatic strain between Pakistan and India, which have remained in a stalemate following a military confrontation in May 2025 and a deadly incident in Indian Illegally Occupied Jammu and Kashmir.

During the forum, Malik will present Pakistan's perspective on the importance of inter-civilisational dialogue and highlight the country's constructive role within the SCO. The Pakistani delegation is scheduled to participate in thematic sessions and interact with representatives from other member states on the sidelines of the event.

Pakistan is currently chairing the SCO Council of Heads of State for the 2026-27 period, a role in which it will host various ministerial and expert group meetings ahead of the upcoming summit. The Foreign Office noted that participation in the forum reflects Islamabad's ongoing commitment to promoting regional understanding under the Shanghai Spirit.

stories.title: Government Identifies Corruption Risks Across Ten Institutions in Self-Accountability Drive
stories.summary:
Law Minister Azam Nazeer Tarar announced on Friday that the federal government has uncovered weaknesses that could create corruption opportunities across ten institutions through a survey titled the National Risk Assessment of Corruption Vulnerabilities. Speaking in a televised message, Tarar clarified that the report is not a charge sheet but rather an identification of structural flaws intended to be fixed through reforms promoting merit and transparency.

The Ministry of Law and Justice coordinated with multiple agencies and institutions to compile the findings, which evaluated vulnerabilities using various indicators. Tarar asserted that no previous government has undertaken such an effort and confirmed that the resulting survey will be shared with international organizations. He explained that the ten institutions subjected to deep examination were chosen due to operational characteristics, specifically financial activities that present elevated risks for corrupt practices.

Highlighting other governance measures, the law minister pointed to positive steps taken by Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif regarding electricity and energy sector reforms. Through extensive coordination with relevant departments, the government executed a lengthy review process to tackle underlying structural problems in the energy sector.

As an outcome of these targeted policy reforms, the federal government anticipates saving Rs3,500 billion within the energy and electricity sectors. Tarar presented these systemic updates as part of a broader push toward internal governance overhaul and institutional accountability at the federal level.

stories.title: خیبر پختونخوا کے 13 اضلاع میں 1623 غیر حاضر طبی اہلکاروں کیخلاف کارروائی کا فیصلہ
stories.summary:
خیبر پختونخوا کے تیرہ مخصوص اضلاع میں محکمہ صحت کے ایک ہزار چھ سو تئیس اہلکاروں کی غیر حاضری کا انکشاف ہوا ہے، جس کے بعد ان کے خلاف سخت کارروائی کرنے کا فیصلہ کیا گیا ہے۔ ایریا ڈیولپمنٹ سیکریٹریٹ کی جاری کردہ رپورٹ کے مطابق ان غیر حاضر ملازمین کے خلاف ضوابط اور متعلقہ سروس رولز کے تحت کارروائی عمل میں لائی جائے گی۔ اس ضمن میں متعلقہ اضلاع سے ڈیوٹی سے غیر حاضری پر واضح جواب بھی طلب کیا گیا ہے۔

رپورٹ کے اعداد و شمار کے مطابق سب سے زیادہ غیر حاضری ضلع لکی مروت میں پانچ سو اٹھاون ریکارڈ کی گئی ہے۔ اس کے علاوہ مہمند میں چار سو دس، بنوں میں دو سو آٹھ، ڈیرہ اسماعیل خان میں ایک سو بیس اور شمالی وزیرستان میں ایک سو ایک طبی اہلکار ڈیوٹی سے غائب پائے گئے۔ مزید برآں، خیبر میں پچانومی، اپر جنوبی وزیرستان میں نواسی، ٹانک میں ستাত্তর، لوئر وسطی کرم میں اڑسٹھ، اورکزئی میں تینتالیس، اپر کرم میں بتیس، لوئر جنوبی وزیرستان میں اٹھارہ اور باجوڑ میں چار طبی عملے کے ارکان کی غیر حاضری سامنے آئی ہے۔

ایریا ڈیولپمنٹ سیکریٹریٹ کا اس حوالے سے کہنا ہے کہ مخصوص اضلاع میں فرائض سے غفلت اور نااہلی کو کسی صورت برداشت نہیں کیا جائے گا۔ محکمہ صحت کے ان غفلت برتنے والے اہلکاروں سے بازپرس شروع کر دی گئی ہے تاکہ علاقے کے طبی نظام کو بہتر بنایا جا سکے۔ یہ اقدام صوبے کے پسماندہ اور مخصوص اضلاع میں صحت کی سہولیات کو فعال کرنے اور ملازمین کی حاضری کو یقینی بنانے کے لیے اٹھایا جا رہا ہے۔

stories.title: پاکستان اور ترکیہ کے درمیان توانائی کے شعبے میں تعاون بڑھانے پر اتفاق
stories.summary:
وزیر اعظم شہباز شریف نے ترکیہ کے وزیر توانائی الپ ارسلان بیراکتار کے اعزاز میں ایک خصوصی عشائیہ دیا۔ اس موقع پر گفتگو کرتے ہوئے وزیر اعظم نے دونوں ممالک کے درمیان تاریخی، دیرینہ اور باہمی اعتماد پر مبنی تعلقات کو سراہا۔ انھوں نے ترک تحقیقی بحری جہاز اورچ رئیس کی پاکستان آمد اور آف شور تیل و گیس کی تلاش کے منصوبے میں تعاون پر ترک صدر کا شکریہ ادا کیا۔ وزیر اعظم نے کہا کہ سمندری حدود میں تیل و گیس کے ذخائر کی تلاش ملکی معاشی ترقی اور توانائی کے تحفظ کے لیے انتہائی اہمیت کی حامل ہے۔

ترک وزیر توانائی الپ ارسلان بیراکتار نے تقریب سے خطاب کرتے ہوئے کہا کہ پاکستان اور ترکیہ توانائی کے شعبے میں تعاون کے ایک بالکل نئے دور میں داخل ہو چکے ہیں۔ انھوں نے اس عزم کا اظہار کیا کہ ترکیہ اپنی تمام تر تکنیکی مہارت اور سائنسی تجربات کو پاکستان کے ساتھ مل کر بروئے کار لائے گا۔ ان کا مزید کہنا تھا کہ ترک تحقیقی جہاز سندھ اور مکران کے سمندری علاقوں میں تیل اور گیس کے ذخائر کا پتہ لگانے کے لیے تھری ڈی سیسمک سروے کرے گا، جس سے مستقبل میں ڈرلنگ اور تلاش کے امکانات کا تعین کیا جا سکے گا۔

وزیر اعظم نے اس بات پر بھی زور دیا کہ دونوں برادر ممالک کے مابین معدنیات اور قابلِ تجدید توانائی کے شعبوں میں بھی باہمی تعاون کو وسعت دینے کے وسیع مواقع موجود ہیں۔ حکومت پاکستان ترکیہ کے تجربات سے بھرپور استفادہ کرنا چاہتی ہے تاکہ صارفین کو مسابقتی اور بہتر توانائی فراہم کی جا سکے۔ یہ شراکت داری خطے میں توانائی کے بحران سے نمٹنے اور دوطرفہ اقتصادی تعلقات کو مزید مستحکم کرنے میں مددگار ثابت ہوگی۔

stories.title: German Defence Minister Apologizes for Calling Pentagon Official's Stance Stupid
stories.summary:
German Defence Minister Boris Pistorius stated on Friday that he apologized for describing Pentagon policy chief Elbridge Colby's opposition to Ukrainian deep strikes inside Russia as "stupid," though he maintained he stands by his substantive criticism. The tense exchange occurred earlier in the week at NATO headquarters in Brussels, highlighting a policy rift between Washington and European capitals over Kyiv's military tactics in the nearly five-year war following Moscow's invasion.

Speaking to the Politico news outlet, Pistorius admitted that his choice of words was inappropriate, noting that he should not have used such phrasing during a news conference as a non-native English speaker. He confirmed that he contacted Colby on Wednesday to discuss the fallout, offering an apology for the specific vocabulary used while clarifying that both officials acknowledge they hold differing viewpoints on the strategy.

The controversy arose after Colby criticized long-range Ukrainian strikes during a meeting of the Ramstein Group of military backers, arguing that such attacks have failed to end the conflict or halt Russian front-line advances. Colby warned that strikes targeting civilian and commercial infrastructure, such as warehouses belonging to the Russian firm Wildberries, risk hardening civilian resistance among the Russian population instead of weakening Moscow's resolve.

In contrast, Pistorius argued during his news conference that dismissing strikes on strategic military targets was the wrong approach, emphasizing that international attention should instead focus on nightly Russian attacks targeting Ukrainian water, energy, and heating infrastructure. The Pentagon and Colby did not issue an immediate public comment regarding the minister's apology.

stories.title: Pakistan Shaheens Defeat UAE by 61 Runs in Asia Cup Rising Stars
stories.summary:
The defending champions Pakistan Shaheens secured a 61-run victory against the United Arab Emirates in their opening Group B fixture of the Asia Cup Rising Stars tournament at the University of Doha for Science and Technology on Friday. Batting first, Pakistan Shaheens posted a total of 245 in 46.4 overs. Shamyl Hussain top-scored with a rapid 62 off 39 balls, earning the Player of the Match award, while Maaz Sadaqat contributed 53 runs from 63 deliveries during an 87-run opening partnership. Captain Abdul Samad added 39 runs, Farhan Yousaf scored 28, and Mohammad Imran chipped in with 22. Basil Hameed was the standout bowler for the UAE, capturing four wickets for 37 runs, alongside Awais Ali Shah and Ibrar Ahmad, who took two wickets each.

In response, the UAE team was bowled out for 184 in 40.5 overs as the Pakistan Shaheens bowlers controlled the chase. Fast bowler Ali Raza made early breakthroughs by dismissing three top-order batters, leaving the UAE struggling at 16 for three within the first six overs. Mohammad Shahdad led the scoring for the UAE with 45 runs off 60 balls, followed by Aftab Alam with 39 and Awais Ali Shah with 32. This victory marks a strong start to the title defense for Pakistan Shaheens, who are scheduled to play their next match against arch-rivals India on Sunday, November 22.

stories.title: Big Pharma Embraces Artificial Intelligence to Accelerate Drug Discovery Timelines
stories.summary:
Major global pharmaceutical companies, including GSK, Bristol Myers Squibb, Novartis, Eli Lilly, Novo Nordisk, AstraZeneca, and Sanofi, report that artificial intelligence has accelerated early-stage drug development this year. Scientists from these firms indicate that AI has cut the time required to produce new molecules and advance them into clinical testing by up to half. Companies are utilizing the technology beyond routine tasks like regulatory filings, employing it instead to design molecules, prioritize promising candidates, and identify safety risks. Specific milestones include Sanofi saving at least a year on the asthma treatment lunsekimig, Novartis identifying five priority targets for kidney disease treatments, and Novo Nordisk reducing design-to-testing cycles from eight to three.

This trend coincides with artificial intelligence lab Anthropic entering the space and launching its $1.5 trillion initial public offering, alongside introducing scientific research software called Claude Science. While Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei and other tech figures suggest AI could drastically speed up finding cures, representatives from traditional pharmaceutical companies urge caution. Industry experts note that historical figures show nearly 9 out of 10 conventionally developed drugs fail in clinical trials, and developing a drug typically takes 10 to 15 years while costing billions. Although some pharmaceutical leaders view Anthropic as a collaborator or potential partner, others regard the lab as a competitor, noting that proprietary internal data remains essential for training effective models.

Researchers compile data showing that the number of AI-enabled drug candidates in clinical testing is climbing incrementally, reaching 129 candidates across 69 companies in March. Most of these programs remain in early-stage development, and experts predict a sharp uptick in pre-clinical and clinical AI drugs over the next one to three years. However, scientists emphasize that human trial bottlenecks and regulatory requirements mean these medications may not necessarily gain approval any faster than traditional drugs. Leading researchers estimate that AI could reduce early-discovery timelines by 20% to 25% within two years, and potentially by half within five years, across a growing number of development programs.

stories.title: JI Chief Hafiz Naeem Criticizes Political Parties and Current System
stories.summary:
Jamaat-e-Islami Pakistan Ameer Hafiz Naeem ur Rehman has criticized major political parties, including the Pakistan Peoples Party, accusing them of prioritizing personal interests despite public differences. Speaking at a Friday gathering at Jamia Masjid Mansoorah in Lahore, the JI chief specifically targeted Bilawal Bhutto Zardari, stating that he helped topple the PTI government and is now expressing worry over the ongoing political situation. Hafiz Naeem pointed out that a PPP governor remains in place in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa amid discussions of emergency and Governor's Rule, asserting that these political factions continue to work together.

Addressing the nation's religious and political framework, Hafiz Naeem argued that the existing system contradicts the commands of Allah and should be abolished. He stated that religion encompasses a complete system of justice and fairness rather than a few basic issues, adding that a society plagued by injustice and disorder cannot qualify as a religious system. He highlighted that citizens across Sindh, Balochistan, and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa face serious hardships, ranging from financial disputes and demands for new provinces to poor law and order in Balochistan, where Jamaat-e-Islami continues its activities despite security challenges.

The JI leader also shared findings from his party's committee on petroleum matters, claiming they uncovered multiple cases of corruption. He questioned the banking sector's fairness, noting that interest rates stand at 12 percent while account holders receive only 5.6 percent, with 40 percent of bank funds held in non-interest-bearing current accounts. He alleged that a cartel of mafias persists regardless of who holds government power and announced upcoming public gatherings for Jamaat-e-Islami in Quetta on November 22 and at Minar-e-Pakistan on November 29.

stories.title: Protesters in San Francisco Demonstrate Against AI Lab Anthropic Following IPO
stories.summary:
Roughly a hundred demonstrators gathered in front of Anthropic’s San Francisco offices on Thursday to protest the artificial intelligence lab's race toward advanced models, coinciding with the company's initial public offering. Chanting slogans such as "Ban RSI, we don’t want to die," the protesters targeted recursive self-improvement, a process where advanced AI models autonomously create newer versions of themselves, which critics fear could lead to catastrophic outcomes. Participants included retired librarian Tarnel Abbott, researcher Emily Tan, and Jacob Coxon, a former Anthropic researcher whose resignation in September over AI safety warnings drew widespread attention.

Protesters and former tech employees expressed skepticism regarding whether Anthropic can maintain its stated values of prioritizing safety over profits under pressure from shareholders demanding growth and returns. Daniel Kokotajlo, a former employee of rival lab OpenAI who joined the protest, criticized the rationale among tech workers that they must build advanced systems first to prevent rivals or foreign competitors from doing so. While many demonstrators acknowledged that they find AI tools helpful, they argued that the technology is advancing too rapidly without sufficient safeguards, following the release of an open letter signed by various researchers, entrepreneurs, and academics accusing Anthropic of unsafe practices.

The demonstration also drew a sole counter-protester, 31-year-old activist blogger Barak Gila, who held a sign thanking Anthropic for the technology and its local economic impact. While Anthropic has completed what is reported as a record-breaking market debut and raised substantial capital, the company has not yet reached the recursive self-improvement stage. Anthropic did not respond to requests for comment regarding its acquisition plans or its ongoing relationships with major pharmaceutical and tech partners.

stories.title: Liverpool Manager Iraola Wary of Pochettino's Tactics Ahead of Clash
stories.summary:
Liverpool manager Andoni Iraola has expressed concerns that newly appointed Manchester United boss Mauricio Pochettino holds a tactical advantage ahead of their upcoming match at Anfield. Pochettino is taking charge of United for the first time since departing his role as the USA national team coach to succeed the dismissed Michael Carrick. Because the former Tottenham and Chelsea manager has had limited time with his new squad, Iraola admitted he lacks references to properly prepare for United's potential strategies on Sunday.

To counter the uncertainty, Iraola stated that his team must adapt quickly on the fly, particularly during the early stages of the game, and adjust their game-plan if necessary.
