متاثرہ بچی کو تشویشناک حالت میں اسلام آباد کے قائداعظم ہسپتال منتقل کیا گیا تھا لیکن وہ جانبر نہ ہو سکی۔ تفتیشی ٹیم کے مطابق مقتولہ کے والدین مذکورہ پولیس افسر کی رحیم یار خان میں واقع زمینوں پر کام کرتے ہیں۔ ملزمہ کے شوہر اس وقت وفاقی تحقیقاتی ادارے (ایف آئی اے) میں گوجرانوالہ ریجن میں بطور ڈائریکٹر خدمات انجام دے رہے ہیں۔ اس مقدمے میں گرفتار دوسرا ملزم قاری علی پنجاب ہائی ویز پٹرولنگ میں تعینات سرکاری ملازم ہے۔

پوسٹ مارٹم رپورٹ کے مطابق فاطمہ کی موت بار بار کیے جانے والے جسمانی تشدد کے نتیجے میں لگنے والی شدید چوٹوں سے ہوئی۔ ڈاکٹروں نے سر کے پچھلے حصے میں سوجن، چہرے، بازوؤں اور ٹانگوں پر نیل اور استری سے جلائے جانے کے نشانات کی تصدیق کی ہے۔ اسلام آباد پولیس کے حکام کا کہنا ہے کہ واقعے کے ہر پہلو سے شفاف تحقیقات کی جا رہی ہیں اور پوسٹ مارٹم رپورٹ کی روشنی میں مزید قانونی کارروائی عمل میں لائی جائے گی۔

stories.title: Gold prices decline sharply across Pakistan following international market trends
stories.summary:
Gold prices in Pakistan experienced a significant drop on Friday, mirroring losses observed in the global market. According to the All-Pakistan Gems and Jewellers Sarafa Association, the local price of gold per tola fell by Rs15,400, settling at Rs379,836. 

Additionally, the cost of 10-gram gold decreased by Rs13,203 to reach Rs325,648. This downturn follows a previous decline on Thursday, when the per-tola gold price had dropped by Rs3,700 to reach Rs395,236.

Globally, the international rate of gold fell by $154, bringing the price down to $3,573 per ounce. Alongside the precious metal, the price of silver in the domestic market also saw a reduction, dropping by Rs297 to reach Rs4,708 per tola.

stories.title: Karachi faces worsening wheat crisis and potential flour mill closures
stories.summary:
Karachi's wheat crisis has escalated significantly, creating widespread concerns over potential flour shortages and the prospective shutdown of local flour mills. This situation stems from an ongoing deadlock between the Sindh Food Department and flour millers regarding the retail cost of flour milled from government-imported wheat.

While imported wheat has begun arriving at mills for Rs5,000 per bag, agreement on flour pricing remains out of reach. Flour mill representatives have proposed supplying flour made from government wheat at Rs146 per kilogram, whereas the Sindh government insists on a capped price of Rs140 per kilogram. Negotiations between the Food Department and millers have failed to produce a consensus.

Flour mill representative Malik Iqbal noted that mills in Karachi are currently collecting imported wheat directly from Karachi Port, while mills in interior Sindh await government wheat shipments despite issued permits. Meanwhile, an open-market wheat shortage has enabled profiteers to charge arbitrary rates, worsening conditions.

The Flour Mills Association warned that the supply-demand gap has reached a critical stage and cautioned that mills may shut down completely if supplies are not secured. The association has urged the government to ensure continuous distribution and permit private sector imports to avert further deterioration before December.

stories.title: Ringleader pleads guilty to record $100 million California jewellery heist
stories.summary:
The ringleader of a notorious highway robbery gang pleaded guilty to a federal charge in connection with the theft of approximately $100 million in jewellery from an armoured vehicle in California five years ago. The incident stands as the largest jewellery heist in United States history.

The defendant, 33-year-old Ecuadorean national Carlos Victor Mestanza Cercado, entered his guilty plea to a single felony count of interference with commerce by robbery under an agreement with prosecutors. Arrested two years ago during a flight layover in Panama, Mestanza was among seven individuals indicted for the July 11, 2022, robbery of a Brink's truck at a Kern County rest stop north of Los Angeles. The vehicle was transporting 73 sacks of precious gems, fine gold, diamonds, rubies, emeralds, and luxury watches from a San Francisco Bay area exhibition to a Southern California storage facility.

Authorities stated that Mestanza and his accomplices trailed the shipment across 380 miles using multiple vehicles and cellphones to coordinate. They breached the locks of the parked armoured truck and escaped with 24 bags of valuables. In exchange for his guilty plea, prosecutors dropped several other charges against Mestanza, and his sentencing is scheduled for April 15, carrying a maximum penalty of 20 years in prison.

Beyond the major jewellery theft, Mestanza also admitted involvement in the March 2022 highway robberies of trucks transporting electronics. Among his co-defendants, three are scheduled for trial in March 2027, two remain at large, and one has been deported. It remains unclear whether any of the stolen jewellery has been recovered.

stories.title: Former federal minister Liaquat Abbas Bhatti murdered in Hafizabad home
stories.summary:
Former federal minister Liaquat Abbas Bhatti was found murdered inside his room near Kasoki Bypass in Hafizabad, with local police reporting that he was strangled to death. An initial medical examination indicated clear marks of strangulation caused by a rope around his neck.

A murder and robbery case has been filed at the City Police Station following a complaint by the victim's nephew, Member of the Provincial Assembly Zameer-ul-Hassan Bhatti. The First Information Report names more than 10 suspects, including four of the former minister's personal security guards, who allegedly carried out the strangulation before fleeing the scene.

According to police reports, the perpetrators also stole 50 tolas of gold jewellery, Rs2 million in cash, weapons, and three luxury vehicles belonging to the deceased. District Police Officer Fawad Ahmed stated that specialized police teams have been deployed to track down and arrest all individuals connected to the crime.

Liaquat Abbas Bhatti had a prominent political career, having previously served twice as a Member of the National Assembly and once as a Member of the Provincial Assembly.

stories.title: Field Marshal Munir Visits North Waziristan to Review Regional Security
stories.summary:
Field Marshal Syed Asim Munir, Chief of Army Staff and Chief of Defence Forces, travelled to Miran Shah in North Waziristan on Friday to evaluate the ongoing security conditions and counterterrorism operations in the region. Upon arriving, he placed a floral wreath at the Yadgar-e-Shuhada to honor soldiers who lost their lives while performing their official duties. During the visit, the army chief was given a comprehensive briefing regarding the local security framework, intelligence-based operations, and the strategies being implemented to preserve hard-earned counterterrorism gains and secure lasting stability.

During his time in the area, Field Marshal Munir interacted directly with military officers and troops, commending their professional readiness, high morale, and dedication to safeguarding the nation. He specifically lauded the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Police, characterizing them as a courageous frontline unit and expressing admiration for their resilience and sacrifices in combating terrorism throughout the province. He reiterated that security forces, working alongside other law enforcement agencies, remain fully committed to eradicating terrorism and preserving peace.

The high-ranking military official was officially greeted upon his arrival by the Commander Peshawar Corps, according to an official statement released by the Inter-Services Public Relations. The visit underscores ongoing military oversight in border regions and highlights the collaborative efforts between the military and local police forces to maintain public safety and regional order against persistent militant threats.

stories.title: Pochettino Faces Tough Liverpool Test as Manchester United Struggles Continue
stories.summary:
Mauricio Pochettino begins his tenure as manager of Manchester United with a challenging fixture away against rivals Liverpool this weekend. The former Tottenham and Chelsea boss takes over a struggling squad that sits in the Premier League relegation zone and could potentially drop to the bottom of the table depending on prior results. Under departed manager Michael Carrick, the team accumulated only eight points from their first 10 matches, marking their lowest points tally at this stage of a league campaign in 40 years. Following the Anfield encounter, United face upcoming matches against Brentford, Newcastle, Coventry, and Crystal Palace.

In other Premier League action, second-placed Brighton aim to sustain momentum after winning six of their last seven league games. Under Fabian Hurzeler, the south-coast club boasts the league's top-scoring attack with 26 goals and has conceded only seven, though midfielder Pascal Gross dismissed talk of an early title challenge. Meanwhile, Manchester City are seeking to halt a three-match losing streak that leaves them six points behind leaders Arsenal. Enzo Maresca's side faces Fulham, a team City has defeated in their last 20 encounters across all competitions, as the club continues to await potential penalties regarding over 100 alleged breaches of financial regulations.

stories.title: India Capitalizes on New Zealand Errors After Nicholls Scores Unbeaten 175
stories.summary:
India capitalized on several fielding mistakes by New Zealand to reach 159-1 by the conclusion of the second day in the first Test at Wellington, trailing the hosts by 209 runs. Opening batters Yashasvi Jaiswal and KL Rahul forged a 130-run stand in just 27.5 overs, exploiting early dropped catches. Jaiswal, who contributed 85 runs from 89 balls, was dropped twice on zero and six by Henry Nicholls and Glenn Phillips, while Rahul survived an unreviewed lbw appeal on five. Jaiswal played aggressively, striking numerous boundaries before being caught behind off Matt Henry, leaving Rahul unbeaten on 52 alongside Devdutt Padikkal on 16 at stumps.

Earlier on day two, New Zealand were dismissed for 368 shortly after lunch, driven by Nicholls' patient, unbeaten 175 off 335 balls. Nicholls anchored the innings alongside Phillips, whose 118 helped rescue the team from an early collapse at 70-5 on the first day through a 216-run partnership. Indian fast bowler Jasprit Bumrah returned to Test cricket after a year to claim 4-92, supported by Akash Deep who took 3-53. Indian bowlers struggled with their lengths during parts of the innings, but the top-order batters responded with swift scoring to press for a result on a pitch becoming increasingly favorable for batting.

stories.title: Cyber Crime Agency Arrests Suspect in Karachi Over Stolen US Data Sale
stories.summary:
The National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency arrested a suspect in Karachi accused of acquiring, possessing, and selling confidential data belonging to United States government agencies, law enforcement organizations, and private companies. A formal criminal case has been registered at the agency's Karachi police station under multiple sections of the Prevention of Electronic Crimes Act, 2016, following amendments in 2025. Investigators stated that the suspect operated under the online alias 'DP BRUCE' and utilized platforms like LeakBase and Telegram to advertise stolen databases containing sensitive information linked to institutions such as the FBI, CIA, Department of State, Department of Defence, and various police departments.

According to the agency, the suspect allegedly received payments for the compromised information through cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin. Acting on credible intelligence, an NCCIA team conducted a raid in Karachi's Manzoor Colony on November 11, apprehending the suspect and seizing a personal laptop. Preliminary technical inspections of the device revealed multiple files and databases containing sensitive US records and evidence of online trade activities. The agency emphasized its ongoing commitment to dismantling cybercriminal networks involved in domestic and transnational illicit data trading.

The arrest forms part of a broader series of enforcement actions by the cyber crime agency. Just a day prior, the NCCIA reported uncovering a financial network tied to illegal online betting, fraudulent operations, and money laundering with transactions reaching up to Rs1 trillion. Earlier in the month, the agency also detained numerous suspects across various operations targeting international cyber fraud networks, illegal call centers, and unauthorized data sales.

stories.title: Punjab Revenue Authority Warns Hotels and Restaurants Over Digital Payments
stories.summary:
The Punjab Revenue Authority has announced that it will take strict measures against hotels and restaurants that obstruct the digital payment system across the province. The warning was shared by a spokesperson following a high-level meeting on promoting digital transactions.

Chaired by PRA Chairman Moazzam Iqbal Sappra, the meeting established that forgery in payment records and tax misappropriation will face zero tolerance. Authorities confirmed that establishments compelling customers to pay exclusively in cash will be placed under strict surveillance.

Businesses utilizing unregistered Point of Sale systems or depositing funds into unauthorized bank accounts will be subjected to heavy financial penalties. Furthermore, the PRA has instructed its vigilance wing to inspect and verify business receipts and payment records across multiple districts in Punjab.

stories.title: Tim Hortons App Shared User Data with Israeli Tech Firm, Says Group
stories.summary:
Canadians for Justice and Peace in the Middle East stated that the mobile application for coffee chain Tim Hortons shares sensitive consumer information with Forter, an Israeli fraud prevention company established by alumni of the Israeli military intelligence Unit 8200. The advocacy group urged the company to sever ties with the technology firm, having confirmed its identity with assistance from University of Calgary researcher Joel Reardon, whose findings appeared in a CBC investigation.

The investigation revealed that the Tim Hortons app transmitted details such as unique device identifiers, camera specs, and nearby Wi-Fi networks to third parties, with researcher Joel Reardon describing the data collection as excessive. CJPME Vice President Michael Bueckert criticized the sharing of personal data with a cyber-tech company linked to a foreign military intelligence unit tied to human rights violations against Palestinians. Microsoft previously restricted cloud and AI services used by Unit 8200 over surveillance concerns.

In response to the CBC report, Tim Hortons stated that the information is gathered strictly for fraud prevention, payment protection, and account security rather than marketing purposes. The company maintained that third parties are prohibited from selling the data and that it does not sell user information. Previously, in 2022, Canadian privacy regulators determined the coffee chain's app gathered extensive location data without proper user consent.

stories.title: US Dollar Nears 19-Month High Amid Federal Reserve Tightening Bets
stories.summary:
The United States dollar hovered near a 19-month high, remaining on track for a fourth consecutive week of gains driven by expectations of further Federal Reserve interest rate hikes and investor safe-haven demand amid artificial intelligence market jitters. The dollar index traded near 103.9, its strongest level since early April 2025. The rally intensified after November 10 when strong US inflation data bolstered tightening expectations and Fed Governor Christopher Waller suggested a potential 50-basis-point increase in December. This currency strength coincided with weak equity sentiment, dragging the S&P 500 down for six straight sessions amid broader concerns over tech valuations.

Additional support for the greenback came from hawkish statements by regional Federal Reserve officials. Philadelphia Fed President Anna Paulson noted that interest rates must rise due to high inflation, while Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee stated that inflation data does not indicate price pressures are returning naturally to the 2% target. Conversely, the Japanese yen firmed 0.3% to 159.13 against the dollar following data showing Japan's annual core inflation accelerated to 2.2% in October. Meanwhile, sterling languished near a one-year low of $1.3106, the euro struggled near $1.0977, the Australian dollar hovered close to $0.6664, and China's offshore yuan bounced to 6.743 per dollar.

In regional developments, the Punjab Revenue Authority in Lahore warned of strict enforcement against hotels and restaurants obstructing digital payment systems. PRA Chairman Moazzam Iqbal Sappra led a meeting focused on expanding digital transactions and curbing tax evasion and forgery across the province.

This currency market movement matters because it reflects global investor anxiety regarding technology sector valuations and shifting macroeconomic forecasts. Higher interest rate expectations in the United States directly influence global capital flows, impacting currency valuations and borrowing costs internationally.

stories.title: Trump, Xi, and Putin Hold Historic Trilateral Summit in Shenzhen
stories.summary:
The leaders of the world's three major powers convened for an unprecedented 90-minute trilateral meeting in Shenzhen, China, on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit. US President Donald Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping, and Russian President Vladimir Putin gathered at a hillside resort to address international stability. Although the talks concluded with a joint peace declaration and four key agreements—including plans to reform the United Nations, increase refined petroleum supplies, and launch nuclear risk reduction dialogues—analysts widely characterized the session as a confidence-building exercise rather than an immediate resolution to ongoing global conflicts.

During the discussions, which also touched upon the war in Ukraine and the jurisdictions of bodies like the International Criminal Court, each leader emphasized the necessity of major-power cooperation. Xi highlighted that regular high-level engagement is essential for crisis prevention. Trump advocated for reduced nuclear stockpiles while criticizing globalist organizations, and Putin emphasized shared responsibilities regarding international security and transnational crime. According to regional experts like Hoo Tiang Boon and Wu Xinbo, Beijing and Moscow emerged as the primary beneficiaries, with China successfully showcasing its diplomatic centrality as host and Russia utilizing the platform to counter global isolation. Trump's participation was viewed as an effort to project international leadership following domestic midterm setbacks.

Despite the positive optics and descriptions of the talks as constructive by all three leaders, skepticism persists regarding tangible outcomes. Scholars noted that the joint statement lacked substantive progress on complex geopolitical issues such as the conflicts in Ukraine and Iran. However, analysts suggest that establishing direct communication channels creates positive momentum and reinforces mutual trust, pointing to the potential for future institutionalized trilateral interactions in an uncertain global landscape.

stories.title: اٹلی کے خطے پوگلیا کی روایتی روٹی فریزیلے جو سال بھر خراب نہیں ہوتی
stories.summary:
جنوبی اٹلی کے خطے پوگلیا کی روایتی روٹی فریزیلے اپنی انفرادیت اور طویل مدتِ تحفظ کی وجہ سے دنیا بھر میں جانی جاتی ہے۔ اس گول اور پتھر جیسی سخت روٹی کو کھانے سے پہلے پانی میں ڈبویا جاتا ہے تاکہ اس کی خستگی برقرار رہتے ہوئے یہ نرم ہو جائے۔ مقامی لوگ اس پر ٹماٹر، زیتون کے تیل میں محفوظ مرچیں، کیپرز، اوریگانو اور لہسن کے ساتھ بینگن ڈال کر استعمال کرتے ہیں۔ یہ طریقہ صدیوں پرانا ہے اور اس خطے کی تاریخ سے جڑا ہوا ہے۔

فریزیلے کی تیاری کا عمل نہایت دلچسپ اور دو مراحل پر مشتمل ہوتا ہے۔ بیکر آٹے کی لمبی پٹی بنا کر اسے حلقے کی شکل میں ڈھالتے ہیں اور تقریباً چالیس منٹ تک بیک کرتے ہیں۔ اس کے بعد اسے تار کی مدد سے کاٹا جاتا ہے تاکہ اس کی سطح کھردری ہو جائے اور یہ ذائقہ اور پانی بہتر طریقے سے جذب کر سکے۔ کٹنے کے بعد اسے دوبارہ تقریباً ڈیڑھ گھنٹے کے لیے تنور میں رکھا جاتا ہے تاکہ اس میں موجود تمام نمی ختم ہو جائے اور پھپھوندی نہ لگ سکے۔

اس روٹی کی تاریخ ہزاروں سال پرانی ہے اور قدیم دور میں ملاح اور کسان طویل سفر کے دوران اسے اپنے ساتھ رکھتے تھے۔ پوگلیا کے ساحلی اور زرعی ماحول کے پیشِ نظر یہ خوراک سمندری سفر اور جنگ و امن کے ادوار میں انتہائی کارآمد ثابت ہوئی۔ فولا جیوردانو کے مطابق پہلی صدی عیسوی میں بھی دو بار بیک کی جانے والی ملاحوں کی روٹی کا ذکر ملتا ہے جسے صلیبی اور زائرین بھی استعمال کرتے تھے۔

وقت کے ساتھ اس روٹی کی تیاری میں استعمال ہونے والے اناج میں بھی تبدیلی آئی ہے۔ ماضی میں جو سے بنے فریزیلے کو غریبوں کی خوراک سمجھا جاتا تھا اور لوگ گندم کو ترجیح دیتے تھے، لیکن اب جو کے فریزیلے زیادہ صحت بخش اور مقبول متبادل بن چکے ہیں۔ آج کل پوگلیا کی بیکریوں میں اس کی مختلف اقسام دستیاب ہیں جن میں سپیلٹ اور ملٹی گرین شامل ہیں، جبکہ شیف اب اسے جدید انداز میں ڈیکنسٹرکٹڈ ڈشز اور چھوٹے سائز میں بھی پیش کر رہے ہیں۔

stories.title: US Religious Freedom Panel Accuses India of Targeting Muslim Minorities
stories.summary:
The United States Commission on International Religious Freedom stated that India has escalated its targeting of religious minorities during a massive nationwide voter list revision. USCIRF Chair Asif Mahmood reported that Muslim citizens are being systematically removed from voter rolls, labeled as foreigners, and illegally deported. The electoral revision resulted in the deletion of 130 million names—the largest such reduction in Indian history—with data showing disproportionate impacts on Muslims, India's largest minority group. This community has faced increasing discrimination since Prime Minister Narendra Modi's Bharatiya Janata Party assumed power in 2014.

India's Election Commission defended the voter roll updates, stating the process targeted duplicate, deceased, and ineligible voters while offering an appeals mechanism for anyone excluded in error. However, commissioner Gene Mills urged the US State Department to designate India as a country of particular concern, citing the expulsion of citizens based on faith. The Indian foreign ministry dismissed USCIRF as biased and viewed its criticism as foreign interference in domestic affairs. Meanwhile, opposition groups and student demonstrators have staged protests against the revisions, leading to crackdowns that have drawn further criticism from international human rights experts.

This controversy underscores deepening international scrutiny over minority rights in India. While government officials maintain that state policies benefit all communities through welfare and infrastructure programs, international bodies and civil rights advocates point to rising hate speech, discriminatory citizenship legislation, and administrative actions as evidence of systemic prejudice against religious minorities.

stories.title: Pakistan Climbs 17 Spots in United Nations E-Government Index 2026
stories.summary:
Pakistan advanced 17 positions globally in the United Nations E-Government Development Index 2026, reaching the 119th spot according to an official statement. This latest achievement brings the nation's total ranking improvement to 31 places over the past four years, demonstrating measurable progress in digital governance and the digital delivery of public services. Pakistan's EGDI score rose by 23 percent to reach 0.6264, accompanied by significant regional advancements in online public service delivery across South Asia.

Federal Minister for Information Technology and Telecommunication Shaza Fatima attributed the upgraded ranking to Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif's objective of establishing a digital nation. She noted that coordinated initiatives between federal and provincial authorities have successfully transitioned numerous government services to online platforms, thereby improving accessibility for everyday citizens. The minister emphasized that this upward trajectory in digital infrastructure has garnered international acknowledgment for the country's reform efforts.

The UN E-Government Survey, compiled biennially by the UN Department of Economic and Social Affairs, evaluates all 193 UN member states using three core dimensions: online services, telecommunications infrastructure, and human capital. Participating nations are categorized into four distinct groups and 16 rating classes, with the highest tier designating the most sophisticated e-government systems worldwide. This progress reflects ongoing administrative reforms aimed at modernizing public sector operations and enhancing institutional efficiency.

stories.title: Awami Raj Party Chief Iqrar-ul-Hassan Pleads Not Guilty in NCCIA Case
stories.summary:
A Judicial Magistrate in East Karachi formally indicted Awami Raj Party leader Iqrar-ul-Hassan on Friday in a legal case initiated by the National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency. During the court proceedings, the accused entered a plea of not guilty to the charges leveled against him.

The presiding magistrate instructed the prosecution to present its evidence and summoned prosecution witnesses to provide their testimonies during the upcoming hearing scheduled for December 9. Furthermore, the court instructed the defendant to guarantee his personal attendance on that specific date.

In a separate petition presented during the session, legal counsel for Iqrar-ul-Hassan requested the restoration of his mobile phone, which authorities confiscated at the time of his arrest. The court listened to the arguments surrounding this request and announced that its decision would be delivered on Monday, noting that the corresponding forensic report is anticipated by that time.

Separately in Lahore, the Punjab Revenue Authority issued a stern warning regarding strict measures against hotels and restaurants that obstruct the rollout of the provincial digital payment system. PRA Chairman Moazzam Iqbal Sappra led a recent meeting focused on advancing digital transactions, where officials addressed concerns regarding tax evasion and document forgery.

stories.title: SECP Mandates UDIN Verification for Company Audit Report Submissions
stories.summary:
The Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan has formally instructed companies to verify the Unique Document Identification Number on their auditor reports prior to submitting audited financial statements. This directive applies to all business entities mandated by existing legislation to file such documents with the commission.

A Unique Document Identification Number serves as a specific identifier that allows individuals to verify the authenticity of an audit report's issuer and prevents the circulation of fraudulent documentation. Qualified auditors generate these unique identifiers through online portals maintained by their respective professional bodies, namely the Institute of Chartered Accountants of Pakistan or the Institute of Cost and Management Accountants of Pakistan.

Under Regulation 6A of the Auditors Reporting Obligations Regulations from 2018, auditors are legally required to integrate a UDIN onto every official report they generate under these guidelines. Business organizations are expected to check the validity of this number via the appropriate institute portal before completing their regulatory submissions.

The Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan stated it will only accept financial filings if the attached auditor report features a verified and authentic UDIN. Utilizing an unverified or invalid number may result in official regulatory intervention or formal civil and criminal legal proceedings under the prevailing laws.

stories.title: Pakistan Strongly Condemns Houthi Missile Strike on Riyadh Financial District
stories.summary:
Pakistan has formally condemned a suspected Houthi missile attack directed at King Abdullah Financial District in Riyadh, conveying strong support for Saudi Arabia and backing its fundamental right to defend its territory and sovereignty. The Foreign Office released a statement describing the strike as a serious breach of Saudi sovereignty, warning that persistent attacks on civilian infrastructure and economic centers endanger civilian lives and undermine regional stability.

The diplomatic statement emphasized that such aggressive actions must end immediately. Islamabad reaffirmed its close standing with the leadership and citizens of Saudi Arabia, emphasizing support for measures taken to safeguard residents and protect the nation's security, while reiterating its dedication to fostering lasting regional peace.

This condemnation followed a suspected missile strike hitting the PIF Tower, which serves as the headquarters for the sovereign wealth fund of Saudi Arabia. The impact shattered windows across multiple floors and inflicted structural damage to the metal exterior, marking the second incident in under two weeks to affect a prominent landmark in the capital's financial hub after an Aramco facility was hit on November 8.

Emergency responders and fire crews rushed to the scene while authorities restricted entry and cleared individuals from the area. While initial reports indicated no immediate casualties, the Saudi-led coalition monitoring the conflict confirmed it intercepted a projectile threat directed at Riyadh, noting that falling debris caused material damage.

stories.title: Mir Raza Ali JIT Seeks Bank Record Access and Witness Cooperation
stories.summary:
The Joint Investigation Team probing the homicide of Mir Raza Ali has approached a court for authorization to interrogate specific suspects and review relevant bank accounts. Sources indicate the team formally requested permission to examine the financial records of individuals including Ahmed Bhardey and Abdullah Bhardey, prompting the court to issue notices to the relevant parties.

Additionally, the investigators asked the court to compel pertinent banking institutions and organizations to fully cooperate with the ongoing inquiry. The application notes that the investigative body aims to finalize its inquiries and subsequently submit the final police report to the judicial authorities.

Meanwhile, attorney Jibran Nasir addressed a formal letter to the Sindh Home Minister to voice apprehension regarding delays in executing recommendations proposed by the judicial commission tied to the murder investigation. Nasir criticized the absence of certain members from Joint Investigation Team sessions and requested status updates on subcommittee decisions, noting a lack of communication regarding a one-member inquiry committee led by Zulfiqar Ali Lark.

Nasir urged formal departmental actions against responsible officials and highlighted that the parents of Mir Raza, who serve as vital witnesses, had not been summoned by the three-member investigative committee. In a separate development, the Punjab Revenue Authority warned Lahore hotels and restaurants against creating obstacles for the provincial digital payment infrastructure during a meeting chaired by PRA Chairman Moazzam Iqbal Sappra.

stories.title: Karachi Family Dispute Leaves Three Dead After Tragic Shooting
stories.summary:
A domestic dispute in the Landhi area of Karachi resulted in a fatal shooting on Friday morning. According to initial details, a local man opened fire and killed his wife and brother-in-law in Old Muzaffarabad Colony before turning the weapon on himself. Police and rescue personnel rushed to the scene to secure the location and initiate an official inquiry into the tragic event.

Following the shooting, authorities transferred the bodies of the deceased individuals to the Jinnah Postgraduate Medical Centre (JPMC) for necessary medico-legal procedures. The incident occurred as investigators continue to look into separate domestic violence cases in the country, highlighting broader concerns regarding family conflicts and safety.

In an unrelated recent development, medical authorities released a detailed post-mortem report concerning 13-year-old domestic worker Fatima Asghar. The autopsy, conducted by the Pakistan Institute of Medical Sciences (PIMS), confirmed that the minor suffered severe physical torture before her death, sustaining roughly 20 fresh and old injuries spanning from her head to her feet.

The medical findings revealed extensive bruising, swelling, and blood clots in vital organs such as the heart and kidneys, with the official cause of death attributed to repeated physical assaults leading to cardiopulmonary arrest. The young victim had reportedly worked at the official residence of a senior Federal Investigation Agency (FIA) officer located in Islamabad's Police Lines Headquarters, prompting legal experts to urge a thorough examination of the circumstances surrounding her employment and abuse.

stories.title: Cricket Australia Captain Pat Cummins' Manager Defends Him Against Scandals
stories.summary:
The ongoing "Sandpapergate" controversy surrounding the 2018 ball-tampering incident has intensified following fresh claims regarding team-wide knowledge. Neil Maxwell, manager of Australia Test captain Pat Cummins, strongly criticized the intense scrutiny faced by the skipper, dismissing the criticism as unfounded hysteria that does not reflect reality.

The renewed controversy was sparked by retired player Usman Khawaja's autobiography, which alleged that the entire squad was aware of the plot during the Cape Town Test. These claims were subsequently supported by Cameron Bancroft, the player who used the sandpaper on the ball, who stated in a newspaper column that the whole team knew and expressed feelings of betrayal by the captain.

Despite the pressure and intense public scrutiny, Neil Maxwell defended Cummins' lengthy press conference and his eight-year stance, asserting that there is no serious case establishing the captain as an architect of ball-tampering. Maxwell also argued that the players who received year-long suspensions—Steve Smith, David Warner, and Cameron Bancroft—paid an excessively high price compared to similar penalties handed down in other international jurisdictions.

Cricket Australia has formally decided against reopening the investigation into the 2018 scandal. Instead, Chief Executive Todd Greenberg has backed Cummins and announced plans to launch an independent forum to provide players with a platform to share their personal versions of the events.

stories.title: Kozo Tashima Refuses to Drop Out of FIFA Presidential Race
stories.summary:
FIFA presidential candidate Kozo Tashima stated on Friday that he has no immediate intention to withdraw from the upcoming election in March. Tashima, a former president of the Japan Football Association and current FIFA Council member, aims to restore integrity, transparency, and trust within world football's governing body. He joins a three-man ballot that includes incumbent president Gianni Infantino and French football chief Philippe Diallo.

While Diallo is backed by Europe and viewed as a stronger challenger to unseat Infantino, Tashima indicated he wants to work closely with the French official rather than step aside for a straight fight. Tashima noted that although he did not know Diallo was entering the race until late and has not spoken to him directly, he welcomes the candidacy and sees them as moving in a similar direction to reform FIFA.

Infantino faces criticism over a planned private investment into the World Cup and a controversial decision to lift a suspension on American player Folarin Balogun following an intervention by US President Donald Trump. Despite these controversies, Infantino retains considerable backing for a fourth and final term. Tashima stressed that his decision to run stems from a belief that the presidency is the most effective way to improve the organization rather than a personal ambition.

Turning 69 on Saturday, Tashima brings a low-key approach shaped by his extensive background as a player, coach, and bureaucrat. He believes that the organization should be reshaped so that players, teams, and referees remain the most visible figures in the sport. His continued presence in the race matters as it shapes the dynamic of the opposition against Infantino's bid for leadership.

stories.title: Pakistani Climate Minister Musadik Malik Visits India for SCO Forum
stories.summary:
Federal Minister for Climate Change Musadik Masood Malik arrived in New Delhi on Friday to lead Pakistan's delegation at the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) Civilisational Dialogue Forum. Received by Pakistan’s Charge d’Affaires in New Delhi, Malik is attending the event to discuss shared civilisational heritage, cultural ties, and regional cooperation among SCO member states, which include Pakistan, India, China, and Russia.

The visit marks the first time a Pakistani minister has travelled to India in over three years, following a high-level visit by then Foreign Minister Bilawal Bhutto Zardari to Goa in May 2023. The diplomatic engagement comes amid strained relations between the two nuclear-armed neighbours following a four-day military conflict in 2025, which represented the worst violence between them in decades.

During the forum, Malik will present Pakistan's perspective on the importance of inter-civilisational dialogue and diplomacy, highlighting the nation's diverse heritage and constructive role within the regional political and security organisation. The delegation is scheduled to participate in thematic sessions and engage with other member states on the sidelines of the event, reflecting Pakistan's active commitment to the "Shanghai Spirit" of cooperation and understanding.

Ahead of his departure, Malik met with Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Senator Mohammad Ishaq Dar at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs to review Pakistan's participation. His presence at the dialogue forum matters as a rare high-level diplomatic outreach between the two countries following a period of severe military escalation.

stories.title: Trump Dismisses Cyber Director Sean Cairncross Following Major Tech Outages
stories.summary:
White House national cyber director Sean Cairncross was fired on Wednesday after technology disruptions paralyzed US air travel, banking, and national security systems. A source close to the White House confirmed that President Donald Trump fully supported the ouster, which followed demands from First Lady Melania Trump for her sacking amid a broader White House reshuffle driven by midterm election setbacks and infighting.

The dismissal represents the administration's first major personnel action in response to a week of severe technological failures, including a nationwide halt affecting over 18,000 flights and a global outage impacting hundreds of millions of Microsoft users. Department of Defense Chief Information Officer Kirsten Davies will temporarily take over the cybersecurity portfolio, while any permanent successor will require confirmation by a Democrat-controlled Senate beginning in January.

Cybersecurity experts attribute the recent wave of disruptions to corporate efforts to rapidly patch newly discovered software vulnerabilities using advanced artificial intelligence tools. Meanwhile, the top US intelligence official clarified on Wednesday that the failures stem from routine maintenance and service outages rather than any coordinated or state-sponsored cyber attack. Republican lawmakers, including Senator Josh Hawley of Missouri, have called on the administration to brief Congress so the public can be informed about the crisis.

Cairncross, a former executive at the Republican National Committee who oversaw federal cybersecurity policy and strategy, stated that serving in the Trump administration was the honor of a lifetime. The removal matters as a high-level personnel fallout from systemic technology failures that have intensified scrutiny on the administration's administrative competence and infrastructure resilience.

stories.title: Trump, Xi, and Putin Hold Trilateral Summit in Shenzhen with Few Results
stories.summary:
US President Donald Trump met with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin in an unprecedented three-way summit in Shenzhen, China. The gathering occurred on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) China Summit as Trump sought to project international influence following political setbacks at home, including his party's loss of control of Congress in the midterm elections and a deeply unpopular war with Iran.

Despite the high-profile setting, the leaders failed to achieve substantive breakthroughs on major geopolitical issues such as the wars in Ukraine, Iran, and Taiwan, nor did they narrow existing gaps regarding trade and artificial intelligence. While the three nuclear-armed powers issued a symbolic peace declaration affirming that a nuclear war cannot be won and must never be fought, they announced no concrete arms control agreements or timelines for nuclear risk reduction dialogue.

Analysts noted that the summit largely benefited Xi and Putin by enhancing their diplomatic standing without requiring significant concessions, while leaving Trump's signature personalized diplomacy with few tangible policy wins. White House spokeswoman Anna Kelly defended the engagement, stating that Trump effectively restored American strength and demonstrated leadership. However, critics like Senate Democratic Leader Charles Schumer dismissed the meeting as a historic embarrassment that yielded no lasting commitments from adversaries.

The meeting drew comparisons to the 1945 Yalta Conference, causing alarm among European allies who were absent from the discussions and indignant that Trump embraced Putin as a friend. As Trump returns to Washington, the summit highlights the ongoing challenges of his leader-to-leader approach ahead of hosting the upcoming G20 summit in Florida.

stories.title: Turkish Seismic Vessel Orus Reis Arrives in Karachi for Survey
stories.summary:
A Turkish seismic vessel named Orus Reis docked at Karachi port on Friday to initiate offshore oil and gas exploration in Pakistan. This development signifies a fresh stage of energy cooperation between Turkiye and Pakistan, with Ankara taking a central role in the country's offshore exploration initiatives. Turkish Energy Minister Alparslan Bayraktar traveled to Karachi a day prior and joined Deputy Prime Minister Ishaq Dar, Federal Minister for Petroleum Ali Pervaiz Malik, and other Pakistani officials to welcome the arrival of the vessel.

The ship will conduct seismic surveys across Pakistan's offshore blocks. Islamabad recently auctioned these blocks for hydrocarbon exploration for the first time in two decades as part of a broader strategy to revive domestic exploration and decrease import dependence. For years, Pakistan's offshore potential remained largely untapped due to insufficient investment and technical capabilities.

This milestone follows actions taken earlier in the year regarding the Pakistan Offshore Bid Round 2025. Pakistan Petroleum Limited (PPL) executed Production Sharing Agreements and exploration licences for eight offshore blocks on May 20, 2026, following a provisional award announced on November 13, 2025. The portfolio includes two PPL-operated blocks, Gharo Creek and Kochi Creek, along with six partner-operated blocks: Bin Qasim South, Keti Bandar, Behr, Zarrar, Offshore Deep D, and Sapat Bandar.

The deployment of the vessel and revival of these offshore blocks matter significantly for Pakistan's energy security and economic framework. By leveraging Turkish technical collaboration, Islamabad aims to bolster domestic hydrocarbon production, mitigate vulnerabilities associated with energy imports, and attract renewed interest to a sector that has faced prolonged stagnation.

stories.title: Pakistan Defeats Sri Lanka to Secure Test Series Victory
stories.summary:
Pakistan secured a commanding eight-wicket triumph over Sri Lanka in the second and final Test match in Rawalpindi, successfully winning the series. Starting the fourth morning at 309-9, Sri Lanka added just seven runs to their overnight total before being bowled out for 316. Milan Rathnayaka anchored the lower order with an unbeaten 66 runs off 88 balls, featuring 12 fours, before Mohammad Abbas trapped Asitha Fernando lbw for two to conclude the innings. Abbas finished as the pick of the Pakistani bowlers with figures of 3-55, supported by Aamer Jamal with 3-67 and Razaullah with 2-116.

Chasing a target of 90 runs, Pakistan reached the objective in 13 overs to seal the win. Despite losing openers Tayyab Arif for 13 and Mohammad Taha for four, Aamer Jamal scored 34 not out and Azan Awais contributed an unbeaten 32. Jamal hit the winning boundary off spinner Prabath Jayasuriya. The victory marks Pakistan's first series win in the current cycle of the World Test Championship, following previous draws against South Africa and the West Indies, and losses to Bangladesh and England.

During the match, Pakistan's pace quartet utilized the green-tinged pitch effectively on the first day, dismissing Sri Lanka for 98 in their first innings. The hosts then responded with 325 runs to establish control. Although Sri Lanka avoided an innings defeat through half-centuries from Rathnayaka, Sonal Dinusha, and captain Kusal Mendis, they could not prevent the overall series loss.

Pakistan captain Babar Azam expressed satisfaction with the performance of his new players, emphasizing the goal of cultivating a resilient team environment. Meanwhile, Sri Lankan skipper Kusal Mendis noted that a weak first-inning performance hampered their chances and pointed out that the team needs to improve its batting and fielding.

This series win provides a vital confidence boost for Pakistan's evolving Test squad within the World Test Championship cycle. It highlights the effectiveness of the home team's pace attack on favorable pitches and signals a positive turn for the national side following a challenging run of international series results.

stories.title: Army Chief Field Marshal Munir Vows to Eradicate Terrorism
stories.summary:
Chief of Defence Forces and Chief of the Army Staff Field Marshal Asim Munir visited Miranshah in North Waziristan on Friday to reaffirm the security forces' commitment to eliminating terrorism. According to the Inter-Services Public Relations (ISPR), Munir stated that security agencies and law enforcement would work closely to eradicate the menace and safeguard the peace of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. He also praised the resilience and sacrifices of the KP police force in countering terrorism and Fitna-al-Khawarij, the state's term for the banned Tehreek-i-Taliban Pakistan.

During his visit, the army chief received a detailed briefing regarding the security situation, intelligence-based operations, and measures to sustain counterterrorism gains. He was welcomed by the Peshawar Corps commander, laid a floral wreath at Yadgar-i-Shuhada to honor fallen soldiers, and interacted with troops to commend their operational readiness. The trip to North Waziristan followed a visit to Turbat in Balochistan, where he reviewed operations against externally sponsored terrorism.

Pakistan's security forces have maintained continuous counterterrorism actions in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and Balochistan, the two regions most heavily impacted by violence. Recent military reports indicated that dozens of terrorists were killed and multiple troops were martyred in recent intelligence-based operations. Furthermore, an independent monthly assessment by the Pakistan Institute for Conflict and Security Studies reported a significant nationwide decline in violence during October, with attacks dropping by 37 percent and related deaths decreasing by 57 percent compared to September.

These ongoing security operations and leadership visits matter significantly for maintaining stability in regions vulnerable to militant activity. The reaffirmation of resolve by top military command underscores the state's continued focus on subduing insurgent networks, particularly as authorities manage administrative challenges and governance shifts in affected provinces.

stories.title: انڈیا کے ٹرک ڈرائیور بلجندر سنگھ کی بارہ کروڑ روپے کی لاٹری نکل آئی
stories.summary:
انڈیا کے شہر موہالی کے قریب واقع چھوٹے سے گاؤں ہمایوں پور کے رہائشی ٹرک ڈرائیور بلجندر سنگھ کے گھر میں اس وقت جشن کا ماحول ہے کیونکہ ان کی بارہ کروڑ روپے کی لاٹری نکل آئی ہے۔ پیشے کے اعتبار سے ٹرک ڈرائیور بلجندر سنگھ ماہانہ چند ہزار روپے کماتے ہیں اور وہ گذشتہ پندرہ برس سے دیوالی یا لوہڑی جیسے مختلف تہواروں کے موقع پر لاٹری کے ٹکٹ خریدتے آ رہے تھے۔ وہ ٹکٹ لا کر اپنے دستاویزات کے ساتھ رکھ دیا کرتے تھے اور ان کے گھر میں کسی کو بھی اس کا علم نہیں تھا۔

بلجندر سنگھ کو پندرہ برسوں میں پہلی بار اس دکاندار کی کال موصول ہوئی جس سے وہ ٹکٹ خریدتے تھے۔ وشال گرگ نامی اس دکاندار نے بلجندر سنگھ کو فون کر کے بتایا کہ ان کا انعام نکل آیا ہے لیکن گھبراہٹ سے بچانے کے لیے ابتدا میں انہیں انعامی رقم کے حجم کے بارے میں نہیں بتایا گیا۔ جب بلجندر سنگھ دکان پر پہنچے تو دکاندار نے انہیں بٹھایا، پانی پلایا اور آرام سے پوچھا کہ اگر بڑی رقم نکل آئے تو کیا ہوگا۔

جب بلجندر سنگھ کو بتایا گیا کہ ان کی لاٹری سے بارہ کروڑ روپے کی رقم نکلی ہے تو وہ ایک دم شاک میں آ گئے اور شدید خوشی کا اظہار کرتے ہوئے کہا کہ وہ یہ ٹکٹ تکیے کے نیچے رکھ کر پوری رات نہیں سوئیں گے۔ اس بڑی کامیابی کے بعد بھی بلجندر سنگھ کا کہنا ہے کہ وہ اپنی محنت جاری رکھیں گے، عام زندگی گزاریں گے اور ڈرائیونگ کا کام نہیں چھوڑیں گے۔ ان کے ستر سالہ والد کا بھی کہنا ہے کہ انہوں نے محنت مشقت کر کے بہت مشکل وقت کاٹا ہے اور اب وہ اپنا پرانا سادھا طرز زندگی ہی برقرار رکھیں گے۔

stories.title: Indian Bonds Edge Up as Markets Await Debt Auction
stories.summary:
Indian government bonds traded slightly higher in early Friday sessions, tracking an upward movement in US Treasuries. The benchmark 6.94% 2036 bond yield stood at 7.2439 percent by 10 a.m. IST, down from its previous close of 7.2543 percent. Market activity remained subdued as investors awaited the results of New Delhi's weekly debt auction, which involved selling bonds worth 330 billion rupees, equivalent to $3.54 billion, including liquid five-year paper. Primary dealers noted that while market bulls pushed for lower yields, caution and profit-taking ahead of the auction prevented a broader rally.

The movement in US Treasuries followed a selloff in US equities that drove investors toward safe-haven government assets. Weaker economic indicators in the United States led traders to reprice expectations for the Federal Reserve's December policy meeting, with CME FedWatch data showing the probability of a larger rate hike dropping significantly.

Meanwhile, international oil prices remained a critical factor for India's domestic economy, with Brent crude hovering around $92 a barrel. Sensitivity around the Strait of Hormuz poses risks of supply disruptions that could tighten global markets. Sustained high oil prices represent a major macroeconomic risk for India, directly affecting its current account deficit, local currency value, and inflation outlook.

These economic pressures matter greatly for India's monetary policy trajectory. With retail inflation recently moving above the Reserve Bank of India's 6 percent upper threshold for the first time in two years, markets have positioned themselves for a potential interest rate increase by the central bank in early December.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia Implements Domestic Minimum Top-Up Tax Effective January 2027
stories.summary:
The Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority has announced the implementation of a domestic minimum top-up tax starting January 1, 2027. This regulatory measure applies specifically to constituent entities within multinational enterprise groups that possess consolidated annual revenues of at least 750 million euros, or an equivalent value in Saudi riyals. Qualification for the tax is determined by financial statements from the ultimate parent entity across at least two out of the four fiscal years preceding the application year.

The policy scope is strictly limited to eligible multinational groups, excluding purely domestic enterprises that lack international branches or membership in a covered multinational entity group. The initiative stems from international efforts spearheaded by the G20 and the Organization for Economic Co-operation and Development under Pillar Two. It is designed to safeguard the nation's tax rights concerning profits generated domestically by qualifying corporations.

Under this framework, authorities can collect a top-up tax within the kingdom whenever a group's effective tax rate drops beneath the global minimum threshold of 15 percent. Officials emphasized that this 15 percent benchmark applies to corporate profits rather than total revenues. The tax aims to foster tax fairness and ensure compliance with international standards.

To assist targeted organizations seeking additional guidance, the Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority established several communication channels. Stakeholders can utilize the unified call center at 19993, contact the official account on X, send inquiries via email, or use the live chat feature available on the official website.

stories.title: Pakistan Secures Eight-Wicket Victory Against Sri Lanka to Win Test Series
stories.summary:
Pakistan triumphed over Sri Lanka by eight wickets in the second and final Test match held at the Rawalpindi Cricket Stadium on Friday, securing a series victory. Sri Lanka managed to avoid an innings defeat previously but was eventually dismissed for 316 runs on the fourth morning, adding only seven runs to their overnight total of 309 for nine. Milan Rathnayaka finished unbeaten with 66 runs from 88 balls, featuring twelve boundaries, while Mohammad Abbas concluded the innings by trapping Asitha Fernando leg-before-wicket for two.

Chasing a target of 90 runs, Pakistan reached the objective in 13 overs. Despite losing opening batsmen Tayyab Arif for 13 and Mohammad Taha for four, Aamer Jamal and Azan Awais secured the win. Jamal scored an unbeaten 34 and hit the winning boundary off spin bowler Prabath Jayasuriya, while Awais remained not out with 32 runs.

In the bowling department, Mohammad Abbas led Pakistan with figures of 3-55, supported by Aamer Jamal taking 3-67 and Razaullah claiming 2-116. This triumph marks Pakistan's first Test series win of the current World Test Championship cycle, following prior draws against South Africa and the West Indies alongside losses to Bangladesh and England.

The home team established early control on the first day by utilizing a green-tinged pitch to dismiss Sri Lanka for 98 runs in their first innings, followed by a total of 325 runs of their own. Despite half-centuries from Rathnayaka, Sonal Dinusha, and captain Kusal Mendis, Sri Lanka could not prevent the series defeat.

stories.title: Thai Baht Maintains Steady Performance Against US Dollar on Friday
stories.summary:
The Thai baht remained stable against the US dollar during Friday trading, recording a marginal increase and staying within a narrow fluctuation band according to data from LSEG. 

At 0215 GMT, the currency traded 0.02% higher at 33.96 per dollar. Throughout the session, it moved within a range defined by a high of 33.970 and a low of 33.940.

This performance follows the previous trading session, where the baht closed at 33.9625 against the US dollar.

The steady movement highlights relative currency stability in Bangkok markets during the early trading hours on Friday.

stories.title: Japan's Nikkei Plummets Over 4 Percent Following Wall Street Tech Slump
stories.summary:
Japan's Nikkei stock average dropped sharply by more than 4% during early trading on Friday, mirroring significant technology sector declines on Wall Street overnight. By 0040 GMT, the Nikkei had fallen 4.28% to 56,899.52, while the broader Topix index registered a 2.7% decrease.

Major chip-related entities bore the brunt of the downturn, with Advantest and Tokyo Electron experiencing steep declines of 10% and 7%, respectively. SoftBank Group also suffered notable losses as broader market sentiment soured amid waning enthusiasm for artificial intelligence.

The regional sell-off was triggered by an overnight slump in US equities. That downturn followed Anthropic's large-scale initial public offering, which failed to revive flagging artificial intelligence optimism after an initial, temporary spike in share prices quickly subsided.

Market breadth on the Tokyo Stock Exchange's prime market reflected the widespread sell-off. Out of more than 1,500 actively traded stocks, 90% recorded losses, 7% managed gains, and 2% remained flat.

stories.title: Chinese Yuan Bounces From One-Month Low Amid Corporate Repatriation
stories.summary:
The Chinese yuan recovered from a more than one-month low against the US dollar following corporate repatriation driven by year-end requirements. Companies took advantage of a strong dollar to convert foreign-currency receipts, a seasonal trend ahead of the calendar year-end and the Lunar New Year due to administrative needs and bonus expenses. Onshore, the currency rebounded to 6.6715 per dollar from 6.6950, which had been its weakest level since October 14. The offshore yuan traded at 6.6746, while the People's Bank of China established its midpoint rate at 6.7131.

Despite the recent rebound, a robust dollar and market expectations of aggressive US Federal Reserve interest rate hikes to combat inflation have continued to pressure emerging market currencies. Minutes from the latest Federal Reserve meeting indicated that policymakers considered further monetary tightening. Concurrently, the People's Bank of China maintained its benchmark lending interest rates for the eighteenth straight month.

Looking ahead, analysts project that the renminbi will experience a gradual appreciation through 2027. Jeremy Zook, lead analyst for China at Fitch Ratings, noted that authorities will likely temper rapid appreciation to protect export performance against weak domestic demand. Similarly, Yu Song, chief China economist at UBS Securities, highlighted that a substantial current account surplus and easing capital outflows will support the currency. Analysts expect the yuan to conclude the year at 6.6 per dollar and strengthen to 6.25 by the end of next year.

stories.title: Australian Shares Drop to One-Month Low on Weak Employment Data
stories.summary:
Australian shares experienced a sharp decline, hitting a one-month low as financials and mining sectors retreated. The S&P/ASX 200 index dropped 1% to 8.639.4 points, marking its lowest level since October 15, after falling as much as 1.5% earlier in the session. This market drop followed official figures from the Australian Bureau of Statistics revealing an unexpected jump in the jobless rate to a five-year high of 4.9% in October, alongside a significant fall in employment.

The weak labor market data fueled anxieties about an economic slowdown and led investors to scale back expectations of further monetary tightening, pricing in a potential interest rate cut by mid-2027. Andrew Ticehurst, senior economist at Nomura Australia, stated that the Reserve Bank of Australia faces growing criticism for potentially over-tightening the economy through its five rate hikes earlier in the year.

Financial stocks headed toward their worst week since mid-August, with the major four banks posting losses between 1% and 2% due to concerns over credit quality and lending growth. Meanwhile, miners declined by 1% as copper prices hovered near a seven-month low, and bellwether stock BHP dipped 0.3%. Gold stocks tumbled 2.2% following a drop in bullion to a 14-month low, and tech stocks fell 4.3% in tandem with US market losses. In New Zealand, the S&P/NZX 50 index slipped 0.6% to 14,160.95 points.

stories.title: Oil Prices Rise on Middle East Supply Concerns and Houthi Attacks
stories.summary:
Oil prices advanced on Friday, driven by growing supply concerns following Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia's capital, Riyadh, and tanker disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz. Brent crude futures increased by 9% to reach $92.77 a barrel, while US West Texas Intermediate January futures rose 0.9% to $83.15. Despite these daily gains, Brent was positioned for a weekly decline of roughly 3.5%, and WTI faced an approximate 6% weekly drop, marking a third consecutive week of losses as shipments through the Strait of Hormuz returned closer to pre-war levels.

 Geopolitical tensions intensified after the Iran-aligned Houthi movement targeted Riyadh with missiles, and two oil tankers struck naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz, resulting in explosions and fires, according to Iran's Revolutionary Guards Navy. UOB Group analysts noted that frequent tanker incidents in November continue to add a geopolitical risk premium to the market. Additional support for prices came from expectations that OPEC+, which includes the Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries and allies like Russia, will maintain coordinated production cuts during their upcoming meetings on November 29 to determine 2027 output policy.

 Broader market conditions and external supply factors also influenced the energy sector. Analysts at Saxo pointed out that risk-off sentiment and concerns over near-term demand tied to the artificial intelligence trade unwind weighed on prices. Additionally, International Energy Agency projections indicate that global electrification and efficiency measures could significantly reduce oil demand by 2035. In Russia, crude output faces downward pressure as Ukrainian drone attacks have cut combined crude processing volumes at Russian refineries by 45% since late October.

stories.title: Chinese and Hong Kong Markets Fall Amid Wall Street Tech Selloff
stories.summary:
Stocks across mainland China and Hong Kong dropped significantly, driven primarily by losses in technology shares following a steep Wall Street selloff. The downturn was exacerbated by fading enthusiasm for the artificial intelligence sector, as Anthropic's much-anticipated initial public offering failed to sustain an early market rally. At the midday break, the benchmark Shanghai Composite index declined by 1.6% to reach its lowest intraday level since July 2025, while the blue-chip CSI300 index lost 1.7% to hit a 17-month trough. Smaller indices also retreated, with the Shenzhen index falling 1.5%, the ChiNext Composite tumbling 2.1%, and the STAR50 index dropping 2.7%.

Market sentiment was weighed down by investor concerns regarding stretched valuations and elevated capital expenditure spending within the technology sector, according to analysts at OCBC. In China, sectors heavily reliant on computing power—such as big data, artificial intelligence, and cloud computing—recorded sharp declines. Hong Kong-listed shares of Chinese AI model developers experienced heavy selling, with Minimax plunging 9% to record lows and extending its weekly loss beyond 30%, while other shares dropped 6%.

Semiconductor stocks contributed heavily to the morning losses, with a dedicated sector sub-index plunging 3.2%. Sentiment toward regional chipmakers was further strained by reports that Taiwan's TSMC tightened restrictions on Chinese chip designers, suspending certain advanced manufacturing orders and limiting affected clients to older technologies. In Hong Kong, the benchmark Hang Seng index fell 1.7% to its lowest intraday level since May 2025, and local tech shares slumped 3.1%.

stories.title: Pakistan Secures 1-0 Test Series Win Over Sri Lanka
stories.summary:
Pakistan defeated Sri Lanka by eight wickets in the second and final Test at the Rawalpindi Cricket Stadium, securing a 1-0 victory in the two-match series on Friday. Chasing a target of 90, the hosts reached 90-2 in just 13 overs on the fourth morning. The victory marks Pakistan's first Test win since beating the West Indies and their first series triumph in the current World Test Championship cycle.

Sri Lanka had resumed their second innings at 309-9 on the fourth morning and were bowled out for 316. Mohammad Abbas trapped Asitha Fernando lbw for two, finishing with figures of 3-55. Milan Rathnayaka remained unbeaten on 66 for the visitors, capping a recovery alongside Kusal Mendis and Sonal Dinusha after Sri Lanka's low first-inning score of 98 and a 227-run deficit.

Pakistan's chase began with early setbacks as Lahiru Kumara bowled Tayyab Arif for 13, and Asitha Fernando removed Mohammad Taha for four, leaving the hosts at 37-2. Aamer Jamal was promoted up the order and responded aggressively, scoring 34 not out from 22 deliveries. He shared an unbroken 53-run partnership with opener Azan Awais, who finished unbeaten on 32.

The series finale brought important points for Pakistan in the World Test Championship standings following earlier draws and defeats in the cycle. The match concluded quickly on the fourth day, highlighting strong performances from Pakistan's pace bowlers on a green-tinged pitch and a composed final-day run chase.

stories.title: Kuwait Security Campaign Targets Lawbreakers in Capital Governorate
stories.summary:
The Capital Governorate Security Directorate conducted a large-scale security operation in Kuwait City to enforce local regulations and apprehend lawbreakers. The sweep was carried out in cooperation with the General Fire Force and Kuwait Municipality. Brigadier General Mohammed Ahmed Rajab, Director General of the Capital Governorate Security Directorate, supervised the entire operation.

The Ministry of Interior reported that the operation resulted in the arrest of 45 wanted individuals and 58 residency violators. Participating agencies recorded a total of 246 official actions during the sweep. The campaign was designed to strengthen overall security deployment across the capital and ensure commercial establishments complied with established laws.

All authorities involved in the joint operation executed necessary legal measures within their designated jurisdictions to address the infractions. The sweep forms part of ongoing enforcement efforts by Kuwaiti security forces to regulate commercial activities and track down individuals violating residency laws in the capital region.

stories.title: Xi Jinping and Anthony Albanese Hail China-Australia Relations Turnaround
stories.summary:
Chinese President Xi Jinping and Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese met on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Forum summit in Shenzhen on Friday to discuss bilateral ties. Xi praised a comprehensive turnaround in relations since Albanese took office in 2022, suggesting expanded cooperation in agriculture, energy, the green economy, artificial intelligence, and people-to-people exchanges.

Bilateral ties had previously deteriorated under Australia's prior government after calls for an inquiry into the origins of COVID-19. Although China subsequently removed various trade barriers, minor frictions have persisted over regional security tests and the detention of Chinese-born Australian nationals. Albanese emphasized that both nations must manage their differences constructively and directly without letting them define the broader relationship.

Following the Shenzhen meeting, Albanese planned to travel to Beijing to meet Premier Li Qiang alongside a delegation of top Australian business leaders, including executives from Rio Tinto and BHP. The business engagements coincide with tense negotiations between Australian mining companies and the China Mineral Resources Group regarding iron ore contracts and centralizing trade negotiations.

stories.title: Musadik Malik Arrives in New Delhi for SCO Dialogue Forum
stories.summary:
Federal Minister for Climate Change and Environmental Coordination Dr Musadik Malik arrived in New Delhi on Friday to lead Pakistan’s delegation at the SCO Civilisational Dialogue Forum. Upon his arrival at the airport, he was received by Pakistan’s Chargé d’Affaires Saad Waraich. The visit marks the first time a Pakistani minister has visited India since former foreign minister Bilawal Bhutto-Zardari attended a Shanghai Cooperation Organisation meeting in Goa in May 2023.

The forum runs from November 20 to November 22 and brings together representatives from SCO member states to discuss cultural understanding and civilisational dialogue. Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi, who originally proposed the forum during the SCO summit in Tianjin, China, in September 2025, is scheduled to address the gathering. Pakistan's Foreign Office noted that the government remains committed to fostering people-to-people contacts and dialogue within the regional bloc.

High-level diplomatic exchanges between India and Pakistan in recent years have predominantly occurred under the umbrella of the SCO, though formal bilateral talks have remained absent. Pakistan holds the rotating chairmanship of the SCO Council of Heads of State for the 2026-27 term and is scheduled to host the organization's summit in Islamabad in August 2027. Relations between the two neighboring countries have remained severely strained following a four-day military conflict in May 2025.

stories.title: Malaysian Palm Oil Futures Decline for Fourth Consecutive Session
stories.summary:
Malaysian palm oil futures extended their losses for a fourth straight session on Friday, putting the market on course for its third weekly decline in four weeks. The downturn was primarily driven by weaker soyoil prices across global markets. By the midday break on the Bursa Malaysia Derivatives Exchange, the benchmark palm oil contract for February delivery dropped 32 ringgit, or 0.74%, closing at 4,301 ringgit, equivalent to $1,046.47 per metric ton. Overall, the benchmark contract has lost 2.11% over the course of the week.

Market participants noted that palm oil prices continue to be influenced heavily by competing edible oils. David Ng, a proprietary trader at Iceberg X Sdn Bhd, explained that market direction remains tightly linked to movements in soybean oil and crude oil prices. In competing markets, Dalian's most-active soyoil contract decreased by 0.38%, its palm oil contract fell by 0.53%, and Chicago Board of Trade soyoil prices dropped by 0.93%.

Crude oil prices experienced upward movement but remained headed for a weekly decline amid rising supply disruption concerns. These worries followed Houthi attacks targeting Riyadh in Saudi Arabia and reports of tanker disruptions within the Strait of Hormuz. Stronger crude futures generally enhance the appeal of palm oil as a biodiesel feedstock. Meanwhile, the ringgit, which serves as palm's currency of trade, appreciated 0.02% against the dollar, making the commodity slightly more expensive for international buyers holding foreign currencies.

In corporate developments, Agrinas Palma Nusantara, an Indonesian state-owned palm plantation company, announced plans to transfer management and control of more than 200,000 hectares of land to local cooperatives next year. This strategic shift was detailed by a company director as part of future operational adjustments for the state enterprise.

stories.title: UN Committee Adopts Pakistan-Sponsored Resolution on Self-Determination by Consensus
stories.summary:
The United Nations General Assembly's Third Committee adopted a Pakistan-sponsored resolution reaffirming the right to self-determination for populations living under foreign domination, colonialism, and alien occupation. The initiative, titled “Universal Realisation of the Right of Peoples to Self-Determination,” received widespread backing and was adopted by consensus without a vote. A total of 62 countries co-sponsored the measure, which Pakistan has continuously championed at the international body since 1981.

Ambassador Syed Haider Shah, Pakistan’s Permanent Representative to the United Nations, formally introduced the resolution during a session on November 19, 2026. In his address, Ambassador Shah emphasized that the promise of self-determination remains unfulfilled for numerous populations, specifically highlighting the ongoing denial of this fundamental right to the people of Palestine and Indian-occupied Jammu and Kashmir. He stated that legitimate aspirations in these regions are frequently met with military oppression, excessive force, extrajudicial killings, arbitrary detentions, and demographic engineering.

Drawing on historical context, Ambassador Shah underscored that the exercise of self-determination has historically enabled millions to escape foreign subjugation and establish sovereign states. He noted that the vast majority of UN member states achieved independence through this principle, which serves as a cornerstone of the UN Charter under Article 1(2), Common Article 1 of the International Covenants on Civil and Political Rights and Economic, Social and Cultural Rights, and General Assembly Resolution 1514.

The adopted text reaffirms the universality and indivisibility of the right to self-determination while expressing solidarity with deprived peoples and highlighting the international community's collective responsibility. Ambassador Shah expressed gratitude to the 62 co-sponsoring nations and encouraged other member states to endorse the initiative, noting that the cross-regional support reflects the enduring relevance of the principle in addressing situations involving foreign occupation.

stories.title: مرتضیٰ وہاب کا ایم کیو ایم کو تنقید کا نشانہ بناتے ہوئے سندھ کا فیصلہ نہ کرنے کا مشورہ
stories.summary:
میئر کراچی مرتضیٰ وہاب نے ایک پریس کانفرنس کے دوران متحدہ قومی موومنٹ کو شدید تنقید کا نشانہ بناتے ہوئے اسے 'منتشر قومی موومنٹ' قرار دیا ہے۔ انہوں نے کہاکہ جن لوگوں کی اپنی جماعت میں انتشار کا شکار ہو، وہ سندھ کے بارے میں کوئی فیصلہ کرنے کا حق نہیں رکھتے۔ انہوں نے اس عزم کا اظہار کیا کہ سندھ کے عوام اور نمائندے متحد ہیں اور صوبے سے متعلق فیصلے یہاں کے عوام کی خواہشات کے مطابق ہی ہونے چاہئیں۔

مرتضیٰ وہاب نے مزید کہا کہ سندھ کے عوام نے অতীতে بہت برا وقت دیکھا ہے اور بڑی قربانیوں کے بعد کراچی میں امن و امان بحال ہوا ہے۔ انہوں نے خبردار کیا کہ کوئی بھی ایسی سوچ لوگوں پر مسلط کرنے کی اجازت نہیں دی جائے گی جس سے شہر دوبارہ اسی اسی کی دہائی کے حالات کی طرف واپس جائے۔

اس موقع پر لانڈھی میں کے ایم سی اسپورٹس کمپلیکس کا افتتاح بھی کیا گیا۔ تقریب سے خطاب کرتے ہوئے سکھر کے میئر ارسلان شیخ کا کہنا تھا کہ پاکستان پیپلز پارٹی نئے صوبوں کے قیام کی مطلق مخالف نہیں ہے، لیکن یہ اقدام وہاں ہونے چاہئیں جہاں آئینی تقاضے پورے نہ ہو رہے ہوں اور عوام کے مسائل حل نہ ہوتے ہوں۔ انہوں نے دوہرے معیار اور لسانیت کی دھمکیاں دینے کے رویے کی سخت مذمت کی۔

تقریب اور پریس کانفرنس کے دوران ملک کی دیگر سیاسی صورتحال پر بھی تبادلۂ خیال کیا گیا۔ رہنماؤں نے واضح کیا کہ پیپلز پارٹی نے ہمیشہ شہر میں امن کے قیام کے لیے کام کیا ہے اور سندھ کی ثقافت کا مذاق اڑانے یا دھمکیاں دینے کا سلسلہ اب بند ہونا چاہیے۔

stories.title: نनए صوبوں کی تشکیل پر ریفرنڈم کرانے میں کوئی حرج نہیں ہے، عطاء اللّٰہ تارڑ
stories.summary:
وفاقی وزیرِ اطلاعات عطاء اللّٰہ تارڑ نے کہا ہے کہ نئے صوبوں کی تشکیل کے حوالے سے حکومت کا مؤقف بالکل واضح ہے اور اس معاملے پر براہِ راست عوام کی رائے لی جانی چاہеے۔ الیکشن کمیشن کے باہر میڈیا سے گفتگو کرتے ہوئے انہوں نے کہا کہ اگر عوام نئے صوبوں کے حق میں فیصلہ دیتے ہیں تو صوبے بنا دیے جائیں اور اگر وہ اس کی مخالفت کرتے ہیں تو ایسا نہیں کیا جانا چاہیے۔

عطاء اللّٰہ تارڑ کا کہنا تھا کہ آئین میں قومی اہمیت کے کسی بھی معاملے پر ریفرنڈم کرانے کی واضح شق موجود ہے اور عوامی رائے کا راستہ ہمیشہ ہموار کیا جانا چاہیے۔ انہوں نے اس بات پر زور دیا کہ اس اہم موضوع پر پورے ملک میں بھرپور بحث جاری رہنی چاہیے تاکہ عوام کی حقیقی مرضی سامنے آ سکے اور اسی بنیاد پر حتمی فیصلہ کیا جا سکے۔

اس موقع پر انہوں نے صدرِ مملکت آصف علی زرداری اور وزیرِ اعظم شہباز شریف کے درمیان ہونے والی ملاقات کا بھی ذکر کیا۔ انہوں نے بتایا کہ دونوں رہنماؤں کی ملاقات میں باہمی دلچسپی کے امور اور مختلف معاملات پر افہام و تفہیم کے ساتھ آگے بڑھنے کے عزم کا اعادہ کیا گیا۔

الیکشن کمیشن میں پیشی کے حوالے سے گفتگو کرتے ہوئے وفاقی وزیر نے وضاحت کی کہ گوجرانوالہ کا دورہ انہوں نے ڈسٹرکٹ بار کے جنرل سیکریٹری کی ذاتی دعوت پر کیا تھا، جو کہ انتخابی شیڈول جاری ہونے سے پہلے دی گئی تھی۔ انہوں نے کہا کہ اس تقریب میں کوئی امیدوار موجود نہیں تھا اور وہ اس معاملے پر کمیشن سے غیر مشروط معذرت کر چکے ہیں۔

stories.title: الیکشن کمیشن نے عطاء اللّٰہ تارڑ کے خلاف ضابطۂ اخلاق کیس کا فیصلہ محفوظ کر لیا
stories.summary:
الیکشن کمیشن نے قومی اسمبلی کے حلقہ این اے 77 کے ضمنی انتخابات کے دوران ضابطۂ اخلاق کی مبینہ خلاف ورزی پر وفاقی وزیرِ اطلاعات عطاء اللّٰہ تارڑ کے خلاف کیس کا فیصلہ محفوظ کر لیا ہے۔ چیف الیکشن کمشنر سکندر سلطان راجہ کی سربراہی میں تین رکنی بینچ نے اس کیس کی سماعت کی، جس میں وفاقی وزیر خود بھی کمیشن کے سامنے پیش ہوئے۔

سماعت کے دوران عطاء اللّٰہ تارڑ کے وکیل سجیل سواتی نے عدالت کو بتایا کہ اس دورے کا مقصد قطعی طور پر انتخابی مہم چلانا نہیں تھا بلکہ یہ ایک مکمل طور پر ذاتی دورہ تھا۔ انہوں نے مؤقف اختیار کیا کہ موصوف ایک وکیل کی ذاتی دعوت پر وہاں گئے تھے اور متعلقہ تقریب میں کوئی انتخابی امیدوار بھی موجود نہیں تھا۔

وکیل نے مزید کہا کہ وہ الیکشن کمیشن کا انتہائی احترام کرتے ہیں اور ذمہ دار ارکانِ پارلمان کی حیثیت سے ضابطۂ اخلاق کی خلاف ورزی کا سوچ بھی نہیں سکتے۔ اس سلسلے میں تحریری جواب پہلے ہی جمع کروایا جا چکا ہے جبکہ غیر مشروط معذرت کرتے ہوئے معاملے کو کمیشن کے رحم و کرم پر چھوڑا جاتا ہے۔

چیف الیکشن کمشنر نے ریمارکس دیے کہ تسلیم کیا کہ آپ وکیل کی دعوت پر گئے تھے، لیکن آپ ایک وفاقی وزیر کا منصب بھی رکھتے ہیں۔ فریقین کے دلائل سننے کے بعد الیکشن کمیشن نے اس کیس کا فیصلہ محفوظ کرنے کا اعلان کر دیا۔

stories.title: Field Marshal Asim Munir Evaluates Security Situation During North Waziristan Visit
stories.summary:
Chief of Defence Forces Field Marshal Syed Asim Munir traveled to Miranshah in North Waziristan for an official visit, as reported by the Inter-Services Public Relations (ISPR) on Friday. Upon arriving at the location, the Field Marshal visited the Martyrs' Memorial to lay a floral wreath and honor the military personnel who lost their lives defending the nation. The visit focused on reviewing regional security and evaluating ongoing military strategies in the area.

During his tour, Field Marshal Asim Munir received a comprehensive briefing regarding the prevailing security conditions, intelligence-based operations, and counterterrorism measures currently underway. The discussions also addressed initiatives aimed at solidifying the strategic gains achieved through sustained military campaigns against terrorism. The Corps Commander Peshawar formally received the Field Marshal upon his arrival in Miranshah.

Field Marshal Asim Munir took the opportunity to interact directly with officers and soldiers, commending their professionalism, high morale, and steadfast dedication to Pakistan's security. He additionally praised the courage and sacrifices of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Police, calling them a frontline institution in the fight against terrorism. He expressed pride in the force's resilience and stressed that enhanced coordination among all law enforcement agencies will ensure the complete eradication of terrorism.

Prior to this visit, the Field Marshal traveled to Turbat, where he reviewed operational readiness, the security environment, and foreign-sponsored counterterrorism efforts. During that trip, he was also briefed on socio-economic development projects designed to improve the welfare of the people of Balochistan. Across both engagements, he reaffirmed the military's commitment to maintaining peace, stability, and territorial integrity under challenging conditions.

stories.title: Pakistan Strongly Condemns Houthi Militia Attack in Saudi Arabia
stories.summary:
