During a prior session, the electoral authority resummoned seven respondents alongside Tarar, including Sardar Ghias Gul, the former chief of Gujranwala Police who has since been transferred to Rawalpindi. Other resummoned individuals feature lawmaker-elect Raashid Bashir Virk, Gujranwala Deputy Commissioner Naveed Ahmad, District Monitoring Officer Syed Basit Ali, Returning Officer Sumaira Ambreen, Punjab Parliamentary Secretary Health Asma Naz Abbasi, and Punjab Assembly committee chairperson Qudsia Batool.

Controversy arose prior to the NA-77 poll when the ECP flagged media reports indicating that the information minister had arrived in the constituency via helicopter and participated in a public gathering. The election body's code of conduct strictly prohibits government functionaries from visiting active electoral constituencies once a polling schedule is notified, prompting the ECP to summon Tarar personally and warn that the election results could potentially be withheld.

Tensions escalated when Tarar failed to attend a previous hearing, drawing sharp warnings from the Chief Election Commissioner regarding the consequences of ignoring official directives. Meanwhile, the ECP officially notified Pakistan Muslim League Nawaz candidate Raashid Bashir Virk as the winner of the NA-77 seat, which had become vacant following the September 11 passing of his father, Mahmood Bashir Virk.

stories.title: Ten Fatally Injured in Bus and Gas Tanker Collision in Gwadar
stories.summary:
A collision between a passenger bus and a gas tanker along the Makran Coastal Highway near Gwadar resulted in ten fatalities and twenty-seven injuries. The impact of the crash sparked an intense fire that quickly engulfed both vehicles, trapping occupants and causing severe concern among witnesses who reported hearing the screams of women and children inside the bus.

Emergency response teams, including police, the Ormara Municipal Committee fire brigade, and various rescue units, rushed to the scene. Firefighters managed to bring the raging flames under control while rescue personnel worked to evacuate all individuals from the wreckage. Authorities confirmed that eight of the deceased were recovered from the passenger bus, while two bodies were retrieved from the gas tanker. Ormara Deputy Superintendent of Police Nabi Bakhsh Ronjha stated that all the victims lost their lives due to burn injuries.

The passenger bus was traveling from Turbat to Karachi when the crash occurred on the coastal highway. Following the initial emergency response, SP Aslam Bangulzai noted that teams were rapidly dispatched to handle the crisis. All twenty-seven injured individuals were rescued and transported to nearby hospitals for urgent medical treatment.

The devastating accident caused major disruptions along the Makran Coastal Highway. Traffic came to a standstill, leaving long lines of vehicles stranded in both directions while emergency crews cleared the site and managed the aftermath of the disaster.

stories.title: Port Qasim Receives Six Vessels Transporting Liquefied Petroleum Gas
stories.summary:
Six cargo vessels carrying a cumulative total of 55,417 metric tonnes of Liquefied Petroleum Gas arrived at Port Qasim over a six-day period from November 12 to November 18, according to data released by the Port Qasim Authority.

The largest shipments arrived during the latter half of the tracked timeframe. The vessel Seashine docked late Wednesday at 8:30 pm with 21,866 metric tonnes, while Pacific Star 1 arrived the previous day at 9:00 pm carrying 20,115 metric tonnes. Combined, these two large carriers made up approximately 76 percent of the total LPG volume imported during the week.

Earlier arrivals at the port included the Gas RGA, which docked on November 12 at 9:45 pm with 1,621 metric tonnes. Victoria Kosan arrived two days later at 10:48 pm carrying 4,387 metric tonnes.

The final two ships of the period arrived on November 17. Leonara Kosan docked at 1:54 am with 3,877 metric tonnes, and Alisa 1 berthed later that morning at 10:42 am with 3,551 metric tonnes of the fuel.

stories.title: کراچی کے علاقے لانڈھی میں گھریلو تنازع پر فائرنگ سے تین افراد ہلاک
stories.summary:
کراچی کے علاقے لانڈھی اولڈ مظفر آباد کے قریب ایک گھر میں پیش آنے والے فائرنگ کے واقعے میں خاتون سمیت تین افراد جاں بحق ہو گئے۔ ایدھی ترجمان کے مطابق جاں بحق ہونے والوں میں میاں بیوی اور خاتون کا بھائی شامل ہیں۔

پولیس اور قائد آباد پولیس کے مطابق ملزم ناصر احمد نے شاہ لطیف ٹاؤن سے آکر مظفر آباد کالونی میں اپنے سسرال کے اندر فائرنگ کی۔ فائرنگ کے نتیجے میں اس کی بیوی اسماء اور سالے محمد احسن موقع پر جاں بحق ہو گئے۔ اس کے بعد ملزم نے خود کو بھی گولی مار کر خودکشی کر لی، اور موقع سے ایک پستول برآمد کیا گیا۔

واقعے کی اطلاع ملتے ہی پولیس اور کرائم سین یونٹ فوری طور پر موقع پر پہنچ گئے۔ پولیس حکام نے تینوں لاشوں کو جناح اسپتال منتقل کر دیا ہے اور واقعے کی مزید تفتیش کا آغاز کر دیا گیا ہے۔

پولیس کے مطابق میاں بیوی کی شادی پندره سال قبل ہوئی تھی تاہم گزشتہ کچھ دنوں سے ان کے درمیان علیحدگی چل رہی تھی۔ جاں بحق ہونے والی خاتون اسماء نے خلع کے لیے عدالت سے رجوع کر رکھا تھا اور وہ ان دنوں اپنے والدین کے گھر مقیم تھیں۔

stories.title: پاکستان نے ریاض میں کنگ عبداللہ فنانشل ڈسٹرکٹ پر حوثی حملے کی مذمت کی
stories.summary:
پاکستان نے دارالحکومت ریاض میں واقع کنگ عبداللہ فنانشل ڈسٹرکٹ کے ایک ٹاور پر حوثی ملیشیا کی جانب سے کیے جانے والے حملے کی شدید الفاظ میں مذمت کی ہے۔ ترجمان دفتر خارجہ کے مطابق یہ جارحانہ کارروائی سعودی عرب کی خودمختاری کی سنگین خلاف ورزی ہے۔

دفتر خارجہ کے ترجمان نے اپنے بیان میں کہا ہے کہ حکومت اور عوام کی جانب سے سعودی عرب کے ساتھ مکمل یکجہتی کا اظہار کیا جاتا ہے۔ شہری بنیادی ڈھانچے اور اقتصادی تنصیبات کو مسلسل نشانہ بنانے کے سنگین نتائج برآمد ہوتے ہیں۔

ترجمان نے اس عزم کا اعادہ کیا کہ ایسے حملے بے گناہ افراد کی زندگیوں کو خطرے میں ڈالتے ہیں اور اس سے علاقائی امن و سلامتی کو بھی شدید خطرات لاحق ہوتے ہیں، اس لیے اس قسم کے قابل مذمت حملوں کا فوری خاتمہ ہونا ضروری ہے۔

بیان میں مزید کہا گیا ہے کہ پاکستان سعودی عرب کے اپنی خودمختاری، سالمیت کے دفاع اور اپنے شہریوں و مقیم افراد کے تحفظ کے جائز حق کی مکمل حمایت کرتا ہے۔ پاکستان خطے میں پائیدار امن اور استحکام کے قیام کی کوششیں جاری رکھے گا۔

stories.title: سہولیات کے فقدان پر عوامی تنقید، ملک بھر میں نئے صوبوں کا مطالبہ
stories.summary:
پاکستان بھر کے شہریوں نے ناقص کارکردگی اور بنیادی سہولیات کی عدم فراہمی پر شدید تنقید کرتے ہوئے ملک میں نئے انتظامی یونٹس کے قیام کا پرزور مطالبہ کیا ہے۔ کراچی، کوئٹہ، مانسہرہ اور ایبٹ آباد سمیت مختلف علاقوں کے شہریوں نے اس اقدام کی حمایت کی ہے۔

شہریوں کا کہنا ہے کہ ملک میں مہنگائی، بے روزگاری اور بدانتظامی عروج پر ہے اور آج بھی بنیادی سہولیات کا شدید فقدان پایا جاتا ہے۔ بڑھتی ہوئی آبادی اور بڑھتے ہوئے مسائل کے باعث اب موجودہ صوبوں سے نظام چلانا مشکل ہو چکا ہے، اس لیے ملک کو چھوٹے انتظامی یونٹس میں تقسیم کرنا ناگزیر ہو گیا ہے۔

عوام کا یہ بھی ماننا ہے کہ نئے صوبے بننے سے دور افتادہ علاقوں پر یکساں توجہ دی جا سکے گی اور ترقی کی راہیں کھلیں گی۔ اس سے مقامی وسائل مقامی افراد تک پہنچیں گے اور نوجوانوں کے لیے روزگار کے نئے مواقع بھی پیدا ہوں گے۔

شہریوں کے مطابق چھوٹے صوبوں کے قیام سے تعلیم، روزگار اور صحت جیسی بنیادی سہولیات ملک کے ہر شہر اور ہر فرد تک آسانی سے پہنچائی جا سکیں گی، جس سے بدانتظامی کے خاتمے میں بھی مدد ملے گی۔

stories.title: راولپنڈی ٹیسٹ: سری لنکا کا دوسری اننگز میں 316 رنز پر خاتمہ، پاکستان کو 90 رنز کا ہدف
stories.summary:
راولپنڈی میں کھیلے جانے والے ٹیسٹ میچ کے چوتھے روز سری لنکن ٹیم اپنی دوسری اننگز میں 316 رنز بنا کر آؤٹ ہوگئی، جس کے بعد میزبان ٹیم کو سیریز میں فتح حاصل کرنے کے لیے 90 رنز کا ہدف ملا ہے۔ چوتھے روز کے آغاز پر سری لنکا نے 309 رنز پر نو کھلاڑی آؤٹ کے ساتھ کھیل دوبارہ شروع کیا تھا، تاہم دن کے دوسرے ہی اوور میں محمد عباس نے اسیتھا فرنانڈو کو ایل بی ڈبلیو کر کے آخری وکٹ حاصل کی۔

مہمان ٹیم کی دوسری اننگز میں ملن رتھنائیکے نے 66 رنز کی ناقابل شکست اننگز کھیلی، جبکہ سونل دینوشا اور کوشال مینڈس بالترتیب 54 اور 53 رنز بنا کر نمایاں بلے باز رہے۔ پاکستان کی بولنگ سائیڈ کی طرف سے عامر جمال اور محمد عباس نے تین تین کھلاڑیوں کو آؤٹ کیا۔ اس کے علاوہ رضا اللہ نے دو جبکہ ثاقب خان اور سلمان علی آغا نے ایک ایک وکٹ اپنے نام کی۔

میچ کے ابتدائی مراحل میں سری لنکا کی پہلی اننگز صرف 98 رنز پر سمٹ گئی تھی، جس کے جواب میں پاکستانی ٹیم نے 325 رنز بنا کر تمام کھلاڑیوں کے آؤٹ ہونے پر 227 رنز کی بڑی برتری حاصل کی تھی۔ پاکستان کی پہلی اننگز میں غازی غوری نے 54، اذان اویس نے 47، طیب عارف نے 46 اور رضااللہ نے 42 رنز اسکور کیے تھے۔

پہلی اننگز میں سری لنکا کی جانب سے بولنگ کرتے ہوئے لاہیرو کمارا نے پانچ وکٹیں حاصل کی تھیں۔ اس کے علاوہ اسیتھا فرنانڈو نے تین، جبکہ ملن رتھنائیکے اور پرباتھ جے سوریا نے ایک ایک وکٹ حاصل کی تھی۔ اس میچ میں کامیابی حاصل کرنے کی صورت میں پاکستانی ٹیم کے لیے ہدف کا حصول اہمیت رکھتا ہے۔

stories.title: Ben Shelton Reaches ATP Finals Semifinals as Arthur Fils Exits
stories.summary:
American tennis player Ben Shelton secured his place in the ATP Finals semifinals on Thursday at the Inalpi Arena in Turin, Italy. Earlier in the day, the 24-year-old defeated Spain's Rafael Jodar with scores of 7-6 (10/8), 7-5 in their John McEnroe Group encounter. Jodar, a 20-year-old newcomer ranked 10th from Spain, held two set points during the opening set tie-break and later fought back from deficits in the second set before ultimately falling to his third defeat of the week in his debut at the elite season-ending tournament.

Shelton's progression to the final four was confirmed later when world number one Alexander Zverev defeated France's Arthur Fils in straight sets, winning 6-4, 7-6 (8/6) in 35 minutes for the first set. Zverev has not dropped a set in Turin and is guaranteed to win the group, putting him through alongside Shelton and Carlos Alcaraz. Zverev acknowledged battling a lingering ankle injury stemming from a 2022 French Open ligament tear, stating he will work with his physio and team to be ready for Saturday's match against the runner-up of Friday's fixture between Daniil Medvedev and Frances Tiafoe.

Meanwhile, world number three Carlos Alcaraz awaited the outcome of an MRI scan on Thursday following a hamstring injury sustained during his Wednesday victory over Russia's Daniil Medvedev. Alcaraz has also reached the tournament's final four with assistance from Tiafoe.

Reflecting on his match, Shelton praised Jodar as a formidable competitor possessing numerous weapons, while expressing satisfaction at overcoming difficult moments during the first set. Jodar expressed immense pride in his breakthrough season performance, emphasizing the high level of consistency required to compete against the world's top players.

stories.title: Pakistani Leaders Vow Dialogue Amid Political Tensions Over New Provinces
stories.summary:
Pakistan President Asif Ali Zardari and Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif agreed on Thursday to resolve all national issues through consultation and dialogue. The high-level meeting took place at the Aiwan-e-Sadr in Islamabad against the backdrop of rising political friction surrounding a recent debate over the creation of new administrative provinces.

The presidency stated that the leaders reviewed the overall national situation, the political landscape, and Middle East developments. The renewed commitment to consultation follows sharp remarks from Pakistan Peoples Party (PPP) Chairman Bilawal Bhutto-Zardari, who criticized federal ministers and opposed any forced division of Sindh, warning of severe unrest.

Federal ministers, including Minister of State for Interior Talal Chaudhry, responded by defending the necessity of governance reforms while emphasizing that all major decisions require consensus among allied parties. Chaudhry noted that the ruling coalition has historically made all legislative and administrative moves through joint committees and democratic processes.

Despite the friction, Bilawal has affirmed his continued support for Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif's government, stressing that the public expects leaders to prioritize economic solutions. The meeting between Zardari and Sharif underscores the ruling coalition's intent to manage internal disagreements democratically and prevent further escalation.

stories.title: پنجاب میں فضائی آلودگی خطرناک سطح پر، لاہور دنیا میں سرفہرست
stories.summary:
پنجاب بھر میں فضائی آلودگی کی صورتحال انتہائی سنگین شکل اختیار کر گئی ہے اور مختلف شہروں میں ایئر کوالٹی انڈیکس خطرناک حد کو چھو رہا ہے۔ عالمی درجہ بندی فراہم کرنے والے ادارے آئی کیو ایئر کے مطابق لاہور 368 اے کیو آئی کے ساتھ دنیا بھر کے شہروں میں پہلے نمبر پر رہا۔ اس کے علاوہ گوجرانوالہ میں آلودگی کی شرح 562 اور ملتان میں 524 ریکارڈ کی گئی ہے، جو شہریوں کی صحت کے لیے شدید خطرے کی علامت ہے۔

صوبائی ایئر کوالٹی ڈیش بورڈ کے اعداد و شمار کے مطابق صبح کے وقت جھنگ کا اے کیو آئی 441 اور لاہور کا 402 ریکارڈ کیا گیا۔ اس کے علاوہ شیخوپورہ میں 381، پاکپتن میں 356 اور ساہیوال میں 348 اے کیو آئی کے ساتھ صوبے کے آلودہ ترین شہروں میں شمار ہوئے۔ لاہور کے مقامی علاقوں میں بھی صورتحال انتہائی تشویشناک رہی جہاں ملتان روڈ، ڈی ایچ اے فیز 6 اور جی ٹی روڈ پر ایئر کوالٹی انڈیکس 500 تک جا پہنچا۔ اس کے علاوہ فیصل آباد میں 686 اور گوجرانوالہ میں 550 اے کیو آئی ریکارڈ کیا گیا۔

فضائی آلودگی میں اس خطرناک اضافے کی وجہ سے عام شہریوں بالخصوص بچوں، بزرگوں اور سانس کی بیماریوں میں مبتلا افراد کو شدید طبی خطرات لاحق ہو گئے ہیں۔ محکمہ صحت اور ماہرین نے ایسے تمام افراد کو گھروں میں رہنے اور شدید احتیاطی تدابیر اختیار کرنے کی ہدایت کی ہے تاکہ زہر آلود فضا کے مضر اثرات سے بچا جا سکے۔

stories.title: JPMorgan, Visa, and Mastercard Reveal Third-Party Vendor Cyberattacks
stories.summary:
JPMorgan Chase announced on Thursday that third-party service providers were targeted in a cyberattack, potentially exposing customer names and email addresses. A JPMorgan spokesperson stated that the company is investigating the incident and will contact affected customers directly. The bank clarified that this breach is unrelated to a software bug earlier in the week that caused transaction processing disruptions across multiple lenders.

In related developments, a cyber extortion group named "n0n" claimed responsibility on November 16 for acquiring cardmember records and data from Visa and Mastercard. A Visa spokesperson confirmed awareness of the claims, linking them to an Asia-Pacific third-party service provider while emphasizing that Visa's own systems and payment data, such as card numbers, remained unaffected. Similarly, a Mastercard spokesperson reported a limited exposure of email addresses for a small subset of cardholders enrolled in a specific benefit program at a third-party provider, noting no impact on the Mastercard payment network.

The compromised data attributed to these incidents includes marketing campaign details, phone numbers, postal codes, and employee email addresses from various global regions. The hacking group n0n has allegedly claimed approximately 200 incidents since emerging in September 2026. Experts note that these events highlight significant reputational risks for financial institutions, as customers often do not distinguish between a bank and its external vendors during a cyber incident.

stories.title: ملک کے مفاد میں بہتر فیصلہ ہو گا، طارق فضل چودھری
stories.summary:
وفاقی وزیر برائے پارلیمانی امور ڈاکٹر طارق فضل چودھری نے ایک بیان میں امید ظاہر کی ہے کہ صدر آصف زرداری اور وزیر اعظم شہباز شریف کی ملاقات کے بعد ملک کے مفاد میں مثبت فیصلے سامنے آئیں گے۔ انہوں نے واضح کیا کہ ریفرنڈم آئین میں ایک قانونی آپشن ہے جس کے ذریعے کسی متنازع معاملے پر براہِ راست عوامی رائے لی جا سکتی ہے، لیکن اس سے انتخابات کا مؤقف تبدیل نہیں ہوتا۔ ان کا کہنا تھا کہ موجودہ حکومت اپنی آئینی مدت پوری کرے گی اور مقررہ وقت پر ہی انتخابات کروائے جائیں گے۔

اس دوران سیاسی اور حکومتی امور کے حوالے سے مختلف شخصیات کے بیانات اور سرگرمیاں بھی سامنے آئی ہیں۔ رہنما پاکستان پیپلز پارٹی اور دیگر رہنماؤں نے مخصوص نشستوں اور قانون سازی پر ہونے والی مشاورت کا ذکر کیا۔ سندھ بلڈنگ کنٹرول اتھارٹی نے لیاقت آباد میں ایک عمارت کی غیر قانونی تعمیر کے معاملے پر مؤقف پیش کیا جبکہ بحیرہ عرب میں اسمگلنگ کی روک تھام کے لیے پاک بحریہ، میری ٹائم سیکیورٹی ایجنسی اور اے این ایف کی مشترکہ کارروائی عمل میں آئی۔

راولپنڈی اور لاہور کے حلقوں میں اہم ملاقاتیں اور عدلیہ کی کارروائیاں بھی جاری رہیں۔ جی ایچ کیو میں فیلڈ مارشل سید عاصم منیر سے قطر کے وزیر داخلہ شیخ خلیفہ بن حمد بن خلیفہ الثانی نے ملاقات کی، جس میں منشیات کے کیسز میں تعاون اور مختلف شعبوں میں اشتراکِ عمل پر گفتگو کی گئی۔ دریں اثنا، کوٹ لکھپت جیل لاہور میں قید پی ٹی آئی کی قیادت نے چیف جسٹس آف پاکستان اور چیف جسٹس اسلام آباد ہائیکورٹ کو ایک مشترکہ خط ارسال کیا جس میں سیاسی اسیران کے مقدمات پر تحفظات کا اظہار کیا گیا۔

مقدمات کی سماعت کے دوران پراسیکیوٹر نوید حسین نے عدالت کو بتایا کہ اس مقدمے میں اب تک سولہ گواہان کے بیانات ریکارڈ کیے جا چکے ہیں۔ دوسری جانب، کابینہ ڈویژن کے سیکریٹری نے ملک کو درپیش بحرانوں میں ڈیجیٹائزیشن کے فقدان کو ایک بڑی رکاوٹ قرار دیا۔ مہاجر قومی موومنٹ کے چیئرمین آفاق احمد نے بھی جنوبی سندھ صوبے کے قیام کو اپنی جماعت کا دیرینہ مطالبہ قرار دیا۔

stories.title: Trump Discloses Nvidia and SpaceX Stock Trades Made in September
stories.summary:
US President Donald Trump purchased between $200,000 and $265,000 worth of Nvidia stock and sold up to $15,000 in September, according to a financial disclosure released on Thursday. The transactions occurred shortly before media reports emerged regarding alleged ties between Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and a Chinese spy. These trades follow previous disclosures showing Trump bought up to $1.6 million and sold up to $1 million in Nvidia shares in August.

The financial disclosure, signed by Trump on November 1 and made public by the US Office of Government Ethics, also revealed that the president bought up to $315,000 in SpaceX stock in September. SpaceX is a US military contractor led by Elon Musk, a former adviser to Trump, and maintains substantial government contracts tied to federal agency approvals.

White House spokesperson Davis Ingle stated that third-party financial institutions independently manage the president's portfolio by replicating recognized indexes like the Schwab 1000. Ingle emphasized that neither Trump nor his family members possess the ability to direct or influence investment decisions or timing.

The disclosures arrive as the Trump administration weighs policies concerning advanced chip export rules for Nvidia, the world's leading maker of AI chips. Washington has increasingly sought to limit China's access to advanced computing technology to prevent its use in weapon development, while Chinese entities continue to seek access through third-party countries like Southeast Asian nations.

stories.title: Pakistan PM Credits Civil-Military Coordination for Economic Progress
stories.summary:
Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif stated on Thursday that strong coordination between Pakistan's political and military leadership has fostered valuable opportunities for economic growth. Addressing the Pakistan-American Business Council (PABC), the premier emphasized that export-led growth is the sole sustainable path forward for the country's economy.

Hurrying to reassure domestic and foreign investors, Sharif highlighted improvements in key economic indicators. He noted that Pakistan's total foreign exchange reserves have risen to approximately $27 billion, inflation has dropped to 11.5% from a previous high of 32%, and the policy rate has been reduced to 12% from 23.5%. These gains reflect fiscal discipline and collective efforts following a severe threat of default in 2023.

The prime minister also outlined government initiatives aimed at empowering the private sector, streamlining export financing, and promoting electric vehicles to reduce fuel import dependence. He noted that agricultural sectors, including livestock, are being reformed with international consultants to transform the economy, while direct digital cash transfers have replaced outdated welfare distribution systems.

Leaders of the business council expressed strong investor confidence, noting that participating American companies have generated substantial cumulative revenues and capital investments over the past five years. Sharif assured investors that his administration remains dedicated to eliminating bureaucratic hurdles and addressing genuine grievances swiftly.

stories.title: پیرس ایئرپورٹ پر مشتبہ ڈرون کی اطلاع، پروازوں کا آپریشن عارضی معطل
stories.summary:
فرانس کے پیرس ایئرپورٹ پر فضائی حدود میں مشتبہ ڈرون کی موجودگی کی اطلاع ملنے کے بعد تمام پروازوں کی آمد و رفت کو عارضی طور پر روک دیا گیا۔ اس واقعے کے نتیجے میں مسافروں اور مختلف ایئرلائنز کو شدید پریشانی کا سامنا کرنا پڑا۔

حکام کو جیسے ہی ایئرپورٹ کے اوپر ڈرون دیکھے جانے کی اطلاع موصول ہوئی، انہوں نے فوری طور پر حفاظتی اقدامات نافذ کیے۔ ممکنہ خطرے کے پیش نظر ایئرپورٹ کی فضائی حدود اور اس کے اردگرد کے علاقوں میں تفصیلی سیکیورٹی چیکنگ کا آغاز کیا گیا۔

کلیئرنس ملنے کے بعد حکام نے کچھ ہی دیر میں پروازوں کا معمول کا آپریشن بحال کردیا۔ واضح رہے کہ فرانسیسی قوانین کے تحت ہوائی اڈوں اور حساس تنصیبات کے قریب بغیر اجازت ڈرون اڑانے پر سخت پابندی عائد ہے کیونکہ یہ طیاروں کی لینڈنگ اور ٹیک آف کے دوران بڑے حادثات کا سبب بن سکتے ہیں۔

ایئرپورٹ حکام نے اس واقعے کی باقاعدہ تحقیقات شروع کر دی ہیں۔ تاہم، جاری کردہ ابتدائی رپورٹ میں مشتبہ ڈرون یا اسے آپریٹ کرنے والے فرد کے حوالے سے مزید کوئی تفصیلات سامنے نہیں آ سکیں ہیں۔

stories.title: Global Leaders Issue Symbolic Peace Declaration at Historic Shenzhen Summit
stories.summary:
Chinese President Xi Jinping, US President Donald Trump, and Russian President Vladimir Putin convened for an unprecedented three-way summit in Shenzhen, China, on Thursday. During the meeting, the leaders issued a symbolic "peace declaration" reaffirming that a nuclear war cannot be won and must never be fought, though the agreement contained no formal arms-control commitments or reductions of nuclear arsenals. The three powers agreed to maintain dialogue on reducing nuclear risks and preventing proliferation without setting a specific timeline.

The declaration also addressed broader geopolitical issues, including pledges to advance United Nations reforms, increase fuel product supplies, and uphold the immunity of state officials in international courts. Notably, the document omitted any reference to Russia's ongoing war in Ukraine or the conflict with Iran. Putin described the summit as beneficial for addressing regional conflicts and gaining diplomatic credibility, while analysts noted the meeting caused unease among smaller nations and US European allies.

The summit concluded shortly before European leaders and Ukrainian officials were scheduled to meet Trump's envoys, Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner, in Berlin. Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andriy Sybiha criticized the meeting's outcomes, asserting that Russia must end the war. Meanwhile, Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi maintained a distanced presence at the broader gathering following ongoing diplomatic friction with China over Taiwan.

The historic venue, Kylin Villa, has previously hosted sensitive diplomatic encounters. The trilateral meeting followed individual bilateral discussions held by Trump with both Xi and Putin during his three-day diplomatic tour across Asia.

stories.title: مسلم لیگ ن کا نئے صوبوں پر اتفاق رائے کے لیے سیاسی کمیٹی بنانے کا فیصلہ
stories.summary:
مسلم لیگ ن کی قیادت نے ملک کی موجودہ سیاسی صورتحال، نئے انتظامی یونٹس اور صوبوں کے قیام کے معاملے پر تمام پارلیمانی جماعتوں سے رابطہ کرنے کا فیصلہ کیا ہے۔ اس مقصد کے لیے ایک رابطہ کار سیاسی کمیٹی تشکیل دی جائے گی۔

یہ خصوصی کمیٹی پاکستان پیپلز پارٹی اور ایم کیو ایم پاکستان سمیت تمام پارلیمانی جماعتوں سے رابطے کرے گی۔ پارٹی ذرائع کے مطابق مرکزی قیادت آئندہ مجوزہ آئینی ترمیم، نئے صوبوں کے قیام، آئینی و قانونی امور اور ممکنہ عوامی ریفرنڈم کے معاملات کا باریک بینی سے جائزہ لے رہی ہے۔

ان تمام امور پر بحث کے لیے وفاقی حکومت کی جانب سے ایک قومی سیاسی کانفرنس بھی منعقد کی جا سکتی ہے، جس کے بعد اس لائحہ عمل کو پارلیمان میں پیش کیا جائے گا۔ اگر تمام فریقین میں اتفاق رائے پیدا ہو گیا تو ایک پارلیمانی کمیٹی تشکیل دے کر آئینی امور کو حتمی شکل دی جائے گی۔

اس پوری مشق کا مقصد ملک سے دہشت گردی کے خاتمے اور معیشت کو مضبوط بنانے کے لیے ایک مشترکہ حکمت عملی وضع کرنا ہے۔ سیاسی رابطوں کے دوران نئے صوبوں کے مجوزہ خاکے اور بلدیاتی نظام کے قیام کے معاملات بھی زیر غور لائے جائیں گے۔

stories.title: Anthropic Reaches $2 Trillion Valuation After Record $81.3 Billion IPO
stories.summary:
Anthropic debuted on the Nasdaq exchange at a $2 trillion valuation on Thursday after raising $81.3 billion in the largest stock-market listing in history. The AI lab, known for developing the Claude chatbot, priced its shares above the marketed range, making it the first publicly traded frontier artificial intelligence company. The milestone reflects intense investor demand for advanced AI technology following years of rapid sector growth and massive funding rounds.

The company's journey to the public market included significant financial backing from major technology players. Anthropic raised capital through multiple funding stages, including a $450 million investment involving Alphabet's Google and Spark Capital, up to $4 billion in cash commitments from Amazon.com, and an agreement for up to $2 billion from Google. Its valuation surged through successive rounds, reaching $380 billion before a subsequent $65 billion round valued the company at $965 billion ahead of its initial public offering.

Anthropic's rapid expansion also encountered legal and political friction. The startup faced a class-action lawsuit from authors alleging the misuse of books to train Claude, which culminated in a landmark $1.5 billion settlement approved by a federal judge in San Francisco. Additionally, the company navigated tensions with the US military after the Trump administration directed agencies to halt work with Anthropic and designated it a supply-chain risk, prompting Anthropic to file a lawsuit to block the national security blacklist.

Structured as a public benefit corporation, Anthropic is legally required to balance broader public interests with profitability. The record-breaking IPO establishes the firm as a dominant publicly traded force in the artificial intelligence industry, outperforming early institutional interest seen in other major listings.

stories.title: سابق وفاقی وزیر لیاقت عباس بھٹی کے قتل پر محافظوں سمیت 11 افراد کیخلاف مقدمہ
stories.summary:
حافظ آباد میں سابق وفاقی وزیر لیاقت عباس بھٹی کے قتل کے معاملے میں ایک بڑا انکشاف سامنے آیا ہے جہاں ان کے اپنے محافظ ہی مبینہ قاتل نکلے۔ پولیس نے اس بہیمانہ واقعے پر چار نامزد ملزمان سمیت کل 11 افراد کے خلاف قتل اور ڈکیتی کا مقدمہ درج کر لیا ہے۔

مقدمہ مقتول کے بھتیجے اور پنجاب اسمبلی کے رکن ضمیر الحسن بھٹی کی مدعیت میں درج کیا گیا۔ ایف آئی آر میں الزام عائد کیا گیا ہے کہ ملزمان نے لیاقت عباس بھٹی کو رسیوں سے باندھ کر گلا گھونٹ کر قتل کیا اور گھر سے 20 لاکھ روپے نقدی، 50 تولے طلائی زیورات، اے ٹی ایم کارڈ اور قیمتی دستاویزات لے کر فرار ہو گئے۔ نامزد ملزمان میں زاہد علی اور فرحان علی شامل ہیں جن کا تعلق ضلع صوابی سے بتایا گیا ہے، جبکہ ملزمان مقتول کی پراڈو، لینڈ کروزر اور ویگو ڈالا گاڑیاں بھی اپنے ساتھ لے گئے۔

ڈی پی او حافظ آباد فواد احمد کا کہنا ہے کہ ملزمان کی گرفتاری کے لیے مختلف مقامات پر چھاپے مارے جا رہے ہیں اور جائے وقوعہ سے ملنے والے شواہد کی روشنی میں جدید ٹیکنالوجی کی مدد سے تفتیش جاری ہے۔ لیاقت عباس بھٹی مسلم لیگ ق کے دور حکومت میں وفاقی وزیر رہے تھے اور دو مرتبہ رکن قومی اسمبلی اور ایک مرتبہ رکن پنجاب اسمبلی منتخب ہوئے تھے۔

مقتول کے دیگر عزیزوں میں سابق ارکان قومی اسمبلی مہدی حسن بھٹی اور شوکت علی بھٹی کے علاوہ پی ٹی آئی کی ایم این اے انیقہ مہدی حسن اور ایم پی اے ضمیر الحسن بھٹی شامل ہیں۔ مقتول کی نماز جنازہ آج سہ پہر تین بجے ان کے آبائی گاؤں برجدارا میں ادا کی جائے گی۔

stories.title: کراچی میں پولیس کے دو مبینہ مقابلے، تین زخمیوں سمیت پانچ ملزمان گرفتار
stories.summary:
کراچی کے مختلف علاقوں میں پولیس اور مبینہ ڈاکوؤں کے درمیان دو الگ الگ پولیس مقابلوں کے دوران تین زخمیوں سمیت پانچ ملزمان کو گرفتار کر لیا گیا۔ گرفتار کیے گئے ملزمان کے قبضے سے اسلحہ، موبائل فونز اور موٹرسائیکلیں برآمد کی گئی ہیں۔

پہلا مقابلہ تیموریہ پولیس اور ڈاکوؤں کے درمیان نارتھ ناظم آباد بلاک این میں واقع ڈینٹل کالج کے قریب پیش آیا، جہاں فائرنگ کے تبادلے کے بعد ایک زخمی سمیت دو ملزمان کو گرفتار کیا گیا۔ زخمی ملزم کی شناخت تیس سالہ احسن عباسی کے طور پر ہوئی جسے عباسی شہید اسپتال منتقل کیا گیا، جبکہ دوسرے ملزم احمد شجا کو تھانے منتقل کیا گیا۔ پولیس کے مطابق یہ ملزمان اسٹریٹ کرائم کی متعدد وارداتوں میں ملوث ہیں اور ان کا سابقہ کریمنل ریکارڈ بھی موجود ہے۔ ان کے قبضے سے اسلحہ، تین موبائل فون اور تیموریہ سے چوری شدہ موٹرسائیکل ملی ہے۔

دوسرا مقابلہ شارع نورجہاں پولیس اور ڈاکوؤں کے درمیان شادمان ٹاؤن سیکٹر چودہ بی میں ہوا جس کے نتیجے میں دو زخمیوں سمیت تین ملزمان گرفتار ہوئے۔ زخمی ملزمان کی شناخت آصف اور شایان کے ناموں سے ہوئی جنہیں اسپتال منتقل کیا گیا، جبکہ تیسرے ملزم کبیر کو تھانے منتقل کیا گیا۔

ابتدائی تفتیش سے انکشاف ہوا ہے کہ ان ملزمان نے گزشتہ روز حیدری مارکیٹ اور نارتھ ناظم آباد سے موٹرسائیکلیں چھینی تھیں، جبکہ برآمد ہونے والا ایک موبائل فون نو روز قبل احمد نامی شہری سے چھینا گیا تھا۔ پولیس دونوں واقعات میں گرفتار ملزمان سے مزید تفتیش کر رہی ہے اور برآمد شدہ سامان کے حوالے سے ریکارڈ چیک کیا جا رہا ہے۔

stories.title: Washington Spirit Set to Face Kansas City Current in NWSL Final
stories.summary:
The Washington Spirit are preparing to host the Kansas City Current in the National Women's Soccer League championship game on Saturday. Both teams are aiming to put recent playoff disappointments behind them, with Washington having finished as runners-up in each of the last two seasons, losing the 2024 final to the Orlando Pride and being defeated by Gotham FC the following year. The Spirit secured home-field advantage because the championship venue was awarded to Washington well before the finalists were determined. They will compete against a strong Current squad that recorded a league-leading 54 regular-season goals and reached the playoffs for the fourth time in six years while chasing their first trophy.

Washington's attack is spearheaded by star striker Trinity Rodman, who tallied 14 goals and 10 assists across the regular season and playoffs. Defensive midfielder Andi Sullivan has also emerged as a crucial player after missing the entire previous season due to an ACL tear and maternity leave. Spirit coach Adrian Gonzalez noted that past experiences have prepared his team better than in previous years. Meanwhile, Current coach Chris Armas plans to rely on two-time MVP Temwa Chawinga and Haley Hopkins in the offensive end, alongside a collective defensive strategy that held top-seeded Gotham to zero shots on target in the semi-final.

The upcoming championship marks another year of growth for the NWSL, with league commissioner Jessica Berman stating that average attendance has risen 40% since 2022, climbing from 7,800 to more than 11,000. However, the league faced logistical hurdles regarding venue availability during the semi-finals, as both home teams nearly faced displacement—including the Spirit, who were almost pushed out by a Division III collegiate football game. Berman highlighted that shared ownership with Major League Soccer teams, such as upcoming moves and expansion teams in cities like Atlanta and Columbus, could provide the league with greater scheduling influence in the future.

stories.title: Report Alleges Silicon Valley Elites Funded Pro-Israel Platform Visegrad24
stories.summary:
An investigative report published by American magazine Wired on Thursday revealed that the Polish right-wing news media platform Visegrad24 received substantial funding from Silicon Valley elites to establish a pro-Israel editorial stance. Founded in 2020 by Stefan Tompson, the platform gained massive traction on social media platform X following the October 7, 2023, attack by Hamas. Within three days, the account published nearly 400 posts consisting of news updates, tributes to victims, and videos of protests, which accumulated 370 million views and thrust the account into the spotlight as a prominent pro-Israel voice.

According to internal communications and financial records reviewed by Wired, Tompson deliberately weighed his options after the outbreak of the conflict, eventually choosing a pro-Israel stance because supporters possessed significant influence and money, with the explicit goal of fundraising off the issue. The investigation revealed that Tompson was added to exclusive communication groups, including one named Jewish Alliances and an informal WhatsApp thread comprising hundreds of powerful figures from Silicon Valley, Wall Street, and Hollywood. These networks worked to build support for Israel and reportedly contributed to significant fundraising success for Visegrad24 through major investment firms, donor-advised funds, and contributions from high-profile technology and business executives.

The donations included $175,000 from DonorsTrust, a fund closely aligned with the priorities of the Trump administration. The platform's founder utilized donor-advised funds, which allow contributors to remain anonymous. While individuals and entities named in the report either declined to comment, denied having donation records, or argued that Visegrad24 was not a far-right group, the platform managed to secure over a million dollars in donations. Previously known for its coverage of the Russian invasion of Ukraine and accusations of spreading misinformation, Visegrad24 later took positions on other geopolitical events, such as expressing enthusiasm for the restoration of Reza Pahlavi's leadership during attacks involving Israel and Iran.

stories.title: Zulfi Bukhari Recognized Among New Generation of Global Politicians
stories.summary:
British-Pakistani politician and former government minister Sayed Zulfikar Abbas Bukhari, known as Zulfi Bukhari, has been named by London-based publication The Luxurist among an international group of emerging political figures. The list, titled "The new generation of global politicians changing the face of power," highlights younger leaders who challenge traditional political structures and engage new voter demographics.

The magazine praised Bukhari for his international business background, cosmopolitan upbringing between London and Pakistan, and contemporary communication style. A close associate of former prime minister Imran Khan, Bukhari previously served as Special Assistant to the Prime Minister on Overseas Pakistanis and Human Resource Development during the Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf (PTI) administration.

Bukhari was featured alongside several prominent international leaders, including New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani, U.S. Senator Abdul El-Sayed, American Congresswoman Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, Ecuadorian President Daniel Noboa, and Nepalese Prime Minister Balendra Shah. The publication noted his strong visibility and network among overseas Pakistanis and younger audiences.

Currently spending his time between London, Dubai, and European capitals, Bukhari maintains an active international political profile while campaigning for Imran Khan. He faces multiple legal cases in Pakistan that were filed following the ouster of the PTI government.

stories.title: امریکی سینیٹ نے ایران کے خلاف جاری جنگ روکنے کی قرارداد مسترد کر دی
stories.summary:
امریکی سینیٹ نے ایک بار پھر ایران کے خلاف جاری جنگ رکوانے اور صدر ڈونلڈ ٹرمپ کے جنگی اختیارات کو محدود کرنے کی کوشش ناکام بنادی ہے۔ اس قرارداد پر ہونے والی رائے شماری کے دوران حق میں 48 جبکہ مخالفت میں 51 ووٹ ڈالے گئے، جس کے نتیجے میں ری پبلکن ارکان نے ایک مرتبہ پھر ٹرمپ انتظامیہ کی جنگی پالیسی کی بھرپور حمایت کر دی ہے۔

غیر ملکی میڈیا کے مطابق ووٹنگ کے عمل کے دوران ڈیموکریٹ سینیٹر جان فیٹر مین نے اپنی ہی جماعت کے مؤقف سے ہٹ کر قرارداد کی مخالفت میں ووٹ ڈالا۔ اس کے برعکس، ری پبلکن سینیٹرز سوزن کولنز، رینڈ پال اور لیزا مرکوسکی نے اس قرارداد کی حمایت کی۔ رواں سال فروری میں امریکا اور اسرائیل کی جانب سے مشترکہ حملے کے بعد سے ڈیموکریٹک ارکان مسلسل ایسے اقدامات اور قراردادیں پیش کر رہے ہیں تاکہ صدر کے جنگی اختیارات کو قابو میں رکھا جا سکے۔

ڈیموکریٹس کا مؤقف رہا ہے کہ صدر کو کانگریس کی باضابطہ منظوری کے بغیر جنگ کو جاری رکھنے کا کوئی قانونی اختیار حاصل نہیں ہونا چاہیے۔ اس سے قبل رواں سال ستمبر میں امریکی ایوان نمائندگان اس قرارداد کو منظوری دے چکا تھا، تاہم سینیٹ میں ایک بار پھر ناکامی کے باعث جنگ روکنے کی یہ تازہ کوشش بھی بارآور ثابت نہ ہو سکی۔

واضح رہے کہ ایران کے خلاف جاری یہ جنگ امریکی عوام میں بھی شدید غیر مقبولیت کا شکار رہی ہے، جس کے نتیجے میں ملک بھر میں پیٹرول اور ڈیزل کی قیمتوں میں اضافے نے حکومت کو گہرے سیاسی دباؤ سے دوچار کر رکھا ہے۔ اس کے علاوہ نومبر کے وسط مدتی انتخابات میں ری پبلکن پارٹی کو دونوں ایوانوں کا کنٹرول بھی کھونا پڑا تھا، اور سیاسی تجزیہ کاروں کے مطابق اس شکست کی ایک بڑی اور اہم وجہ ایران کے ساتھ جاری یہ جنگ بھی قرار دی جا رہی ہے۔

stories.title: Anthropic Reaches $2 Trillion Valuation in Historic Nasdaq Debut
stories.summary:
Anthropic achieved a market value of $2 trillion during its Nasdaq debut on Thursday, outperforming the June listing of SpaceX. The company's shares opened 34 percent higher than their $83 initial public offering price. This milestone places increased focus on the leadership team, headed by CEO Dario Amodei, which must carefully balance commercial expansion with the enterprise's core focus on artificial intelligence safety.

The AI lab raised $81.3 billion, securing the largest initial public offering worldwide and establishing the creator of the Claude chatbot as the initial publicly traded frontier artificial intelligence company. By pricing its shares above the originally marketed range, the organization highlighted strong investor demand for a technology sector that has drawn billions of dollars in investments.

This high-profile market entry emphasizes the growing financial weight of generative artificial intelligence firms on public exchanges. Executives and board members now face heightened scrutiny to maintain operational safety standards while delivering expected commercial growth to public shareholders.

The successful listing marks a critical turning point for the industry, setting a new benchmark for artificial intelligence valuations on global financial markets. Stakeholders and market observers will closely monitor how the leadership navigates the dual responsibilities of rapid technological deployment and rigorous risk management.

stories.title: NCCIA Uncovers Massive Financial Network Involving Rs1 Trillion in Betting
stories.summary:
The National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency in Karachi announced Thursday that it uncovered a vast financial network allegedly tied to illegal online betting, gambling, and money laundering. Authorities estimate the network's transaction exposure reaches up to approximately Rs1 trillion. Karachi NCCIA Additional Director Shahzad Akbar stated that the probe began after the State Bank of Pakistan flagged suspicious activities across commercial banks, microfinance institutions, and digital wallets.

Investigators identified various online betting platforms operating within the network, including 1XBet, Stake, X777, X555, 99c444, X111, and MelBet. Funds were allegedly collected through digital channels, such as two prominent mobile wallets, and subsequently routed through multiple bank accounts, fictitious companies, and rented mule accounts to obscure the true beneficiaries. During enforcement operations, officials successfully secured about Rs1 billion in illicit funds within a single day to prevent their withdrawal.

The investigation has implicated several banking officials, company directors, and payment facilitators. A First Information Report was registered on November 18 under the Prevention of Electronic Crimes Act and the Pakistan Penal Code against 40 individuals and business entities, including 32 company chief executives and five arrested suspects. Officials noted that many individuals creating the gambling applications are Chinese nationals.

In related developments, NCCIA officials highlighted systemic vulnerabilities in company registrations and bank account verifications that permit international fraud networks to launder money. The agency recently urged stricter regulatory oversight to curb the exploitation of these loopholes by illicit call centres and online betting operators.

stories.title: Sindh Cabinet Approves Electric Buses, Safe Cities Project, and Water Program
stories.summary:
The Sindh cabinet approved the acquisition of 500 electric buses for Karachi, a $540 million international financing package for the STAR-WASH program, and several other governance initiatives during a meeting chaired by Chief Minister Syed Murad Ali Shah at the Chief Minister's House on Wednesday. The 21-point agenda focused heavily on enhancing public transport, health, education, and water supply services across the province.

Under a government-to-government agreement with Heavy Industries Taxila, the Sindh Mass Transit Authority will oversee the Rs37.97 billion transport project. The initiative features 300 twelve-metre buses and 200 smaller vehicles operating across 17 routes, alongside charging units, depots, and automated fare collection systems. Additionally, the cabinet greenlit the second phase of the Sindh Safe Cities project in Karachi, awarding an Rs8.871 billion contract to the National Radio and Telecommunication Corporation, with Rs5.766 billion immediately released for equipment and installation.

The cabinet also granted post-facto approval for the $540 million STAR-WASH program, funded by the World Bank, Asian Development Bank, and the provincial government, aimed at improving water and sanitation. Special development grants were allocated for an oncology complex at the Mehrunisa Medical Centre and a urology hospital in Larkana. Furthermore, the chief minister ordered a halt to new bird hunting permits for the 2026-27 season and approved stricter penalties for illegal wildlife hunting.

Additional decisions included terminating a water use agreement with Siddiqsons Energy Limited for an unutilized Thar coal power project and reallocating the water to Fauji Fertilizer Company. The cabinet also revised a scholarship program with the Professional Education Foundation to expand educational opportunities in emerging employment fields.

stories.title: Zardari and Bilawal Reiterate Firm Stance on New Administrative Provinces
stories.summary:
President Asif Ali Zardari and Pakistan Peoples Party Chairman Bilawal Bhutto-Zardari reached an agreement during a meeting at Aiwan-e-Sadr to maintain their firm position regarding new administrative units and a potential referendum. Sources reported that President Zardari specifically summoned the PPP chairman to Islamabad to review the prevailing political landscape and evaluate the approach taken by Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif.

During their discussions, both leaders evaluated the possibility of convening a meeting of the party's Central Executive Committee. President Zardari informed Bilawal that the federal government had requested measures aimed at easing political tensions and confrontation. This meeting followed an earlier discussion between President Zardari and Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif, where both officials agreed to resolve outstanding issues through mutual consultation.

Although the prior meeting between the president and the prime minister focused on the political climate and noted past constitutional amendments achieved through coalition cooperation, the official statement issued by the President's House made no mention of provincial boundaries. Similarly, Pakistan Peoples Party sources withheld specific details concerning discussions about new provinces during that initial encounter.

The leadership's decision to stand resolute on administrative units underscores ongoing political maneuvering within the coalition government. As discussions continue, the party remains focused on its strategic objectives regarding regional governance and constitutional reforms.

stories.title: Pakistani President Urges Swift Implementation of Maldivian Cooperation MoUs
stories.summary:
Pakistan's President has called for prompt and effective follow-up actions regarding the agreements finalized during the recent official visit of Maldivian President Dr. Mohammad Muizzu. The discussions emphasize turning twenty distinct memoranda of understanding into tangible results across key sectors, including health, education, trade, and defense. During a formal meeting at Aiwan-e-Sadr with Vice Admiral (Retd) Ovais Ahmed Bilgrami, the newly designated High Commissioner to the Republic of Maldives, the President stressed the necessity of strengthening economic ties through expanded bilateral commerce and broader collaboration.

Particular emphasis was placed on defense cooperation, with the President advocating for continued progress on three defense-related MoUs signed during President Muizzu's visit. He also recommended the prompt establishment of a proposed Joint Working Group dedicated to defense and security cooperation. Furthermore, the discussion highlighted the importance of education and skills development, with the President urging authorities to facilitate Maldivian students in utilizing educational scholarships offered by Pakistan.

The High Commissioner-designate expressed gratitude for the guidance provided and committed to advancing cooperative efforts between the two countries in trade, defense, and education. The President congratulated Vice Admiral Bilgrami on his new assignment and conveyed optimism that his tenure would further strengthen the long-standing and cordial relations uniting the two nations.

stories.title: مصنوعی ذہانت کی معروف کمپنی اینتھروپک کی امریکی اسٹاک مارکیٹ میں شاندار انٹری
stories.summary:
مصنوعی ذہانت کے شعبے کی مشہور کمپنی اینتھروپک نے امریکی اسٹاک مارکیٹ میں شاندار انداز میں قدم رکھتے ہی سرمایہ کاتوں کی بھرپور توجہ حاصل کر لی ہے۔ اے آئی چیٹ بوٹ کلاڈ تیار کرنے والی اس کمپنی کی مجموعی مارکیٹ ویلیو بڑھ کر تقریباً 1.76 ٹریلین ڈالر کی سطح تک جا پہنچی ہے۔

نیس ڈیک میں اس کمپنی کے حصص کی ابتدائی قیمت 83 ڈالر مقرر کی گئی تھی، جو دورانِ کاروبار بڑھ کر 111.53 ڈالر تک پہنچ گئی اور سیشن کے اختتام پر یہ حصص 97.17 ڈالر پر بند ہوئے۔ مارکیٹ میں حصص کی قیمتوں کے اس اتار چڑھاؤ کے باوجود پہلے ہی روز مجموعی طور پر تقریباً 17 فیصد تک کا نمایاں اضافہ ریکارڈ کیا گیا، جسے اے آئی انڈسٹری کا ایک بڑا امتحان قرار دیا جا رہا ہے۔

اس پیش رفت کے ساتھ ہی امریکی ٹیکنالوجی مارکیٹ میں مندی کا رجحان بھی دیکھا گیا جہاں نیس ڈیک انڈیکس 2.3 فیصد تک گر گیا۔ اس دوران گوگل کی پیرنٹ کمپنی الفابیٹ کے حصص میں 2.9 فیصد اور ایمیزون کے حصص میں تقریباً 3.9 فیصد کمی واقع ہوئی۔

ماہرین کی تمام تر توجہ اب اس اہم سوال پر مرکوز ہے کہ مصنوعی ذہانت کے شعبے میں کی جانے والی کھربوں ڈالر کی یہ سرمایہ کاری مستقبل میں کتنے بڑے مالی فوائد فراہم کرے گی۔ گزشتہ ایک سال کے دوران بڑی ٹیکنالوجی کمپنیوں کی جانب سے اس شعبے میں ایک ٹریلین ڈالر سے زائد کی خطیر سرمایہ کاری کی جا چکی ہے۔

stories.title: Pennsylvania Reports Eighth Measles Death Amid Growing National Outbreak Concerns
stories.summary:
Pennsylvania's Department of Health announced that an unvaccinated resident from Clinton County has died from measles, marking the eighth fatality in the state and raising the national death toll to eleven for the year 2026. State officials promptly notified the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention of the fatality. However, identifying details of the deceased were withheld by state spokeswoman Ashley Miller due to privacy regulations. This announcement arrived just one day after the Pan American Health Organization stripped the United States of its 26-year-old measles elimination status because of ongoing transmission nationwide.

Across Pennsylvania, authorities have recorded 1,599 measles cases spanning 46 counties, which includes 28 new cases reported since November 16. The outbreak has resulted in 315 hospitalizations, while fewer than one percent of all recorded cases in the state have involved vaccinated individuals. The largest clusters are concentrated in Lancaster County with 545 cases, Mifflin County with 205 cases, and Jefferson County with 105 cases. Fatalities within the state have occurred in Jefferson, Lancaster, Mifflin, and Montour counties.

Public confusion remains prevalent regarding measles risks and the advantages of vaccination, as indicated by recent polling data from the Annenberg Public Policy Center. The CDC estimates that approximately one to three out of every 1,000 infected children experience death. In response to the rising health crisis, state health officials advise anyone experiencing symptoms or believing they have been exposed to contact their primary doctor or the Pennsylvania hotline at 877-724-3258 before visiting a clinic or emergency room.

stories.title: Islam Forecast to Surpass Christianity as World's Largest Religion by 2035
stories.summary:
Islam is projected to overtake Christianity and become the world's largest religion by the middle of the next decade, driven by higher fertility rates among Muslim women compared to other religious groups. According to a study published by the Pew Research Center, the global Muslim population is expected to reach 2.57 billion by the year 2035, narrowly exceeding the projected Christian population of 2.52 billion for that same period. If current demographic patterns continue, Muslims will outnumber Christians globally by 3.6 billion to 3 billion by the year 2070.

By 2070, Islam is forecast to account for 37 percent of the total global population, increasing from 26 percent in 2020. Christianity is expected to remain relatively stable at approximately 29 percent, retaining the second-largest global proportion. The primary driver behind this demographic shift is natural population growth stemming from high fertility rates in the Islamic world, which averaged 3.1 children per Muslim woman between 2020 and 2025. In comparison, Christian women averaged 2.5 children, while all other religious categories combined averaged 1.6 children per woman during the same timeframe.

In addition to natural growth, religious switching will play a secondary role in altering global religious demographics. Overall world population is projected to grow by 29 percent between 2020 and 2070, with only Islam and Christianity keeping pace or exceeding this expansion. Meanwhile, religiously unaffiliated individuals, including atheists and agnostics, are expected to decline sharply as a proportion of the global population, dropping from 24 percent in 2020 to 17 percent by 2070, largely influenced by demographic shifts inside China.

stories.title: Houthi Missile Strike Damages Saudi Arabia's Tallest Skyscraper in Riyadh
stories.summary:
Riyadh's tallest skyscraper, which serves as the headquarters for the Saudi sovereign wealth fund, suffered material damage after being struck by an incoming Houthi missile on Thursday. Saudi Arabia's civil defense reported that the attack impacted a tower located within the capital's financial district, blowing out windows across seven to eight floors and bending sections of the metal facade. While several floors and nearby buildings sustained structural damage, state news agency SPA confirmed that no injuries were reported. Although the official statement did not name the structure, published photographs clearly identified it as the PIF Tower.

The attack prompted Saudi authorities to close the King Abdullah Financial District to visitors, while the foreign ministry asserted its right to take all necessary measures to defend national sovereignty, citizens, and assets. This incident marks the second time in less than two weeks that a landmark in Riyadh's financial hub has been hit, following a November 8 strike on the state oil company Aramco's building. The Saudi-led coalition stated that it successfully addressed an incoming missile threat, noting that falling debris caused the damage. Meanwhile, the Houthi-run Saba news agency reported that Saudi aircraft carried out retaliatory airstrikes on the Yemeni capital of Sanaa early Thursday.

The ongoing conflict continues to challenge Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman's economic diversification goals, as military campaigns against the Houthis persist. Western officials indicate that Saudi military leaders anticipate the campaign could stretch for up to six months as ground forces attempt to secure territory. The wider regional conflict, which reignited in July amid tensions involving the United States, Israel, and Iran, has seen hostilities escalate across the Gulf, complicating international diplomatic efforts mediated by Qatar to restore stability.

stories.title: Pakistani Finance Ministry Committee Reviews Export Facilitation Scheme Amendments
stories.summary:
The ninth meeting of the Prime Minister’s Committee to Review the Export Facilitation Scheme took place at the Ministry of Finance, presided over by Minister of State for Finance and Railways Bilal Azhar Kiyani. The discussions centered on proposed amendments aimed at making the scheme more accessible, predictable, and responsive to the needs of exporters while simultaneously strengthening compliance and revenue safeguards.

Key proposals reviewed during the session included shortening authorization times, streamlining exporter classification, and expanding access for both new and established businesses. Officials also discussed introducing a standard value-addition formula to replace disparate calculations across Collectorates, which would utilize existing data and support small and medium-sized enterprises. Furthermore, the committee evaluated measures to enhance risk-based oversight, define sampling and follow-up procedures clearly, and prevent any potential misuse of the program.

Emphasizing the importance of a business-friendly environment and export-led growth, the Minister of State noted that simplification must be paired with uniform application of eligibility criteria. Stakeholder consultations and briefing sessions with exporters are planned prior to the formal implementation of the regulatory changes to address industry concerns.

The gathering brought together prominent figures and senior representatives from the Federal Board of Revenue, the Ministry of Commerce, and various trade bodies. Attendees included Musadiq Zulkarnain, Chairman and CEO of Interloop Limited, alongside delegates from the Pakistan Textile Exporters Association, the All Pakistan Textile Mills Association, and the Sialkot Chamber of Commerce and Industry.

stories.title: Zardari and Sharif Agree to Settle Matters Through Dialogue Amid Friction
stories.summary:
President Asif Ali Zardari and Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif met in Islamabad on Thursday and agreed to address all matters through mutual consultation. The meeting was attended by Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi and aimed to ease political tensions driven by a recent debate over creating new administrative provinces.

The friction escalated after PPP Chairman Bilawal Bhutto-Zardari strongly criticized federal ministers and opposed any division of Sindh, warning that forced administrative changes would lead to bloodshed. Bilawal also questioned the judiciary and the handling of governance reforms, though he later clarified his stance on constitutional amendments.

following the high-level huddle, Minister of State for Interior Talal Chaudhry affirmed that major national decisions will be handled democratically and with consensus from all coalition partners. Chaudhry noted that while Bilawal made an emotional speech, the ruling Pakistan Muslim League-Nawaz (PML-N) prefers resolving issues through established parliamentary channels.

The presidency emphasized that prior constitutional reforms and governance strategies were achieved through collaboration among allied parties. The leadership's renewed focus on dialogue seeks to preserve coalition stability and address broader economic and administrative challenges facing the country.

stories.title: President Zardari and Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif Agree to Consult Amid Coalition Friction
stories.summary:
President Asif Ali Zardari and Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif met in Islamabad on Thursday and agreed to resolve all political matters through mutual consultation. Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi also attended the meeting, where the leaders reviewed the current political climate and discussed ongoing conflicts in the Middle East, emphasizing that allied parties have historically relied on dialogue to pass constitutional amendments.

The discussion occurred against a backdrop of rising tensions between ruling coalition partners, the Pakistan Muslim League-Nawaz and the Pakistan Peoples Party. Friction intensified following recent remarks by PPP Chairman Bilawal Bhutto-Zardari, who questioned decisions made by the federal government and criticized the passage of the 27th Constitutional Amendment, arguing it was secured through a brute majority rather than broad consensus.

Additional strain has been caused by a national debate over the creation of new administrative provinces, a proposal initially advanced by Mohsin Naqvi in July. While federal figures have expressed support for administrative resets, Bilawal strongly opposed dividing Sindh province, warning that any forced attempts could provoke bloodshed, and noted that no government representative had consulted the PPP leadership on the matter.

Despite these sharp disagreements, Bilawal subsequently clarified that he is not entirely disowning the constitutional amendment, while continuing to advocate for a democratic reset and restored parliamentary confidence. The high-level meeting between the President and Prime Minister aims to ease these coalition strains through ongoing dialogue.

stories.title: Experts Promote Swarm Electrification to Advance People-Centred Energy Equity in Pakistan
stories.summary:
Minister of State for Climate Change and Environmental Coordination Dr. Shezra Mansab Ali Khan Kharal emphasized the importance of community-level energy systems during an event titled 'Advancing Swarm Electrification for Energy Equity, Climate Justice and a Just Energy Transition'. Organized by the Policy Research Institute for Equitable Development, the conference highlighted how local solutions can connect everyday public needs with national climate priorities.

Pakistan currently experiences a rapid expansion of consumer-driven rooftop solar power, yet lacks coordinated frameworks to integrate these decentralized resources. Swarm electrification addresses this gap by interconnecting existing solar installations, battery storage, and inverters into local networks, allowing households and businesses to share surplus electricity, improve affordability, and boost resilience in climate-vulnerable communities.

Amina Shahab, a researcher at PRIED, presented findings on unlocking community-led energy sharing to make energy systems more democratic and equitable. Meanwhile, expert panelists from organizations such as the Sustainable Development Policy Institute, Solar Citizens, APMDD, and the Hanns Seidel Foundation discussed technical feasibility, carbon markets, peer-to-peer sharing, and the necessity of international knowledge exchange and grant-based financing.

Concluding the event, Dr. Shezra Mansab noted that community-driven models deserve serious consideration for protecting local interests and ensuring that new energy investments directly benefit the public. She underscored the necessity of developing supportive regulatory frameworks, institutional coordination, and financial safeguards to ensure sustainable and balanced outcomes for the nation.

stories.title: Climate Finance and Resilience Policies Often Overlook Children's Needs
stories.summary:
Climate finance initiatives frequently neglect the specific requirements of children in vulnerable nations like Pakistan, where disasters severely impact health, education, and safety. Although international funds are disbursed for infrastructure and economic losses, child protection and schooling are rarely factored into financial recovery calculations. For example, recent floods have damaged numerous schools and left many children out of the education system or vulnerable to malnutrition and premature labor.

Pakistan faces severe climate risks, with devastating monsoons causing widespread displacement, fatalities, and infrastructure destruction. The 2022 floods affected millions of individuals, including roughly 16 million children, and caused hundreds of child fatalities. Subsequent monsoon seasons have continued to cause massive displacement and deaths. These repeated disruptions severely strain families coping with poverty and inadequate public services, pushing some households toward negative coping mechanisms such as child labor and child marriage.

Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif emphasized at COP31 that adaptation funds must act as survival funds that protect children's security and well-being rather than just physical assets. Pakistan's Nationally Determined Contribution outlines massive emission reduction goals costing hundreds of billions of dollars, relying heavily on international support. However, current funding frameworks fall short of actual developing world needs, and disbursed funds do not always reach the populations most at risk from environmental changes.

The lack of consistent data further complicates efforts to measure the long-term impact of climate disasters on children's nutrition and development. While historical data suggests educational losses can sometimes diminish over a period of years, the immediate disruptions compromise vital developmental milestones. Ensuring grant-based finance and timely recovery are essential to prevent permanent damage to the future of children in climate-vulnerable regions.

stories.title: Pakistan Government Raises Petrol Price by Re1 While Keeping Diesel Unchanged
stories.summary:
The Pakistani government has increased the retail price of petrol by Re1 per litre while leaving high-speed diesel rates unchanged, ending a brief twelve-day streak of consecutive petrol price reductions. According to an official notification from the Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority, petrol will retail at Rs323 per litre and high-speed diesel will cost Rs355 per litre. These pricing adjustments are part of ongoing efforts to manage domestic fuel costs amid fluctuating international market trends driven by geopolitical tensions in the Middle East.

Government officials noted that proactive policy changes and structural reforms in petroleum policy have helped bring fuel prices down from their peaks earlier in the year. Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar stated that the administration remains committed to easing financial burdens on citizens. As part of these relief efforts, the government continues to levy substantial taxes and duties on fuel and has implemented the Prime Minister’s Fuel Relief Scheme to subsidize fuel for owners of motorcycles, rickshaws, and small vehicles.

To conserve fuel and mitigate the economic impact of supply disruptions linked to the ongoing conflict involving Iran and the US, federal authorities have also reintroduced several austerity measures. These steps include mandated early market closures at 9pm and a fifty percent reduction in fuel allocations for official vehicles over a three-month period. Daily price revisions have been delegated to the regulatory authority to reflect real-time international market fluctuations.

Changes in fuel prices significantly impact the middle and lower-middle classes, as petrol is widely used in private transport and small vehicles, whereas diesel powers the heavy transport sector and large generators. Both fuel types remain major revenue earners for the state, with substantial monthly sales volumes across the country compared to lower-demand products like kerosene.

stories.title: US Military Expenditure on Iran Conflict Exceeds $48 Billion, Pentagon Reports
stories.summary:
Spending by the US military on the conflict against Iran has surpassed $48 billion since hostilities began in late February involving the United States and Israel. Testifying during a nomination hearing as assistant secretary of the Navy for financial management, Pentagon deputy comptroller Arthur Miller stated that expenditures reached $48.3 billion as of November 13.

The updated total represents an increase of approximately 26 percent compared to an earlier estimate of $38 billion provided by the Congressional Budget Office as of August 1. Miller explained that the mounting figure accounts for munitions, equipment replacement costs, and general operational expenses incurred during the ongoing military campaign.

However, the official expenditure figures do not encompass the physical damage inflicted on US military bases in the Middle East by recurring Iranian drone and missile strikes. Furthermore, the statistics exclude the broader economic fallout affecting global markets, which has intensified as Iran attempts to block commercial shipping through the vital Strait of Hormuz.

In response to the disruptions, the United States has maintained a heavy naval presence in the region to blockade Iranian ports and protect trade routes. Meanwhile, Iranian-backed Houthi forces in Yemen have continued targeting regional shipping and energy infrastructure, compounding the geopolitical and economic pressures of the conflict.

stories.title: Pakistan Adjusts Fuel Rates as Petrol Price Rises by One Rupee
stories.summary:
Pakistan's government has implemented a minor upward adjustment to petrol prices, raising the rate by one rupee to Rs323 per litre, while maintaining high-speed diesel at Rs355 per litre. The Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority issued the revised ex-depot prices in a formal notification, confirming that the changes were calculated under the pricing mechanism approved by the federal administration. These updated rates take effect on Friday, November 20.

This slight increase follows a series of consecutive price reductions implemented by authorities. Just prior to this adjustment, the government had lowered the prices of both petrol and high-speed diesel by three rupees per litre each, bringing their respective rates down to Rs322 and Rs355. Fuel prices in the country have experienced considerable volatility in response to broader geopolitical developments and supply concerns originating in the Middle East.

Global oil markets reacted to supply anxieties on Thursday, with prices ticking upward following losses in the previous trading session. Concerns regarding shipping security in the Strait of Hormuz balanced against expectations of a potential market surplus, driving upward pressure on international benchmarks. Brent crude futures and US West Texas Intermediate futures both recorded gains during the trading day.

The domestic pricing mechanism continues to reflect these shifting international petroleum trends. Regulatory authorities and government officials monitor global crude movements closely to determine periodic revisions for domestic consumers, balancing fiscal constraints with the objective of providing relief to the general public.

stories.title: Pakistan Extends Airspace Closure for Indian Aircraft Until December
stories.summary:
Pakistan has prolonged its restriction barring Indian aircraft from utilizing its airspace until December 24, 2026. A Notice to Airmen released by the Pakistan Airports Authority specifies that the ban applies to all Indian-registered commercial, jet passenger, and military planes, extending a measure originally instituted on April 23, 2025.

The airspace closure stems from bilateral tensions following the Pahalgam attack in Indian Illegally Occupied Jammu and Kashmir and subsequent military escalation. India blamed Islamabad for the incident, which Pakistan denied while advocating for an independent inquiry. Retaliatory actions followed, including India closing its airspace to Pakistani carriers on April 30, 2025, and cross-border strikes in May 2025 that culminated in an 87-hour conflict before a U.S.-brokered ceasefire.

Historically, these bans have disproportionately affected India's aviation sector financially compared to Pakistan's industry. Similar airspace bans were previously enacted by Pakistan during the 1999 Kargil conflict and the 2019 Pulwama crisis, creating operational hurdles primarily for Indian airlines.

The current restrictions will stay in force until 04:59 on December 24, 2026, barring any changes between the two neighboring countries. Both nations remain locked in diplomatic and logistical friction as regional tensions persist.

stories.title: Regulator Raises Petrol Cost Slightly While Keeping Diesel Unchanged
stories.summary:
The Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority announced an upward adjustment in petroleum product rates, raising the cost of petrol by one rupee per litre while leaving diesel expenses untouched. Based on the official directive issued in Islamabad, petrol will now cost three hundred twenty-three rupees per litre, whereas diesel stays at three hundred fifty-five rupees per litre. These updated rates become applicable starting on November 20.

Prior to this announcement, petroleum dealers gathered in Karachi for an emergency assembly to address pricing structures, refinery earnings, and potential consumer assistance. During this meeting, industry representatives including Malik Khuda Bakhsh and Anwar Kamal urged authorities to conduct a thorough forensic examination of oil refineries' financial accounts.

According to the dealers, such a transparent review would expose the true earnings of these companies. Malik Khuda Bakhsh pointed out that refineries reportedly accumulated twelve months' worth of revenue in a mere quarter. Meanwhile, Anwar Kamal asserted that a proper evaluation could lead to consumer savings of forty to fifty rupees per litre on petrol.

The participants argued that recent remarks from the petroleum minister validated their concerns regarding excessive corporate profits. They insisted that a comprehensive investigation into financial records is necessary to uncover past gains and protect the public from unnecessary monetary pressures going forward.

stories.title: Ten Killed and Twenty-Two Injured in Balochistan Highway Vehicle Collision
stories.summary:
A fatal collision between a passenger coach and a liquefied petroleum gas bowser on the Makran Coastal Highway in Balochistan left ten people dead and twenty-two others injured. The accident occurred near Basol in the Gwadar district, close to Ormara, when an oncoming gas bowser collided with a Karachi-bound passenger coach traveling from Turbat. The powerful impact caused both vehicles to catch fire instantly, trapping passengers inside the bus.

Rescue officials reported that eight passengers burned to death inside the coach, while the driver and the cleaner of the gas bowser also lost their lives. Among the fatalities were three children. Emergency response teams, local police, and the Ormara Municipal Committee fire brigade rushed to the location to battle the flames and transport the twenty-two injured individuals to nearby medical facilities for urgent treatment.

The fiery crash caused significant traffic disruptions along the Makran Coastal Highway, leaving vehicles stranded on both sides of the roadway while rescue operations were underway. Balochistan Chief Minister Sarfraz Bugti expressed deep sorrow over the tragic loss of life and instructed local administration and health authorities to provide immediate medical care to all survivors.

This tragedy highlights ongoing safety concerns along the Makran Coastal Highway, which has been the site of previous fatal road accidents involving gas bowsers. In August, six members of a single family lost their lives when their car collided with an LPG bowser in the Ormara area, and a separate head-on collision in March resulted in multiple fatalities and injuries.

stories.title: اینتھروپک کی اسٹاک مارکیٹ میں انٹری، ایک ہی دن میں ہزاروں ملازمین کروڑ پتی بن گئے
stories.summary:
مصنوعی ذہانت کی ترقی یافتہ کمپنی اینتھروپک کی اسٹاک مارکیٹ میں شمولیت نے اس کے ملازمین کی مالی حالت یکسر بدل دی ہے۔ کمپنی کے تقریباً 96 فیصد ملازمین کروڑ پتی بن گئے ہیں جبکہ سیکڑوں ملازمین کی ذاتی دولت 10 کروڑ ڈالر کی حد کو بھی پار کر گئی ہے۔

امریکی میڈیا رپورٹس کے مطابق کمپنی کی جانب سے حصص کی ابتدائی قیمت 83 ڈالر طے کیے جانے کے بعد ملازمین کے پاس موجود شیئرز کی مالیت میں ہوشربا اضافہ ہوا۔ ستمبر 2026 تک اینتھروپک میں کل ملازمین کی تعداد 5 ہزار 300 تھی، جن میں سے تقریباً 5 ہزار 100 ملازمین کے حصص کی مالیت 10 لاکھ ڈالر سے زائد ہو چکی ہے۔

اعداد و شمار کے مطابق تقريباً 2 ہزار 800 ملازمین ایسے ہیں جن کے حصص کی مالیت 1 کروڑ ڈالر سے زیادہ ہے، جبکہ لگ بھگ 600 ملازمین کی دولت 10 کروڑ ڈالر سے بھی تجاوز کر گئی ہے۔ اندرونی طور پر ان ملازمین کو اینٹس کہا جاتا ہے، جنہوں نے انتہائی مختصر عرصے میں یہ غیر معمولی مالی کامیابی حاصل کی ہے۔

سنہ 2021 میں قائم ہونے والی اس کمپنی کے ملازمین کی تعداد 2024 کے اختتام تک ایک ہزار سے بھی کم تھی جو بڑھ کر پانچ ہزار سے اوپر چلی گئی۔ اسٹاک مارکیٹ میں انٹری کے موقع پر ملازمین کو اپنے حصص کا کچھ حصہ فروخت کرکے نقد رقم حاصل کرنے کا موقع بھی ملا، جس سے ہزاروں افراد راتوں رات امیر بن گئے۔

stories.title: Anthropic Reaches $2 Trillion Valuation in Historic Nasdaq Market Debut
stories.summary:
Artificial intelligence startup Anthropic achieved a $2 trillion market value during its debut on the Nasdaq exchange on Thursday. The company's stock opened at $111.50, marking a 34 percent increase above its initial public offering price of $83. The strong demand for shares provides a key test of investor appetite for the generative AI sector amid recent market skepticism regarding heavy spending and debt.

Anthropic sold 980 million shares to raise $81 billion, pricing the offering above its initial marketing range of $70 to $78. The proceeds could reach $93.5 billion if underwriters exercise additional purchase options, and total over $107 billion when factoring in a private placement involving major technology firms such as Alphabet's Google, Microsoft, and Nvidia. The transaction establishes Anthropic as the world's first publicly traded frontier AI company and a benchmark for the industry ahead of potential future listings by competitors like OpenAI.

The blockbuster debut is expected to generate significant wealth for early investors, researchers, and co-founders, including CEO Dario Amodei, whose stakes represent a substantial portion of the company's valuation. Underwriters led by Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley will collect a $550 million fee for managing the record-setting public offering.

Despite the enthusiastic market response, financial analysts continue to debate the long-term sustainability of the artificial intelligence boom. Critics highlight Anthropic's lack of profitability and massive computing commitments with partners like Amazon and Google, while executives acknowledge potential future reliance on debt markets to fund ongoing expansion and development.

stories.title: سندھ ہائیکورٹ کا غیر قانونی تعمیرات پر ایس بی سی اے سے جواب طلب
stories.summary:
کراچی کے علاقے لیاقت آباد میں نوے گز کے پلاٹ پر دس منزلہ عمارت کی غیر قانونی تعمیر کے معاملے پر سندھ ہائیکورٹ نے سندھ بلڈنگ کنٹرول اتھارٹی سے جواب طلب کر لیا ہے۔ عدالت میں سماعت کے دوران ایس بی سی اے نے بتایا کہ بلڈر کو صرف گراؤنڈ پلس فائیو کی اجازت دی گئی تھی۔ اس پر عدالت نے برہمی کا اظہار کرتے ہوئے کہا کہ ریکارڈ کے مطابق گراؤنڈ پلس دس کی اجازت مانگی گئی تھی اور لوگ دو منزلوں کی اجازت لے کر دس منزلہ عمارتیں کھڑی کر لیتے ہیں۔

عدالت نے ریمارکس دیے کہ اگر ایک کروڑ پلاٹوں پر غیر قانونی تعمیرات ہو رہی ہیں تو کیا عدالت ایک کروڑ مقدمات سنتی رہے گی؟ عدالت نے اس بات پر بھی تشویش ظاہر کی کہ عمارتوں میں رہنے والے لوگوں کو نکالنے سے ان کے حقوق متاثر ہوتے ہیں۔ سندھ ہائیکورٹ نے ایس بی سی اے کی پیش کردہ رپورٹ پر برہمی کا اظہار کرتے ہوئے آٹھ دسمبر تک جواب جمع کرانے کا حکم دے دیا ہے۔

دوسری جانب ملک کے مختلف سیاسی اور انتظامی امور پر بھی خبریں سامنے آئی ہیں۔ وزیر مملکت برائے داخلہ طلال چوہدری نے کہا ہے کہ انتظامی یونٹس کی تشکیل گورننس کی بہتری کے لیے زیر بحث ہے کسی کی ذاتی خواہش پر نہیں۔ دریں اثنا، پاک بحریہ، میری ٹائم سیکیورٹی ایجنسی اور اے این ایف نے بحیرہ عرب میں منشیات کی اسمگلنگ کے خلاف ایک مشترکہ کارروائی انجام دی ہے۔

لاہور کی کوٹ لکھپت جیل میں قید پاکستان تحریک انصاف کی قیادت نے چیف جسٹس آف پاکستان اور چیف جسٹس اسلام آباد ہائیکورٹ کے نام ایک مشترکہ خط لکھا ہے۔ شاہ محمود قریشی، یاسمین راشد، عمر سرفراز چیمہ، اعجاز چوہدری اور میاں محمود الرشید پر مشتمل اس قیدی قیادت کا مؤقف ہے کہ سیاسی رہنماؤں کو بغیر کسی ٹھوس ثبوت کے مقدمات اور سزاؤں کا سامنا کرنا پڑ رہا ہے۔

stories.title: بلاول نوجوان اور جذباتی ہیں، صدر اور وزیراعظم بات چیت چاہتے ہیں: طلال چوہدری
stories.summary:
وزیر مملکت برائے داخلہ طلال چوہدری نے ایک ٹی وی پروگرام میں گفتگو کرتے ہوئے کہا ہے کہ پیپلز پارٹی کے رہنما بلاول بھٹو زرداری نوجوان اور جذباتی ہیں۔ انہوں نے کہا کہ صدر مملکت اور وزیراعظم ہمیشہ باہمی گفت و شنید کے ذریعے معاملات کو آگے بڑھانا پسند کرتے ہیں۔ طلال چوہدری کے مطابق انہوں نے اپنے ردعمل میں مناسب حد کا خیال رکھا ہے اور انہیں بھی اپنے عوام کو جوابدہ ہونا پڑتا ہے۔

وزیر مملکت کا کہنا تھا کہ اگر پیپلز پارٹی کے رہنما جمہوریت اور برداشت کی بات کرتے ہیں تو انہیں بھی وزراء اور وزیر داخلہ کا مؤقف برداشت کرنا چاہیے۔ انہوں نے اس بات پر زور دیا کہ چوتھے درجے کی تقرری سے لے کر وزیراعظم کے انتخاب تک ہر سطح پر اتحادیوں سے مشاورت کی جاتی ہے۔ قانون سازی کے تمام معاملات متعلقہ کمیٹیوں اور پارلیمنٹ میں اتحادی جماعتوں کے سامنے رکھے جاتے ہیں۔

طلال چوہدری نے واضح کیا کہ جمہوری نظام میں بڑی جماعتوں کے ساتھ ساتھ چھوٹی جماعتوں کو بھی نظرانداز نہیں کیا جا سکتا۔ اہم نوعیت کے فیصلے باہمی اتفاق رائے کے بغیر نہ تو کیے گئے ہیں اور نہ ہی آئندہ کیے جائیں گے۔ انہوں نے مزید کہا کہ نئے انتظامی یونٹس بنانے کا مقصد کسی کی خواہش پوری کرنا نہیں بلکہ حکومتی نظم و نسق کو بہتر بنانا ہے۔

ان کا کہنا تھا کہ پی ڈی ایم کی تشکیل سے لے کر اب تک جتنے بھی فیصلے کیے گئے ہیں، ان میں سے کوئی بھی آئین کے دائرہ کار سے باہر نہیں کیا گیا۔ تمام اقدامات اتحادیوں، خصوصاً پاکستان پیپلز پارٹی کے ساتھ مکمل اور جامع مشاورت کے بعد عمل میں لائے گئے ہیں تاکہ ملکی امور کو بہتر طریقے سے چلایا جا سکے۔

stories.title: گجرات میں ٹک ٹاک کمنٹ پر تلخ کلامی، فائرنگ سے نوجوان قتل
stories.summary:
گجرات کے علاقے تھانہ منگووال کی حدود میں واقع گاؤں کیرانوالہ میں سوشل میڈیا ایپ ٹک ٹاک پر کمنٹ کرنے کے تنازع پر ایک نوجوان کو فائرنگ کرکے قتل کردیا گیا۔ مقتول عبدالقادر اور ملزم مجتبیٰ کے درمیان ٹک ٹاک کے کمنٹ باکس میں معمولی تلخ کلامی ہوئی تھی، جس کے بعد ملزم نے مبینہ طور پر فائرنگ کرکے عبدالقادر کی جان لے لی۔ واقعہ کے بعد ملزم موقع سے فرار ہونے میں کامیاب ہوگیا۔

واقعے کی اطلاع ملتے ہی پولیس اور فرانزک ٹیمیں فوری طور پر جائے وقوعہ پر پہنچ گئیں اور وہاں سے تمام ضروری شواہد اکٹھے کیے۔ مقتول کی لاش کو پوسٹ مارٹم کے لیے قریبی اسپتال منتقل کردیا گیا ہے تاکہ قانونی کارروائی مکمل کی جا سکے۔

پولیس حکام کے مطابق ملزم کی گرفتاری کے لیے کیرانوالہ گاؤں میں مکمل ناکہ بندی کرکے شدید چھاپے مارے جا رہے ہیں۔ اس کے علاوہ ملحقہ علاقوں میں لگے سی سی ٹی وی کیمروں کی فوٹیج کی مدد سے بھی ملزم کا سراغ لگانے کی کوشش کی جا رہی ہے۔

پولیس کا کہنا ہے کہ اس ہلاکت کے واقعے کی مختلف پہلوؤں سے گہرائی سے تحقیقات جاری ہیں۔ ملزم کو جلد از جلد قانون کے کٹہرے میں لانے کے لیے پولیس کی جانب سے کارروائیوں کو مزید تیز کردیا گیا ہے۔

stories.title: Wall Street Mixed as Investors Await Major AI Market Listing
stories.summary:
Main indexes on Wall Street traded in a mixed and choppy pattern on Thursday as investors displayed caution ahead of Anthropic's highly anticipated stock market debut. Anthropic priced its initial public offering at $83 per share to raise $81 billion, valuing the artificial intelligence lab at approximately $1.5 trillion prior to its Nasdaq launch.

The cautious market sentiment followed weeks of selling pressures across chipmaking and cloud computing sectors, driven by investor concerns over high valuations, heavy infrastructure expenditures, and executive departures. Market analysts noted that the Anthropic listing acts as an essential valuation indicator for the broader artificial intelligence ecosystem. Meanwhile, hyperscalers Amazon and Alphabet saw share increases of 0.3 percent and 2.5 percent, respectively.
